items.title_zh: 2023年全球心理疾病流行趋势与负担分析
items.summary_zh: 2023年全球疾病负担研究（GBD）评估了375种疾病和伤害的流行率、发病率及健康负担，其中包括12种心理疾病。本文分析了1990年至2023年间，心理疾病在不同性别、年龄组、21个地区及204个国家和地区的流行趋势及负担。研究涵盖的心理疾病包括焦虑症、重度抑郁症、心境恶劣症、双相情感障碍、精神分裂症、自闭症谱系障碍、行为障碍、注意缺陷多动障碍、厌食症、贪食症、特发性发育性智力残疾及其他心理疾病。通过文献回顾和贝叶斯元回归分析，估算了各疾病的流行率，并结合残疾权重计算了残疾年数（YLDs）。厌食症导致的死亡则通过死亡原因集成建模策略进行评估，最终得出各性别、年龄、地区及年份的死亡数据。

items.title: Why Early, Large-scale Weight Loss Is the Future of Type 2 Diabetes Care.
items.body: Type 2 diabetes has traditionally been viewed as a chronic, progressive condition. However, recent innovations, such as accessible low-calorie diets and newer weight loss medications, are challenging this paradigm. Evidence from clinical trials and mechanistic studies indicates that intentional weight loss, especially early in the disease course, can meaningfully alter its trajectory through reducing ectopic fat and glycemic levels. New medications that reduce "food noise" are particularly valuable in today's obesogenic environments, helping patients regain some control over calorie intake and supporting sustainable lifestyle changes. These therapies can lead to weight loss of ≥10% in type 2 diabetes and may enable newly diagnosed individuals to achieve and maintain normoglycemia for many years. Early, substantial weight loss combined with glycemic normalization has the potential to extend life expectancy, reduce or delay complications associated with obesity and hyperglycemia, improve quality of life, and lower long-term care needs. Beyond weight reduction, additional health benefits are offered by these medications, as they also slow atherosclerosis and preserve kidney function. Building on recent American Diabetes Association-European Association for the Study of Diabetes guideline recommendations, we propose that intentional weight loss at or near the time of diagnosis be considered a central strategy in type 2 diabetes management. To support this shift, proof-of-concept trials should be conducted for assessment of the long-term efficacy and durability of this approach. With success, increased competition and broader access to weight loss medications could lower costs and expand availability-even in low- and middle-income countries, where diabetes rates are rising rapidly-supporting a transformative change in the global standard of care.
items.authors: Sattar N, Buse JB.
items.title_zh: 早期大规模减重是2型糖尿病护理的未来
items.summary_zh: 2型糖尿病传统上被视为一种慢性进展性疾病。然而，近年来低热量饮食和新型减重药物的出现正在挑战这一观念。临床试验和机制研究的证据表明，特别是在疾病早期，故意减重能够显著改变疾病进程，降低异位脂肪和血糖水平。在当前肥胖环境下，能够减少“食物噪音”的新药物尤为重要，帮助患者重新控制热量摄入并支持可持续的生活方式改变。这些治疗方法可以使2型糖尿病患者实现≥10%的体重减轻，并可能使新诊断的患者在多年内维持正常血糖水平。早期显著减重结合血糖正常化有潜力延长寿命，减少或延缓与肥胖和高血糖相关的并发症，提高生活质量，并降低长期护理需求。此外，这些药物还提供额外的健康益处，如减缓动脉粥样硬化和保护肾功能。基于近期美国糖尿病协会-欧洲糖尿病研究协会的指南建议，我们提议在诊断时或接近诊断时进行故意减重。

items.title: Designing Next-Generation Cardiometabolic Outcome Trials for Obesity Medicines.
items.body: The prevalence of obesity has reached pandemic proportions and is having enormous public health effects. Obesity increases the risk of type 2 diabetes, hypertension, chronic kidney disease, and cardiovascular (CV) disease including coronary artery disease, heart failure, atrial fibrillation, and stroke. Although initial randomized clinical trials of weight-loss strategies through diet and exercise or early medical therapies did not lead to improved CV outcomes, more recent trials using glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists in individuals with obesity have demonstrated CV benefits. At present, there are multiple cardiovascular outcome trials (CVOTs) of novel GLP-1 receptor agonists and investigational products targeting multiple hormonal pathways planned or underway. However, the optimal design features of CVOTs testing novel obesity medications may need to evolve. In this commentary, we discuss regulatory aspects and study design considerations of CVOTs for obesity medications in the context of previous and ongoing clinical trials and the future of CVOTs targeting obesity. We also propose 5 principles to help guide next-generation cardio-kidney-metabolic outcome trials.
items.journal: Journal of the American College of Cardiology
items.authors: Platz E, Peikert A, Bozkurt B, Van der Schueren B, Butler J, Lingvay I, McGuire DK, Zannad F, Sattar N.
items.title_zh: 设计下一代心脏代谢结果试验以评估肥胖药物
items.summary_zh: 肥胖的流行已达到大流行水平，严重影响公共健康，增加了2型糖尿病、高血压、慢性肾病及心血管疾病（如冠心病、心力衰竭、房颤和中风）的风险。尽管早期通过饮食、运动或药物治疗的随机临床试验未能改善心血管结果，但近期针对肥胖患者使用的GLP-1（胰高血糖素样肽-1）受体激动剂的试验显示出心血管益处。目前，多个新型GLP-1受体激动剂及其他靶向多种激素通路的心血管结果试验（CVOTs）正在进行或计划中。然而，评估新型肥胖药物的CVOTs的最佳设计特征可能需要演变。本文讨论了肥胖药物CVOTs的监管方面和研究设计考虑，并提出了五项原则，以指导下一代心脏-肾脏-代谢结果试验。

items.title: Incretin Mimetics in Cancer and Cardiovascular Disease: JACC: CardioOncology State-of-the-Art Review.
items.body: Incretin mimetics (glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists and dual glucagon-like peptide-1/glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide receptor agonists) are paradigm changing for managing obesity, diabetes, and cardiovascular risk. These phenotypes are also associated with elevated risk for numerous cancers. Limited research suggests that incretin mimetics may be associated with lower risk for developing several cancers. However, more translational and randomized clinical data are needed for confirmation. Patients with cancer were excluded from trials of incretin mimetics. Therefore, their effects on adipose tissue, muscle, cardiovascular risk factors, and outcomes in this population are unknown. Notwithstanding contraindications with a history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2, translational data also promote the hypothesis that incretin mimetics could slow the growth of other cancers. Further clinical data are needed to determine which patients undergoing cancer treatment might experience benefit or harm from the anthropometric and calorie reduction effects of incretin mimetics or display cardiometabolic benefit despite the competing risk for cancer death.
items.authors: Leong D, Gong S, Sattar N, Narayan V, Reizine NM, Gerstein H, Vellky J.
items.title_zh: 胰高血糖素样肽模仿物在癌症与心血管疾病中的应用
items.summary_zh: 胰高血糖素样肽模仿物（如胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂及双重受体激动剂）在管理肥胖、糖尿病及心血管风险方面具有变革性意义。这些疾病与多种癌症的风险增加相关。有限研究表明，胰高血糖素样肽模仿物可能与降低某些癌症的发生风险相关，但尚需更多转化研究和随机临床数据以确认其效果。癌症患者在胰高血糖素样肽模仿物的临床试验中被排除，因此其对脂肪组织、肌肉及心血管风险因素的影响尚不明确。尽管存在对髓样甲状腺癌或多发性内分泌肿瘤2型的禁忌症，转化数据也支持胰高血糖素样肽模仿物可能减缓其他癌症的生长。进一步的临床数据是必要的，以确定在癌症治疗中哪些患者可能从胰高血糖素样肽模仿物的体重和热量减少效果中受益或受到伤害。

items.title: Heart failure and obesity: novel insights leading to new treatment paradigms.
items.body: Heart failure (HF) and obesity place a substantial burden on health-care systems worldwide. Obesity is associated with an estimated 5-7% increase in the incidence of new-onset HF for each unit increase in body mass index. This obesity-associated risk is more pronounced for HF with preserved ejection fraction than for HF with reduced ejection fraction. The relationship between HF and obesity has historically been underrecognized. However, because of the development of weight-loss drugs with beneficial effects on outcomes in patients with HF with preserved ejection fraction, this link is now clear. In this Review, we provide a summary of the effects of obesity on the development of HF, exploring the epidemiology and potential pathophysiological mechanisms linking these two conditions. We also discuss management strategies, including lifestyle interventions and novel pharmaceutical approaches. This Review adds an impetus to all practitioners of cardiovascular medicine, especially specialists in HF, to become well-versed in obesity management and underscores the need for further research on the effects of intentional weight loss in various cardiovascular conditions.
items.authors: Meems LMG, van Veldhuisen DJ, Sattar N, Lee MMY.
items.title_zh: 心力衰竭与肥胖：新见解引领新治疗模式
items.summary_zh: 心力衰竭（HF）和肥胖对全球医疗系统造成了重大负担。肥胖与每增加一个单位的体重指数（BMI），新发心力衰竭的发生率增加5-7%相关。这种肥胖相关风险在射血分数保留的心力衰竭（HFpEF）中更为明显。历史上，HF与肥胖之间的关系未受到足够重视，但随着减重药物的开发，这一联系变得更加清晰。本文综述了肥胖对HF发展的影响，探讨了这两种状况之间的流行病学和潜在病理生理机制，并讨论了管理策略，包括生活方式干预和新型药物方法。本文强调心血管医学从业者，尤其是HF专家，需熟悉肥胖管理，并指出在各种心血管疾病中对有意减重效果的进一步研究的必要性。

items.title: Effectiveness and safety of combining SGLT2 inhibitors and GLP-1 receptor agonists in individuals with type 2 diabetes: a systematic review and meta-analysis of cohort studies.
items.body: Aims/hypothesis Sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitors and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) reduce cardiorenal risk in type 2 diabetes. However, the effect of combining these drugs remains uncertain. This systematic review aimed to evaluate the potential effectiveness and safety of combination therapy compared with monotherapy in individuals with type 2 diabetes. Method We systematically searched PubMed and Embase from inception to 1 May 2025 for cohort studies comparing the effect of combination therapy with SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 RA monotherapy on (cardiovascular) mortality and cardiovascular or kidney endpoints in individuals with type 2 diabetes. Studies enrolling individuals with type 1 diabetes or a maximum follow-up of less than 1 year were excluded. The primary outcome was a composite of major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE). Secondary outcomes included all-cause mortality, cardiovascular mortality, hospitalisation for heart failure, a kidney composite endpoint and serious adverse events. Risk of bias was assessed with ROBINS-I. Risk ratios (RRs) and 95% CIs were pooled in random effects meta-analyses. Certainty of evidence was assessed using Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation (GRADE). Results We included 18 cohort studies (1,164,774 participants). In cohort studies, combination therapy was associated with a lower risk of MACE (RR 0.56 [95% CI 0.43, 0.71]; low certainty of evidence) and the kidney composite endpoint (RR 0.48 [95% CI 0.32, 0.73]; very low certainty of evidence) relative to SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 RA monotherapy. Combination therapy was also associated with a lower risk of all-cause mortality (RR 0.50 [95% CI 0.40, 0.63]; low certainty of evidence), cardiovascular mortality (RR 0.26 [95% CI 0.16, 0.43]; low certainty of evidence) and hospitalisation for heart failure (RR 0.67 [95% CI 0.64, 0.71]; moderate certainty of evidence). Although safety data could not be pooled due to lack of events, no differences were observed in the risk of severe hypoglycaemia, diabetic ketoacidosis, genitourinary infections and gastrointestinal side effects. No data were reported on the risk of serious adverse events or major adverse limb events. Conclusions/interpretation Observational studies suggest that combining an SGLT2 inhibitor and a GLP-1 RA in type 2 diabetes may lower the risk of MACE, all-cause and cardiovascular mortality, hospitalisation for heart failure and kidney composite endpoints compared with monotherapy with either drug. Of course, residual confounding cannot be overcome but results support the need for future randomised trials of combined vs monotherapy. Registration PROSPERO registration no. CRD42024532383.
items.authors: Colombijn JMT, de Leijer JF, Visseren FLJ, Verhaar MC, van Raalte DH, Sattar N, Vernooij RWM, van Sloten TT.
items.title_zh: SGLT2抑制剂与GLP-1受体激动剂联合治疗2型糖尿病的有效性与安全性
items.summary_zh: 本系统评价旨在评估SGLT2抑制剂（SGLT2 inhibitors）与GLP-1受体激动剂（GLP-1 RAs）联合治疗与单药治疗在2型糖尿病患者中的有效性与安全性。我们系统检索了PubMed和Embase数据库，纳入18项队列研究，共计1,164,774名参与者。主要结局为主要不良心血管事件（MACE）的复合指标，次要结局包括全因死亡率、心血管死亡率、心力衰竭住院、肾脏复合终点及严重不良事件。结果显示，联合治疗与单药治疗相比，可能在降低心血管风险方面具有潜在优势，但具体效果仍需进一步验证。风险偏倚评估采用ROBINS-I，证据的确定性使用GRADE进行评估。

items.title: Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Risk Before and After Type 2 Diabetes Onset and the Roles of Ectopic Fat and Ethnic Variation: The 2025 Edwin Bierman Award Lecture.
items.body: Atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) risk begins increasing years before the clinical onset of type 2 diabetes, driven in part by ectopic lipid accumulation. Many individuals predisposed to diabetes often gain weight rapidly and have limited capacity to expand subcutaneous fat, leading to central fat storage and ectopic lipid deposition-especially in the liver. Hepatic fat contributes to metabolic dysfunction and elevated triglyceride-rich lipoproteins (TRLs), which are atherogenic. Alongside higher blood pressure, these factors accelerate atherosclerosis even before hyperglycemia is evident. Although traditional cardiovascular risk factors like LDL cholesterol (LDL-C) and smoking have declined, rising obesity-particularly among younger individuals-is shifting ASCVD risk more toward pathways linked to ectopic lipid accumulation and prolonged exposure to diabetes-related metabolic disturbances. Ethnic variation plays a significant role in modifying this risk. South Asians, for example, develop type 2 diabetes at lower BMIs and tend to have higher hepatic fat and TRL levels than White individuals, contributing to their increased ASCVD burden. Conversely, people of African ancestry often have lower hepatic fat and TRL levels at similar BMIs, correlating with lower ASCVD risk despite elevated diabetes risk. Risk profiles in other ethnic groups remain understudied. These findings highlight the need for early obesity prevention and ethnically tailored strategies for ASCVD risk assessment and management. Without targeted interventions, rising global rates of obesity and type 2 diabetes, especially in low- and middle-income countries, will increase ectopic lipid accumulation, TRLs, and blood pressure, ultimately accelerating ASCVD progression and reversing prior gains made in cardiovascular prevention.
items.authors: Sattar N.
items.title_zh: 动脉粥样硬化性心血管风险与糖尿病的关系及种族差异
items.summary_zh: 动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病（ASCVD）风险在2型糖尿病临床发作前数年就开始增加，部分原因是异位脂肪的积累。许多易患糖尿病的人往往快速增重，皮下脂肪扩展能力有限，导致中心脂肪储存和异位脂质沉积，尤其是在肝脏。肝脏脂肪会导致代谢功能障碍和升高的富甘油三酯脂蛋白（TRLs），这些都是动脉粥样硬化的危险因素。尽管传统心血管风险因素如低密度脂蛋白胆固醇（LDL-C）和吸烟有所下降，但肥胖率上升，特别是在年轻人中，使ASCVD风险更倾向于与异位脂肪积累及糖尿病相关的代谢紊乱相关。种族差异在此风险的修饰中起着重要作用。例如，南亚人群在较低的体重指数（BMI）下发展2型糖尿病，且肝脏脂肪和TRL水平较高，增加了ASCVD负担。相反，非洲血统的人在相似BMI下肝脏脂肪和TRL水平较低，尽管糖尿病风险升高，但ASCVD风险较低。其他种族群体的风险特征尚待深入研究。

items.title: Carcinoma of Esophagus.
items.body: Carcinoma of esophagus is one of the most common cancer worldwide, but its epidemiology is changing. Squamous cell carcinoma is declining in the East, but adenocarcinoma is rising in the West, probably related to the pandemic of obesity and changing lifestyle. Screening of esophageal cancer (both endoscopic and nonendoscopic methods) is recommended in patients suffering from long-term acid reflux symptoms associated with high-risk factors and surveillance in patients with Barrett's esophagus. Endoscopy with virtual chromoendoscopy, endoscopic ultrasound, and CT scan is essential for diagnosis and staging of the disease. Endoscopic therapy can be used to treat early diseases. Surgery remains a mainstay treatment. Multimodality treatment strategies involving combinations of chemotherapy, radiotherapy, and more recently immunotherapy and target therapies are gaining momentum.
items.authors: Sung J, Lin D, Fitzgerald R, Sharma P, Law S, Ilson D.
items.title_zh: 食管癌的流行病学变化与治疗策略
items.summary_zh: 食管癌是全球最常见的癌症之一，其流行病学正在发生变化。东部地区的鳞状细胞癌（squamous cell carcinoma）发病率下降，而西部地区的腺癌（adenocarcinoma）则在上升，这可能与肥胖疫情和生活方式的改变有关。建议对长期出现酸 reflux 症状且具有高风险因素的患者进行食管癌筛查（包括内镜和非内镜方法），并对巴雷特食管（Barrett's esophagus）患者进行监测。内镜检查结合虚拟染色内镜、内镜超声和CT扫描对疾病的诊断和分期至关重要。内镜治疗可用于早期疾病的治疗，而手术仍然是主要的治疗方法。近年来，结合化疗、放疗以及免疫疗法和靶向治疗的多模式治疗策略正在逐渐受到重视。

items.title: Tirzepatide and cardiometabolic parameters in obesity: Summary of current evidence.
items.body: Globally, cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) account for around one-third of all deaths. Clinical trial evidence suggests that treatment of people with obesity or type 2 diabetes (T2D) and CVD with glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists reduces the risk of major adverse cardiovascular events, heart failure outcomes and all-cause mortality. Tirzepatide is a once-weekly, dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) and GLP-1 receptor agonist that has demonstrated dose-dependent efficacy in people with obesity, T2D or both, in terms of glycaemic control and bodyweight reduction in clinical trials. This narrative review summarizes the current evidence regarding the effects of tirzepatide treatment on cardiometabolic parameters, including lipid profile, blood pressure and markers of renal function. Additionally, it summarizes the reported impact of tirzepatide treatment on other relevant parameters, such as body composition, liver fat, progression to T2D among individuals with prediabetes, and incidence of heart failure events. Considering the changing landscape of clinical trial evidence of tirzepatide's effects, this review aims to compile the available evidence, which suggests a promising outlook for the cardiometabolic benefits of tirzepatide.
items.authors: Sattar N, García-Pérez LE, Rodríguez A, Kapoor R, Stefanski A, Hankosky ER.
items.title_zh: Tirzepatide对肥胖患者心代谢参数的影响综述
items.summary_zh: 全球心血管疾病（CVD）约占所有死亡人数的三分之一。临床试验证据表明，使用胰高血糖素样肽-1（GLP-1）受体激动剂治疗肥胖或2型糖尿病（T2D）伴随CVD患者可降低重大不良心血管事件、心力衰竭结果及全因死亡率的风险。Tirzepatide是一种每周一次的双重葡萄糖依赖性胰岛素促分泌肽（GIP）和GLP-1受体激动剂，在肥胖、T2D或两者兼有的患者中，已在临床试验中显示出剂量依赖性的血糖控制和体重减轻效果。本文综述了Tirzepatide治疗对心代谢参数的影响，包括脂质谱、血压和肾功能标志物。此外，还总结了Tirzepatide对其他相关参数的影响，如身体成分、肝脏脂肪、糖尿病前期个体向T2D的进展及心力衰竭事件的发生率。考虑到Tirzepatide效果的临床试验证据不断变化，本文旨在汇总现有证据，展现Tirzepatide在心代谢益处方面的良好前景。

items.title: Key priorities for the implementation of the 2023 ESC Guidelines for the management of cardiovascular disease in patients with diabetes in low-resource settings.
items.body: ESC Guidelines provide best practice, evidence-based recommendations for diagnosing and treating patients with cardiovascular diseases. It is not always possible for best practices to be followed, however, particularly in low-resource settings. To address this issue, a set of guideline-related documents were created to identify key priorities for users in these settings. The documents highlight the related recommendations and describe key strategies for clinicians to approach implementation of these recommendations or discuss alternatives which are in line with the intention of the recommendations, if not having all of the same advantages. The suggestions cannot be used as exact substitutes for the original recommendations in the guidelines, which have not been altered and continue to reflect best practice. This document on key priorities for low-resource settings was developed by the task force Chairs and other members of the task force who produced the 2023 ESC Guidelines for the management of cardiovascular disease in patients with diabetes, which are freely available on the ESC website (https://www.escardio.org/Guidelines). The document also underwent external review, including international experts from within and beyond Europe and ESC partner organizations, including the Interamerican Society of Cardiology, the Asian Pacific Society of Cardiology, and the Asean Federation of Cardiology.
items.journal: European heart journal. Quality of care & clinical outcomes
items.authors: Marx N, Schütt K, Müller-Wieland D, Di Angelantonio E, Herrington WG, Ajjan RA, Kautzky-Willer A, Rocca B, Sattar N, Fauchier L, Lettino M, Federici M, Members of the Task Force for the 2023 ESC Guidelines for the manage
items.title_zh: 2023年ESC指南在低资源环境中管理糖尿病心血管疾病的优先事项
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了2023年欧洲心脏病学会（ESC）指南在低资源环境中实施的关键优先事项。ESC指南为心血管疾病的诊断和治疗提供了基于证据的最佳实践建议，但在资源有限的环境中，遵循这些最佳实践并不总是可行。为此，制定了一系列相关文件，旨在帮助临床医生识别实施这些建议的关键策略，并探讨符合建议意图的替代方案。虽然这些建议不能完全替代原指南中的推荐，但它们为低资源环境中的临床实践提供了指导。该文件由负责2023年ESC糖尿病患者心血管疾病管理指南的工作组主席及其他成员开发，并经过国际专家的外部审查。

items.title: Type 2 diabetes in South Asians.
items.body: Type 2 diabetes poses a substantial public health challenge in South Asia, marked by distinctive features in its pathogenesis, phenotype, and management. This review explores the characteristics of type 2 diabetes in South Asians who tend to develop the condition at a younger average age and lower body mass index than white populations. Prevalence is high and varies across the region, with recent increases in youth onset type 2 diabetes. Environmental influences are driving greater sedentary behavior, and dietary shifts towards processed foods are leading to higher body weights. This is concerning because South Asians show greater abdominal obesity, ectopic fat accumulation (particularly hepatic fat), and lower skeletal muscle mass than white people of a similar age and body mass index. These features, coupled with rapid β cell dysfunction, contribute to earlier onset and accelerated glycemia progression (greater aggregated hyperglycemia than white people), contributing to more retinopathy, cardiovascular disease, and chronic kidney disease. Management of type 2 diabetes in the region is hindered by delayed diagnosis, inadequate healthcare access, and economic barriers limiting sustainable glucose, lipid, and blood pressure management. Evidence supports lifestyle and dietary weight loss as viable approaches to prevention and diabetes remission, respectively, though sustained remission is untested. Recently introduced drugs (sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors and newer glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor agonists) offer promise in weight management and cardiovascular and kidney protection, but are often inaccessible owing to cost constraints. Future efforts should prioritize affordable and innovative solutions, strengthen healthcare systems, and implement population wide preventive measures that account for the region's socioeconomic complexities, and practical contextual research.
items.authors: Misra A, Sattar N, Ghosh A, Nassar M, Jayawardena R, Gupta R.
items.title_zh: 南亚地区的2型糖尿病现状与挑战
items.summary_zh: 2型糖尿病在南亚地区构成了重大的公共卫生挑战，其发病机制、表型和管理具有独特特征。南亚人群通常在较年轻的年龄和较低的体重指数下发展此病，且发病率较高，尤其是青少年发病率有所上升。环境因素导致久坐行为增加，饮食向加工食品转变，体重上升令人担忧。南亚人群的腹部肥胖、异位脂肪积累（尤其是肝脏脂肪）及骨骼肌量较低，均高于同龄白人。这些特征与β细胞功能快速衰退相结合，导致早发和血糖进展加速，进而增加视网膜病变、心血管疾病和慢性肾病的风险。该地区2型糖尿病的管理受到诊断延迟、医疗服务不足及经济障碍的影响。证据表明，生活方式和饮食减重是预防和糖尿病缓解的有效方法。

items.title: Sex-Specific Risk of Smoking for Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm and Exploration of Potential Mechanism: Meta-Analysis and Prospective Cohort Study.
items.body: Background Smoking is the strongest modifiable risk factor for the development of abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA). This study aims to confirm whether smoking is a stronger risk factor in women than men and identify contributory reasons, including inflammation, for any sex-specific difference observed. Methods Systematic review and meta-analysis, conducted according to Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses guidance. Data sources were Medline, Embase, and Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials. Population-based studies reporting the risk of AAA, adjusted for age and cardiovascular risk factors, for women versus men, were included. These were complemented by data from UK Biobank, which also were assessed for sex-specific effects of smoking on incident atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease. Results Meta-analysis of 6 studies (including UK Biobank, 2001-2024) showed that the relative risk ratio of current versus never smokers for incident AAA in women versus men was 1.78 (95% CI, 1.32-2.38). In the UK Biobank cohort, the sex-specific relative risks of current smoking risks were higher for AAA than for atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease; hazard ratio, 1.74 and 1.29, respectively: analysis by cigarettes per day echoed these findings, but pack-year history had lesser association. The proportionately lower AAA incidence rate in exsmokers (versus current smokers) was more marked in women. Sex-specific risks of current smoking for incident AAA were not significantly modified by CRP (C-reactive protein), white blood cell count, or other inflammatory markers. Conclusions The relative risk of developing AAA by current smokers is almost twice as high in women versus men, but no strong association with inflammation was observed. Other reasons, including smoking intensity, must be sought. Registration URL: https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/; Unique identifier: CRD2024586609.
items.authors: Welsh P, Pouncey AL, Sattar N, Powell JT.
items.title_zh: 吸烟对腹主动脉瘤的性别特异性风险及潜在机制探讨
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在确认吸烟是否对女性腹主动脉瘤（AAA）的风险影响大于男性，并探讨可能的原因，包括炎症。通过系统评价和荟萃分析，纳入了6项研究的数据（包括UK Biobank，2001-2024），结果显示，女性当前吸烟者与从不吸烟者相比，发生AAA的相对风险比为1.78（95% CI, 1.32-2.38）。在UK Biobank队列中，当前吸烟对AAA的性别特异性相对风险高于动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病，风险比分别为1.74和1.29；按每日吸烟量分析的结果与此一致，但吸烟年限的关联性较弱。研究还发现，戒烟者的AAA发生率相对较低。

items.title: Obesity substantially impacts rheumatic and musculoskeletal diseases: time to act.
items.body: Obesity is a major health problem and risk factor for many chronic health conditions, including rheumatic and musculoskeletal diseases (RMDs). Around 7 in 10 adults with RMD live overweight or with obesity. Obesity not only increases the risk of developing RMDs. It worsens disease activity, pain, and fatigue; impairs treatment responses; and thereby reduces quality of life and physical function. Further, obesity can amplify or drive several comorbidities that are more prevalent in RMDs including hypertension, cardiovascular disease, type 2 diabetes, and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease. Moreover, reciprocal risk arises since RMDs make it harder to be physically active and maintain a healthy weight, especially in the context of an obesogenic environment. In this viewpoint, we review relevant evidence to suggest obesity confers distinctive, important challenges in care and daily living for many patients with RMDs. With the advent of several highly effective drugs for obesity, we also highlight research needs including that for robust clinical trials to test the efficacy and effectiveness of these therapies as part of the management of inflammatory RMDs, as primary agent or adjuvant to immune targeted therapeutics. Implementing such weight management strategies should provide a much-needed holistic approach to the care of our patients.
items.authors: Sattar N, Sattar LJ, McInnes IB, Siebert S, Ferguson LD.
items.title_zh: 肥胖对风湿和肌肉骨骼疾病的重大影响：行动时刻已到
items.summary_zh: 肥胖是一个主要的健康问题，也是许多慢性健康状况的风险因素，包括风湿和肌肉骨骼疾病（RMDs）。约70%的RMD患者为超重或肥胖。肥胖不仅增加了RMD的发生风险，还加重了疾病活动性、疼痛和疲劳，影响治疗反应，从而降低生活质量和身体功能。此外，肥胖还可能加剧与RMDs相关的多种合并症，如高血压、心血管疾病、2型糖尿病和代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪肝病。RMDs使得保持身体活动和健康体重变得更加困难，形成了相互风险。本文回顾了相关证据，指出肥胖为许多RMD患者的护理和日常生活带来了独特而重要的挑战。随着多种有效肥胖药物的出现，本文强调了进行强有力临床试验的研究需求，以测试这些疗法在炎症性RMDs管理中的有效性。实施这些体重管理策略应为患者提供所需的整体护理方法。

items.title: Adaptive consolidation of active inference: excitatory and inhibitory mechanisms for organizing feedforward and feedback memory systems in sleep.
items.body: Cognitive self-organization rests on activity-dependent plasticity to extend the ontogenetic process of neural differentiation and integration of the cerebral cortex in each act of cognition. This account of neurocognitive growth can be formulated in terms of active inference and learning. The organism regulates synaptic connectivity as it seeks its goals actively, through excitatory, feedforward expectancies that manifest its species-specific affordances. These adaptive expectancies are modified reactively, through inhibitory feedback error-correction to fit and predict environmental encounters. Although adaptive behavior, and concomitant synaptic plasticity, occur during waking, the synaptic architecture requires ongoing consolidation and refinement during sleep. We propose that memory consolidation during sleep is a continuation of the neurodevelopmental process that proceeds through a kind of inversion of waking active inference: NREM sleep first refines the brain's representations of new, unpredicted experiences during waking, implementing inhibitory mechanisms of long-term depression that both differentiate and stabilize new representations for consolidation. REM sleep then updates the organism's generative world model in light of this new learning through excitatory long-term potentiation of synaptic plasticity. REM thereby reconsolidates and integrates the organism's adaptive, feedforward predictions, the Bayesian priors for effective coping.
items.authors: Tucker DM, Luu P, Friston KJ.
items.title_zh: 睡眠中主动推理的适应性巩固机制
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了在睡眠中，主动推理（active inference）如何通过兴奋性和抑制性机制组织前馈和反馈记忆系统。认知自组织依赖于活动依赖性可塑性，以延续神经分化和大脑皮层整合的过程。生物体在追求目标时，通过兴奋性前馈预期调节突触连接，并通过抑制性反馈错误修正来适应环境。尽管在清醒状态下会发生适应性行为和突触可塑性，但突触结构在睡眠中需要持续巩固和精炼。作者提出，睡眠中的记忆巩固是神经发育过程的延续，NREM睡眠通过抑制性机制精炼新经验的表征，而REM睡眠则通过兴奋性机制更新生物体的世界模型，从而实现记忆的再巩固和整合。

items.title: Cardiovascular and Kidney Outcomes and Mortality With Long-Acting Injectable and Oral Glucagon-Like Peptide 1 Receptor Agonists in Individuals With Type 2 Diabetes: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Randomized Trials.
items.body: Background Glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RA) reduce the incidence of major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) in type 2 diabetes (T2D), although whether benefits extend to both subcutaneous and oral formulations remains unclear. Purpose In these meta-analyses, including new data from the Semaglutide cardiOvascular oUtcomes triaL (SOUL) (oral semaglutide) and Evaluate Renal Function with Semaglutide Once Weekly (FLOW) trial, we examined cardiovascular (CV) and kidney benefits and risks of long-acting (defined as having pharmacokinetics sufficient to provide 24-h activity) GLP-1RA in T2D. Data sources A systematic review of PubMed was conducted (to 7 February 2025). Study selection Randomized placebo-controlled CV and kidney outcomes trials of GLP-1RA with ≥500 individuals with T2D were included. Data extraction A random-effects model was used to estimate hazard ratios (HRs) for MACE, its components, all-cause mortality, hospitalization for heart failure (HHF), a composite kidney outcome (kidney failure [kidney replacement therapy or persistent estimated glomerular filtration rate [eGFR] Data synthesis Across 10 trials (n = 71,351), long-acting GLP-1RA reduced incidence rate of MACE by 14% (HR 0.86 [95% CI 0.81, 0.90]; I2 = 27.6%), HHF by 14% (0.86 [0.79, 0.93]; I2 = 2.1%), and the composite kidney outcome by 17% (0.83 [0.75, 0.92]; I2 = 20.4%) and all-cause mortality by 12% (0.88 [0.82, 0.93]; I2 = 17.5%). A consistent 14% reduction was seen for all MACE components. There was no significant heterogeneity by GLP-1RA administration route (subcutaneous vs. oral). There were no increased risks of severe hypoglycemia, retinopathy, or pancreatic events. Limitations Trial-level meta-analyses preclude detailed subgroup analyses and may introduce ecological bias. Conclusions As a group, long-acting GLP-1RA, including both injectable and oral formulations, reduce incidence of MACE, HHF, and kidney events and all-cause mortality in T2D.
items.authors: Lee MMY, Sattar N, Pop-Busui R, Deanfield J, Emerson SS, Inzucchi SE, Mann JFE, Marx N, Mulvagh SL, Poulter NR, Badve SV, Pratley RE, Perkovic V, Buse JB, McGuire DK, SOUL Trial Investigators.
items.title_zh: 长效GLP-1受体激动剂对2型糖尿病心肾结局的影响
items.summary_zh: 本系统评价和荟萃分析研究了长效胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂（GLP-1RA）在2型糖尿病（T2D）患者中的心血管（CV）和肾脏结局及死亡率。分析纳入了包括口服赛马鲁肽（semaglutide）在内的随机对照试验数据。结果显示，在10项试验（共71,351名参与者）中，长效GLP-1RA使主要不良心血管事件（MACE）发生率降低14%（风险比HR 0.86 [95% CI 0.81, 0.90]），心力衰竭住院率降低14%（HR 0.86 [0.79, 0.93]），复合肾脏结局降低17%（HR 0.83 [0.75, 0.92]）。这些结果表明，长效GLP-1RA在改善T2D患者的心肾结局方面具有显著益处。

items.title: Almost a third of Scots are now obese – and at risk of more cancers than smokers
items.body: Scotland successfully targeted its smoking problem, now it needs to do the same for obesity.

items.title_zh: 苏格兰近三分之一人口肥胖，癌症风险高于吸烟者
items.summary_zh: 苏格兰成功解决了吸烟问题，现在需要同样的努力来应对肥胖问题。研究显示，苏格兰的肥胖率已接近三分之一，这使得该国面临更高的癌症风险，甚至超过吸烟者。肥胖与多种癌症（如乳腺癌、结肠癌等）的发生密切相关，且肥胖人群的健康问题日益严重。为了改善公众健康，苏格兰必须采取有效措施，制定针对肥胖的政策和干预措施，以降低肥胖率和相关疾病的发生。

items.title: Is this really the final word on whether calorie restricted diets make you live longer?
items.authors: Naveed Sattar
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/naveed-sattar-331175（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 卡路里限制饮食是否真的能延长寿命？
items.summary_zh: 本文评述了关于卡路里限制饮食（Caloric Restriction, CR）是否能延长寿命的最新研究成果。核心论点是，尽管一些动物实验显示卡路里限制可能延长寿命，但在人类中的效果尚不明确。关键证据包括对不同物种的研究结果，以及对人类长期饮食习惯的观察。结论指向，虽然卡路里限制饮食在理论上可能有益于健康，但目前尚无确凿证据证明其能显著延长人类寿命，未来的研究仍需深入探讨这一领域。

items.title: Impacts of systemic milieu on cerebrovascular and brain aging: insights from heterochronic parabiosis, blood exchange, and plasma transfer experiments.
items.body: Aging is a complex biological process that detrimentally affects the brain and cerebrovascular system, contributing to the pathogenesis of age-related diseases like vascular cognitive impairment and dementia (VCID) and Alzheimer's disease (AD). While cell-autonomous mechanisms that occur within cells, independent of external signals from neighboring cells or systemic factors, account for some aspects of aging, they cannot explain the entire aging process. Non-autonomous, paracrine and endocrine, pathways also play a crucial role in orchestrating brain and vascular aging. The systemic milieu modulates aging through pro-geronic and anti-geronic circulating factors that mediate age-related decline or confer rejuvenative effects. This review explores the impact of systemic factors on cerebrovascular and brain aging, with a particular focus on findings from heterochronic parabiosis, blood exchange, and plasma transfer experiments. We discuss how these factors influence fundamental cellular and molecular processes of aging and impact cerebrovascular endothelial function, neurovascular coupling mechanisms, blood-brain barrier integrity, neuroinflammation, capillary density, and amyloid pathologies, with significant consequences for cognitive function. Additionally, we address the translational potential and challenges of modifying the systemic milieu to promote brain health and prevent age-related cognitive impairment.
items.authors: Gulej R, Patai R, Ungvari A, Kallai A, Tarantini S, Yabluchanskiy A, Huffman DM, Conboy MJ, Conboy IM, Kivimäki M, Csiszar A, Ungvari Z.
items.title_zh: 系统环境对脑血管和大脑衰老的影响研究
items.summary_zh: 衰老是一个复杂的生物过程，对大脑和脑血管系统产生负面影响，促进与年龄相关的疾病如血管性认知障碍和阿尔茨海默病的发生。尽管细胞自主机制在衰老中起一定作用，但无法解释整个衰老过程。非自主的旁分泌和内分泌途径在大脑和血管衰老中也扮演着关键角色。系统环境通过促衰老和抗衰老的循环因子调节衰老，影响与年龄相关的衰退或赋予复兴效应。本文探讨了系统因素对脑血管和大脑衰老的影响，特别关注异时性共生、血液交换和血浆转移实验的发现。我们讨论了这些因素如何影响衰老的基本细胞和分子过程，影响脑血管内皮功能、神经血管耦合机制、血脑屏障完整性、神经炎症、毛细血管密度和淀粉样病理，进而对认知功能产生显著影响。此外，我们还探讨了调整系统环境以促进大脑健康和预防衰老的转化潜力和挑战。

items.title: Subtyping schizophrenia via machine learning by using structural neuroimaging.
items.body: Schizophrenia is a heterogeneous disorder with diverse clinical presentations and neuroanatomical alterations. Despite recent advances, we still lack a working hypothesis for the pathophysiology of schizophrenia. One reason might be the heterogeneous neuroanatomy of the patients. Data-driven approaches leveraging structural neuroimaging and machine learning have emerged as transformative tools for unraveling this enigma. Recent studies employing advanced clustering techniques have identified robust neuroanatomical subtypes independent of traditional symptom-based frameworks. These data-driven methods reveal distinct cortical and subcortical patterns, aligning with disease progression variations, cognitive function, and treatment outcomes. Novel trajectory-based models suggest that schizophrenia may originate from distinct neuroanatomical regions and follow divergent paths of progression, emphasizing the importance of understanding these patterns in the context of disease staging. These findings provide a foundation for improving diagnostic precision, understanding disease mechanisms, and tailoring interventions. Validation with longitudinal data and standardized methods is crucial for translating these insights into clinical practice and personalized treatments.
items.authors: Gonul AS, Candemir C, Thompson P.
items.title_zh: 利用结构神经影像学与机器学习对精神分裂症进行亚型划分
items.summary_zh: 精神分裂症是一种异质性疾病，表现出多样的临床特征和神经解剖变化。尽管近年来取得了一些进展，但我们仍缺乏关于精神分裂症病理生理的有效假说。患者的神经解剖异质性可能是一个原因。数据驱动的方法结合结构神经影像学和机器学习，已成为揭示这一难题的变革性工具。近期研究采用先进的聚类技术，识别出独立于传统症状框架的稳健神经解剖亚型。这些方法揭示了不同的皮层和皮下模式，与疾病进展、认知功能和治疗结果的变化相一致。新的轨迹模型表明，精神分裂症可能源自不同的神经解剖区域，并遵循不同的进展路径，强调在疾病分期背景下理解这些模式的重要性。这些发现为提高诊断精度、理解疾病机制和个性化干预提供了基础。使用纵向数据和标准化方法进行验证，对于将这些见解转化为临床实践和个性化治疗至关重要。

items.title: Association between cerebral lesions and the severity of diabetic cardiovascular disease, retinopathy, and nephropathy-new lessons to learn from neuroimaging.
items.body: Diabetes is associated with cerebrovascular lesions detectable through neuroimaging. Neuroimaging is traditionally valued for its insights into the structure of the central nervous system. However, the brain is connected with other organs. The vascular system, hormones, and peripheral nerve system connect the brain to other sections of the body bidirectionaly. This interaction between the brain and other parts encourages us to look at the total body, not just its different parts separately. Growing evidence has shown the link between brain injuries and cardiac, retinal, and kidney disorders, suggesting that neuroimaging has the potential to provide valuable information about peripheral organs This is particularly crucial for a systemic disease like diabetes, which affects the entire body. In this review, we aim to first discuss the data that neuroimaging can reveal about the severity of diabetic retinopathy, nephropathy, and cardiovascular disease in diabetic patients. This interdisciplinary approach could guide the design of new randomized controlled trials, screening programs, and an integrated clinical practice. This study explores the mechanisms underlying the association between the brain and other organs in the context of diabetes. Then we will consider their implications for future research and clinical practice.
items.authors: Ebrahimi M, Thompson PM, Kafashan Z, Ceriello A, Kolko M, Grauslund J.
items.title_zh: 脑损伤与糖尿病心血管病、视网膜病和肾病的关系
items.summary_zh: 糖尿病与通过神经影像学（neuroimaging）可检测的脑血管损伤相关。神经影像学传统上用于揭示中枢神经系统的结构，但大脑与其他器官相互连接，形成双向联系。越来越多的证据表明，脑损伤与心脏、视网膜和肾脏疾病之间存在关联，提示神经影像学能够提供有关外周器官的重要信息。这对于影响全身的系统性疾病如糖尿病尤为重要。本文旨在讨论神经影像学可以揭示的糖尿病患者视网膜病、肾病和心血管疾病的严重程度数据。这种跨学科的方法可能为新随机对照试验、筛查程序和综合临床实践的设计提供指导。研究还探讨了糖尿病背景下大脑与其他器官之间关联的机制，并考虑其对未来研究和临床实践的影响。

items.title: Combating Genetic Heterogeneity for Polygenic Prediction of Susceptibility to Brain β-Amyloid Deposition: Beyond i APOE /i .
items.body: Background and objectives The APOE (apolipoprotein E) ε4 allele is the strongest known genetic risk factor for sporadic Alzheimer disease (AD) and for brain amyloidosis, an early marker of disease pathophysiology. However, APOE ε4 is present in only 25% of the general population and is by itself inadequate for explaining susceptibility to amyloid accumulation or AD diagnosis. Existing studies have been limited by potential confounding due to inclusion of individuals carrying APOE ε4 or ε2 (which has a modest protective association). We hypothesized that genome-wide association study (GWAS) and genetic risk score (GRS) analyses in APOE ε3/ε3 individuals would uniquely identify novel predictors of β-amyloid pathology in older adults. Methods We analyzed data from the Mayo Clinic Study of Aging (MCSA), Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI), and Rush Religious Orders Study and Memory and Aging Project. Frequency of APOE ε3/ε3 in those samples ranged from 48% to 61%. A GWAS was performed across 1,496 individuals with amyloid PET to identify candidate variants for GRS generation. Postmortem neuropathologic data (N = 710) were used to refine the variant list to capture high-likelihood true associations. An independent sample (N = 641) with plasma p-tau 181 data was used for validation. Results The GWAS identified previously implicated (e.g., PICALM and RBFOX1 ) and novel potential associations with amyloid PET burden. A non- APOE GRS of top variants was strongly associated with amyloid PET levels in the MCSA ( p = 4.34 × 10 -9 , β = 5.88) and ADNI ( p = 1.87 × 10 -8 , β = 12.1) cohorts. In both cohorts, this non- APOE amyloid GRS outperformed a comparator GRS (based on variants associated with clinically diagnosed AD dementia risk) in explaining phenotypic variation. The non- APOE amyloid GRS was also associated with postmortem neuropathologic β-amyloid and neurofibrillary tangle burden and in an independent sample was associated with plasma p-tau 181 concentrations (a robust indicator of cerebral amyloidosis). Discussion Our non- APOE amyloid GRS, which appropriately includes variants associated with amyloid deposition in APOE ɛ4/ɛ2 noncarriers, may advance personalized prediction of genetic susceptibility to β-amyloid accumulation within the large segment of the population that is APOE ε3/ε3. This may have future implications for risk modification, trial enrollment, and treatment selection.
items.authors: Ramanan VK, Heckman MG, Hofrenning EI, Przybelski SA, Graff-Radford J, Lowe VJ, Machulda MM, Murray ME, Algeciras-Schimnich A, Figdore DJ, Bennett DA, Knopman DS, Jack CR, Petersen RC, Ross OA, Vemuri P, Alzheimer's Dise
items.title_zh: 应对基因异质性以预测脑β-淀粉样沉积易感性
items.summary_zh: 本研究聚焦于APOE（载脂蛋白E）ε4等位基因，该基因是散发性阿尔茨海默病（AD）和脑淀粉样沉积的主要遗传风险因素。然而，APOE ε4仅在25%的人群中存在，且不足以解释淀粉样蛋白积累或AD诊断的易感性。现有研究因包含携带APOE ε4或ε2（具有一定保护作用）个体而受到限制。我们假设在APOE ε3/ε3个体中进行全基因组关联研究（GWAS）和遗传风险评分（GRS）分析将独特识别出老年人β-淀粉样病理的新预测因子。我们分析了梅奥诊所老龄化研究（MCSA）、阿尔茨海默病神经影像学倡议（ADNI）和拉什宗教团体研究的数据，发现APOE ε3/ε3的频率在48%至61%之间。GWAS在1496名接受淀粉样PET扫描的个体中进行，以识别GRS生成的候选变异，并利用710份尸检神经病理数据精炼变异列表。最终，641份含有血浆p-tau 181数据的独立样本用于验证。

items.title: Research advances in the diagnosis of infectious disease by aptasensor technology.
items.body: Infectious diseases remain a major challenge to public health. The accurate and timely detection of pathogens responsible for these diseases is essential for controlling their spread, supporting clinical diagnosis, and enabling the application of appropriate therapies. Traditionally, the antibody-based assay has been the primary method for pathogen detection. However, recent advancements in aptamer-based technologies have initiated a transformative shift in diagnostic approaches. Aptamer-based sensors (aptasensors) are characterized by lower production costs and greater flexibility, making them compatible with various detection techniques. This broad applicability facilitates multifaceted, high-throughput applications, significantly improving the capacity to monitor and detect infectious diseases. In this review, we introduce the pathogenic mechanisms and characteristics of pathogens, provide an overview of recent advancements in the development of aptasensors for pathogen detection and highlight their versatility in identifying various infectious disease pathogens, including viruses, bacteria, parasites and other microorganisms. We systematically categorize aptasensors according to their detection mechanisms, including colorimetry, fluorescence, chemiluminescence, surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy (SERS), surface plasmon resonance (SPR), electrochemistry and incorporation of field-effect transistors (FETs). We further demonstrate how these platforms leverage pathogen-specific biological features to achieve ultrasensitive and rapid diagnostics. Further optimization and validation of aptasensor platforms are anticipated to accelerate their clinical translation and industrialization. Advancing these innovative technologies will be crucial to meeting the growing demand for rapid, accurate and reliable pathogen detection across diverse clinical and environmental conditions, ultimately strengthening the ability to respond effectively to infectious disease threats.
items.authors: Li H, Yang Q, Li X, Fu X, Li J, Zhang Y, Tan W, Wang P.
items.title_zh: 适配体传感器技术在传染病诊断中的研究进展
items.summary_zh: 传染病仍然是公共卫生面临的主要挑战，准确及时地检测致病菌对控制其传播、支持临床诊断和应用适当治疗至关重要。传统上，基于抗体的检测方法是主要的致病菌检测手段。然而，适配体（aptamer）技术的最新进展正在推动诊断方法的变革。适配体传感器（aptasensor）具有生产成本低和灵活性高的特点，适用于多种检测技术。这种广泛的适用性促进了多方面的高通量应用，显著提高了监测和检测传染病的能力。本文介绍了致病机制和致病菌的特征，概述了适配体传感器在致病菌检测方面的最新进展，并强调其在识别各种传染病病原体（包括病毒、细菌、寄生虫及其他微生物）中的多功能性。我们系统地根据检测机制对适配体传感器进行了分类，包括比色法、荧光法、化学发光法、表面增强拉曼光谱（SERS）、表面等离子体共振（SPR）、电化学等。

items.title: The South’s aging water infrastructure is getting pounded by climate change – fixing it is also a struggle
items.body: Extreme downpours and droughts, both fueled by rising global temperatures, are taking a toll. Communities trying to manage the threats face three big challenges.
items.authors: John C. Morris
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/john-c-morris-1526386（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 南方老化水利基础设施受气候变化冲击，修复面临挑战
items.summary_zh: 随着全球气温上升，极端降雨和干旱对南方的水利基础设施造成了严重影响。社区在应对这些威胁时面临三大挑战：基础设施老化、资金不足以及气候变化带来的不确定性。这些因素使得修复和升级水利系统变得更加困难，亟需采取有效措施以应对气候变化带来的影响。

items.title: The Use of Deep Learning in RNA Therapeutic Development.
items.body: Ribonucleic acid (RNA)-based therapeutics have emerged as promising methods of disease treatment due to their ability to target the human genome and influence protein production, their versatility, and their relative lack of toxicity compared to other gene therapies. However, the RNA therapeutic design space is extremely large, encompassing multiple variables, including codon identities, secondary structure, and design of specific regions. RNA therapeutic optimization is difficult due to the impracticality of exploring such a vast design space experimentally. To address this limitation, deep learning methods have been employed to optimize RNA therapeutic development. In this review, we examine the application of deep learning models across three key aspects of RNA therapeutic development (RNA structure prediction, CRISPR activity, and RNA delivery), highlighting major contributions in these fields and analyzing how deep learning model architectures could affect model performance. We then discuss challenges associated with using deep learning for RNA therapeutics, such as computational and data limitations. Finally, we offer perspectives on areas for future exploration, such as emerging model architectures and methods of integration with more advanced high-throughput screening techniques. Ultimately, this review provides an overview of how deep learning is used in RNA therapeutic development and how it can evolve in the future.
items.authors: Subramanian DA, Yao SL, Chan A, Witten J, Reker D, Anderson DG, Langer R, Traverso G.
items.title_zh: 深度学习在RNA治疗开发中的应用
items.summary_zh: RNA（核糖核酸）基础的治疗方法因其能够靶向人类基因组、影响蛋白质生产、灵活性高且相较于其他基因疗法毒性较低而成为有前景的疾病治疗手段。然而，RNA治疗的设计空间极为广泛，涉及多个变量，如密码子身份、二级结构和特定区域的设计，使得优化过程困难。为解决这一限制，深度学习方法被应用于RNA治疗开发的优化。本文评述了深度学习模型在RNA治疗开发的三个关键方面（RNA结构预测、CRISPR活性和RNA递送）的应用，强调了这些领域的重要贡献，并分析了深度学习模型架构如何影响模型性能。同时，讨论了使用深度学习进行RNA治疗时面临的计算和数据限制等挑战。最后，提出了未来探索的方向，如新兴模型架构和与更先进的高通量筛选技术的整合方法。

items.title: Translational bottlenecks for biohybrid microrobots.
items.body: Rapid advances in biohybrid microrobots have prompted focused examination of the barriers to their clinical translation.
items.authors: Zhang L, Wang J.
items.title_zh: 生物混合微型机器人临床转化的瓶颈分析
items.summary_zh: 生物混合微型机器人（biohybrid microrobots）的快速发展引发了对其临床转化障碍的深入研究。文章聚焦于当前生物混合微型机器人在临床应用中面临的主要瓶颈，包括技术、法规和市场接受度等方面的挑战。通过分析现有文献和实验数据，作者指出，尽管生物混合微型机器人在实验室环境中表现出色，但在实际临床应用中仍需克服多重障碍，以实现其潜在的医疗价值。最终，文章呼吁加强跨学科合作，推动技术进步和政策制定，以促进生物混合微型机器人的临床转化。

items.title: Towards intelligent and miniaturized drug delivery devices.
items.body: Advances at the intersection of biotechnology, artificial intelligence, electronics and materials science are reshaping how drugs can be delivered inside the body. Intelligent and miniaturized drug delivery devices (IMDDDs) leverage these technologies to achieve precise pharmacokinetics, targeted distribution and programmable release while minimizing toxicity and improving patient adherence. Unlike conventional approaches, IMDDDs can incorporate real-time sensing and adaptive control, enabling drug administration that is more precise and more responsive to dynamic physiological conditions. In this Review, we outline key categories and design principles, highlight artificial intelligence technologies for augmenting performance, discuss potential clinical applications across cancer, diabetes, cardiovascular disease, vaccination and beyond, and examine translation challenges and opportunities. By uniting engineering innovation with medical need, IMDDDs exemplify the next generation of drug delivery technologies.
items.authors: Wei X, Buse JB, Chen H, Desai TA, Stevens MM, Traverso G, Langer R, Gu Z.
items.title_zh: 智能化微型药物输送装置的未来发展
items.summary_zh: 本文评述了智能化微型药物输送装置（IMDDDs）在生物技术、人工智能、电子学和材料科学交叉领域的最新进展。IMDDDs利用这些技术实现精准的药物动力学、靶向分布和可编程释放，同时降低毒性并提高患者依从性。与传统方法不同，IMDDDs能够实时感知和自适应控制，使药物给药更加精准且能快速响应动态生理条件。文章概述了IMDDDs的关键类别和设计原则，强调了人工智能技术在提升性能方面的应用，讨论了其在癌症、糖尿病、心血管疾病和疫苗接种等领域的潜在临床应用，并探讨了转化过程中的挑战与机遇。IMDDDs代表了药物输送技术的下一代发展方向。

items.title: Advanced Oral Delivery Systems for Nutraceuticals.
items.body: Oral delivery is the most preferred route for nutraceuticals due to its convenience and high patient compliance. However, bioavailability is often compromised by poor solubility, instability, and first-pass metabolism in the gastrointestinal tract. This review examines current and emerging oral delivery platforms designed to overcome these barriers and enhance nutraceutical efficacy. Traditional carriers-proteins, lipids, and carbohydrates-highlighting their delivery mechanisms and limitations, are first explored. Advancements in material science have led to novel platforms such as biodegradable polymers, metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), metal-polyphenol networks (MPNs), and 3D printing technologies. Biodegradable polymers improve stability and enable controlled release of bioactives. MOFs offer high surface area and tunable porosity for encapsulating and protecting sensitive compounds. MPNs provide biocompatible, stimuli-responsive systems for targeted nutrient delivery. Meanwhile, 3D printing facilitates the fabrication of personalized delivery systems with precise control over composition and release kinetics, especially when integrated with artificial intelligence (AI) for precision nutrition. By comparing traditional and next-generation strategies, this review outlines key design principles for optimizing oral delivery systems. The transformative potential of these innovations is underscored to improve the bioavailability and therapeutic outcomes of nutraceuticals, ultimately advancing personalized and targeted nutrition solutions.
items.authors: Yang X, Zhang L, Zheng Z, Langer R, Jaklenec A.
items.title_zh: 先进的营养保健品口服递送系统
items.summary_zh: 口服递送因其便利性和高患者依从性而成为营养保健品的首选途径。然而，生物利用度常因溶解度差、不稳定性和肠道首过代谢而受到影响。本文评述了当前和新兴的口服递送平台，旨在克服这些障碍并增强营养保健品的疗效。首先探讨了传统载体（如蛋白质、脂质和碳水化合物）的递送机制及其局限性。材料科学的进步催生了生物可降解聚合物、金属有机框架（MOFs）、金属-多酚网络（MPNs）和3D打印技术等新平台。生物可降解聚合物提高了稳定性并实现了生物活性成分的控制释放。MOFs具有高表面积和可调孔隙率，适合包封和保护敏感化合物。MPNs提供了生物相容性和刺激响应的系统，以实现靶向营养递送。同时，3D打印技术可制造个性化递送系统，尤其在与人工智能（AI）结合时，能够精确控制成分和释放动力学。通过比较传统与新一代策略，本文概述了优化口服递送系统的关键设计原则。

items.title: Delivery of macromolecular drugs: An update.
items.body: In 2019, in this journal, I discussed approaches for controlling the movement of molecules, in particular macromolecules, with an emphasis on how this enabled advances in the field of drug delivery - a field that has impacted billions of people worldwide. Since 2019, there have been advances in our work and this field including a striking demonstration in which drug delivery nanoparticles were crucial to the success of mRNA therapies and the Covid-19 vaccine. In this paper, I provide updates in such areas as i) developing new methods for oral drug delivery systems, ii) delivery of molecules to specific sites of the body, iii) new types of delivery systems, and iv) examples of machine learning/artificial intelligence in these areas. I also discuss advances in mRNA technology as it relates to drug delivery and the development of nanoparticles to protect and deliver vaccines, which saved and improved the lives of hundreds of millions of people throughout the world.
items.authors: Langer R.
items.title_zh: 大分子药物递送的最新进展
items.summary_zh: 本文更新了大分子药物递送领域的研究进展，特别强调了药物递送纳米颗粒在mRNA疗法和新冠疫苗成功中的关键作用。自2019年以来，研究者们在多个方面取得了进展，包括：i) 开发新的口服药物递送系统，ii) 将分子递送到身体特定部位，iii) 新型递送系统的出现，以及 iv) 机器学习/人工智能在这些领域的应用实例。此外，文章还讨论了与药物递送相关的mRNA技术进展，以及开发纳米颗粒以保护和递送疫苗的研究，这些进展拯救并改善了全球数亿人的生命。

items.title: Enhancing immunotherapy with tumour-responsive nanomaterials.
items.body: The targeted delivery of immunotherapies to tumours using tumour-responsive nanomaterials is a promising area of cancer research with the potential to address the limitations of systemic administration such as on-target off-tumour toxicities and a lack of activity owing to the immunosuppressive tumour microenvironment (TME). Attempts to address these challenges include the design and functionalization of nanomaterials capable of releasing their cargoes in response to specific TME characteristics, thus facilitating the targeted delivery of immune-checkpoint inhibitors, cytokines, mRNAs, vaccines and, potentially, chimaeric antigen receptors as well as of agents that modulate the extracellular matrix and induce immunogenic cell death. In this Review, we describe these various research efforts in the context of the dynamic properties of the TME, such as pH, reductive conditions, reactive oxygen species, hypoxia, specific enzymes, high levels of ATP and locoregional aspects, which can be leveraged to enhance the specificity and efficacy of nanomaterial-based immunotherapies. Highlighting preclinical successes and ongoing clinical trials, we evaluate the current landscape and potential of these innovative approaches. We also consider future research directions as well as the most important barriers to successful clinical translation, emphasizing the transformative potential of tumour-responsive nanomaterials in overcoming the barriers that limit the activity of traditional immunotherapies, thus improving patient outcomes.
items.authors: Linderman SW, DeRidder L, Sanjurjo L, Foote MB, Alonso MJ, Kirtane AR, Langer R, Traverso G.
items.title_zh: 利用肿瘤响应纳米材料增强免疫疗法
items.summary_zh: 本文评述了利用肿瘤响应纳米材料进行靶向免疫疗法递送的研究进展，旨在克服系统性给药的局限性，如靶向外的肿瘤毒性和免疫抑制的肿瘤微环境（TME）造成的活性不足。研究者们设计和功能化纳米材料，使其能够根据特定的TME特征释放药物，从而实现免疫检查点抑制剂、细胞因子、mRNA、疫苗及潜在的嵌合抗原受体的靶向递送。此外，文章探讨了调节细胞外基质和诱导免疫原性细胞死亡的药物递送。通过强调前临床成功案例和正在进行的临床试验，评估了这些创新方法的现状和潜力，并考虑了未来的研究方向及成功临床转化的主要障碍，突显了肿瘤响应纳米材料的变革潜力。

items.title: Applying Artificial Intelligence and machine learning in precision nutrition.
items.body: A key feature of the Precision Nutrition and Health approach is the ability to tailor interventions to individual variability using multimodal data from large-scale biobanks and cohorts. Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) models offer new potential to model complex data but remain constrained by challenges related to data quality, interpretability, validation, and causal inference. This Perspective synthesizes current AI/ML methodologies in PN, elucidates their interplay with the distinctive features of multi-omic and nutritional data, such as being compositional, episodic, context-dependent, and error-prone, and delineates nutrition-specific best practices for achieving robust, interpretable, and clinically actionable AI integration in research and practice.
items.authors: Massara P, Kirkland J, Pagani I, Huey SL, Hirsh H, McDonald D, Patel L, Finkelstein JL, Gantz M, Wang F, Erickson D, Wells MT, Elemento O, Knight R, Mehta S.
items.title_zh: 人工智能与机器学习在精准营养中的应用
items.summary_zh: 精准营养与健康方法的关键特征在于利用大规模生物库和队列的多模态数据，根据个体差异定制干预措施。人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）模型为复杂数据建模提供了新的潜力，但仍面临数据质量、可解释性、验证和因果推断等挑战。本文综述了当前在精准营养（PN）领域的AI/ML方法，阐明了它们与多组学和营养数据的独特特征之间的相互作用，这些特征包括组成性、情节性、依赖于上下文和易出错等，并 delineates 了实现稳健、可解释和临床可操作的AI整合在研究和实践中的营养特定最佳实践。

items.title: Sewage testing robots process wastewater faster to predict COVID 19 outbreaks sooner
items.body: A community’s wastewater can predict coronavirus cases that haven’t yet been diagnosed. The quicker that information is known, the better.
items.authors: Rob Knight
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/rob-knight-1215921（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 污水检测机器人加速处理废水以预测COVID-19疫情
items.summary_zh: 社区的废水可以预测尚未确诊的冠状病毒病例。通过快速获取这些信息，能够更早地采取防控措施，从而有效应对疫情。污水检测机器人通过提高废水处理速度，能够更及时地分析病毒载量，为公共卫生决策提供重要依据。这种技术的应用将有助于在疫情爆发前识别潜在风险，提升社区的防疫能力。

items.title: Wildfires are reversing America’s progress on ozone pollution, the main ingredient in smog
items.authors: Jun Wang
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/jun-wang-2419399（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 野火逆转美国臭氧污染治理进展
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了野火对美国臭氧污染（ozone pollution）进展的影响，指出近年来频繁的野火导致臭氧浓度上升，进而加剧了雾霾（smog）问题。研究显示，野火释放的烟雾和污染物使得空气质量恶化，抵消了过去几年在减少臭氧排放方面所取得的成就。文章引用了相关数据，表明在某些地区，臭氧水平已达到了危险的临界点，影响了公众健康和环境。结论强调，面对气候变化和野火频发的挑战，美国需要重新评估和加强其空气质量管理政策，以应对日益严峻的臭氧污染问题。

items.title: Which wildfire smoke plumes are hazardous? New satellite tech can map them in 3D for air quality alerts at neighborhood scale
items.body: As wildfire smoke becomes a frequent summer hazard across large parts of the US, knowing the risk at the neighborhood scale matters for human health.
items.authors: Jun Wang
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/jun-wang-2419399（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 新卫星技术可3D绘制野火烟雾对空气质量影响
items.summary_zh: 随着野火烟雾在美国大部分地区成为夏季常见的危害，了解邻里尺度的风险对人类健康至关重要。新开发的卫星技术能够在三维空间中绘制烟雾云团，为社区提供空气质量警报。这项技术的应用将有助于更准确地评估不同地区的空气质量，进而为居民提供及时的健康建议，降低因烟雾引发的健康风险。通过对烟雾的实时监测，科学家们能够更好地理解其对人类健康的影响，并为政策制定提供数据支持。

items.title: What are the symptoms of omicron?
items.body: Omicron is continuing the trend set by delta, causing symptoms that resemble the common cold.
items.authors: Tim D. Spector
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/tim-spector-105795（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: Omicron变种的症状与普通感冒相似
items.summary_zh: Omicron变种继续延续了德尔塔（delta）变种的趋势，其症状与普通感冒相似。这一发现提示我们，Omicron感染可能导致轻微的呼吸道症状，如咳嗽、喉咙痛和流感等。尽管Omicron的传播性较强，但其症状的轻微化可能影响公众对疫情的认知和应对策略。科学家们强调，尽管症状较轻，仍需保持警惕，特别是在高风险人群中。

items.title: Should we all be using ‘sniff tests’ to screen for COVID 19?
items.body: Temperature checks have become a commonplace screening tool for COVID-19, but loss of sense of smell is a more predictive symptom of coronavirus infection than fever.
items.authors: Tim D. Spector
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/tim-spector-105795（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 我们是否都应该使用“嗅觉测试”筛查COVID-19？
items.summary_zh: 温度检测已成为COVID-19的常见筛查工具，但失去嗅觉（anosmia）是比发热更具预测性的冠状病毒感染症状。研究表明，嗅觉丧失在COVID-19患者中更为普遍，且其出现时间往往早于其他症状。相比之下，体温升高可能并不总是与感染相关。因此，科学家们建议在筛查COVID-19时，考虑使用嗅觉测试作为补充手段，以提高早期检测的准确性和效率。这一观点强调了嗅觉测试在公共卫生应对中的潜在价值。

items.title: Why one size fits all diets don’t work – new study
items.authors: Tim D. Spector
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/tim-spector-105795（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 为何“一刀切”饮食法行不通——新研究揭示
items.summary_zh: 一项新研究探讨了“一刀切”饮食法为何不适合所有人。研究表明，个体的基因、代谢和生活方式差异使得统一的饮食方案难以有效。通过分析不同参与者在相同饮食下的反应，研究发现，某些人对特定食物的反应显著不同，导致体重管理和健康效果的差异。研究强调，个性化饮食方案可能更有效，建议根据个人的生理特征和生活习惯制定饮食计划，以实现更好的健康效果。

items.title: Coronavirus: research reveals way to predict infection – without a test
items.body: Symptoms like loss of smell and taste are powerful predictors of COVID-19 infections.
items.authors: Tim D. Spector
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/tim-spector-105795（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 研究揭示无检测预测新冠病毒感染的方法
items.summary_zh: 研究表明，失去嗅觉和味觉等症状是COVID-19感染的强有力预测指标。这一发现为新冠病毒的早期识别提供了新的思路，可能在没有检测的情况下帮助识别感染者，从而提高公共卫生应对能力。通过分析大量病例数据，研究人员发现这些症状在感染者中具有较高的出现率，能够有效预测感染的可能性。这一研究为未来的疫情监测和防控策略提供了重要依据。

items.title: Our free coronavirus symptom tracking app has been used by two million people – here’s what we’re learning
items.authors: Tim D. Spector
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/tim-spector-105795（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 我们的新冠症状追踪应用已被两百万用户使用
items.summary_zh: 本文评述了一款新冠病毒症状追踪应用的使用情况，该应用已被超过两百万用户下载。研究团队通过收集用户提交的症状数据，分析了新冠病毒的传播模式和症状表现。核心论点是，用户提供的数据帮助科学家更好地理解新冠病毒的影响，并为公共卫生决策提供支持。关键证据包括用户报告的症状变化和疫情高发期的相关数据。结论指出，这种应用不仅为个人健康管理提供了便利，也为疫情防控提供了重要的实时数据支持。

items.title: Coronavirus: how to keep your gut microbiome healthy to fight COVID 19
items.body: Your gut plays an important role in building your immune defences. Don’t neglect it.

items.title_zh: 新冠病毒：如何保持肠道微生物群健康以抵抗COVID-19
items.summary_zh: 肠道在构建免疫防御中扮演着重要角色，因此维护肠道健康至关重要。研究表明，肠道微生物群（gut microbiome）对免疫系统的功能有显著影响，健康的肠道微生物群能够增强机体对病毒的抵抗力。通过合理饮食、补充益生菌等方式，可以有效改善肠道微生物群的组成，从而提升免疫力，帮助身体更好地应对COVID-19等病毒感染。因此，关注肠道健康不仅有助于整体健康，也可能在抗击新冠病毒中发挥积极作用。

items.title_zh: 未来营养建议将如何个性化？医疗为你量身定制——第二部分
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了医疗个性化的趋势，特别是饮食方面的个性化建议。随着科技的发展，未来的营养建议将更加注重个体差异，包括基因组学（genomics）、微生物组（microbiome）和个人生活方式等因素。研究表明，个性化饮食能够提高健康效果，减少慢性疾病的风险。通过分析个人的生物标志物和饮食习惯，未来的营养师和医生将能够提供更为精准的饮食建议，以满足每个人的独特需求。这一变化不仅会影响个人的健康管理，也将推动整个医疗行业向更加个性化的方向发展。

items.title: Gut microbes can be picky eaters – here’s why it matters
items.body: Scientists are beginning to understand the food preferences of our gut microbes.

items.title_zh: 肠道微生物的饮食偏好及其重要性
items.summary_zh: 科学家们正在逐步理解我们肠道微生物的食物偏好。这些微生物在消化过程中扮演着重要角色，影响着宿主的健康和代谢。研究表明，肠道微生物对特定食物的选择性摄取可能与其生存环境、宿主的饮食习惯以及微生物之间的相互作用有关。了解这些饮食偏好不仅有助于揭示微生物如何影响宿主健康，还可能为改善饮食和预防疾病提供新的思路。通过深入研究肠道微生物的饮食习惯，科学家希望能够开发出更有效的营养干预措施，以促进人类健康。

items.title: Advances and Challenges in Wearable Sensors for Health Monitoring.
items.body: Analytical tools may revolutionize healthcare by enabling accessible, rapid, and decentralized testing. Wearable (bio)sensors, in particular, provide frequent or continuous patient monitoring through non- to minimally invasive measurements. This approach yields unprecedented amounts of health-related information, leading to more informed clinical decision-making and closer patient follow-up. In this mega-review article, we bring together leading researchers in the field to discuss the state of the art in wearable devices for health monitoring. We begin by providing a broad overview of the field through citation network analysis. We then review the application of chemical (bio)sensors in biofluids (e.g., sweat, saliva, tears, interstitial fluid, and cerebrospinal fluid), highlighting the challenges and advantages associated with each. Subsequently, we discuss the construction of wearable devices and their main formats (e.g., smart contact lenses, textiles, mouthguards, watches/wristbands, and implantable systems). Physical sensors are addressed in a dedicated section focusing on the assessment of heart rate, blood pressure, and body temperature. The role of soft electronics in wearable devices is also examined, as these technologies are essential for enhancing user comfort and sensor reliability, which demands advances in materials science. Furthermore, we present strategies for signal acquisition and transmission, as well as approaches for on-body energy harvesting and device self-powering. The use of artificial intelligence and machine learning is then discussed as a means of enhancing analytical performance and managing the large volumes of data generated by wearable devices. Finally, business, regulatory, and ethical considerations are examined. We expect that this review will provide an overview of sensing and biosensing technologies for health-related applications, identify promising research directions, and inspire future developments.
items.authors: Brazaca LC, Moreno Lozano A, Mayol B, Scheidt DT, De Fazio D, Kim E, Maroli G, Rosati G, Ates HC, Wang H, Kim HJ, Ha JH, Yang J, Jeon J, Goldhahn J, Sonigara KK, Li, Zhou M, Cho S, Fan S, Wu S, Gonçalves VM, Dei Santi VH
items.title_zh: 可穿戴传感器在健康监测中的进展与挑战
items.summary_zh: 可穿戴（生物）传感器通过非侵入性或微创测量实现频繁或持续的患者监测，为医疗保健带来了革命性的变化。这种方法提供了前所未有的健康相关信息，促进了更为明智的临床决策和更紧密的患者跟踪。本文综述了可穿戴健康监测设备的最新进展，首先通过引文网络分析提供了该领域的广泛概述。接着，评述了化学（生物）传感器在生物液体（如汗液、唾液、泪液、间质液和脑脊液）中的应用，强调了各自的挑战和优势。随后，讨论了可穿戴设备的构建及其主要形式（如智能隐形眼镜、纺织品、护齿器、手表/手环和植入系统）。专门部分探讨了物理传感器在心率、血压和体温评估中的应用。还考察了软电子技术在可穿戴设备中的作用，这些技术对于提升用户舒适度和传感器可靠性至关重要，需在材料科学上取得进展。

items.title: Printing technologies for monitoring crop health.
items.body: Agricultural production requires low-cost sensors capable of delivering reliable, high-resolution data across large areas. Rising food demand, limited arable land, and severe soil degradation have accelerated the adoption of precision agriculture, which relies on real-time monitoring of soil, plant, and environmental conditions. Central to this shift is the development of scalable sensor technologies enabled by advances in materials science. Printing techniques, including inkjet, screen, aerosol jet, 3D printing, and direct laser writing, offer versatile routes to fabricate flexible, large-area, and plant-integrated sensors. This Review surveys recent progress in printable low-dimensional materials for agricultural sensing, examines their physicochemical properties in relation to sensor performance, and discusses key challenges and future opportunities requiring interdisciplinary integration.
items.authors: Panáček D, Kupka V, Nalepa MA, Dědek I, Álvarez-Diduk R, Olenik S, Flauzino J, Zdražil J, Jakubec P, Zdražil L, Spíchal L, Sonigara KK, Zbořil R, Pumera M, Merkoçi A, Wang J, De Diego N, Güder F, Otyepka M.
items.title_zh: 监测作物健康的打印技术研究
items.summary_zh: 农业生产需要低成本传感器，以在大范围内提供可靠的高分辨率数据。随着食品需求上升、可耕地有限以及土壤严重退化，精准农业的采用加速，这依赖于对土壤、植物和环境条件的实时监测。材料科学的进步推动了可扩展传感器技术的发展。打印技术，包括喷墨打印、丝网印刷、气溶胶喷射、3D打印和直接激光写入，提供了制造灵活、大面积和植物集成传感器的多种途径。本文评述了可打印低维材料在农业传感中的最新进展，考察了其物理化学性质与传感器性能的关系，并讨论了需要跨学科整合的关键挑战和未来机遇。

items.title: Microneedle-Based Multiplexed Monitoring of Diabetes Biomarkers: Capabilities Beyond Glucose Toward Closed-Loop Theranostic Systems.
items.body: Significant advances have been made in the management of diabetes through the development of wearable biomedical monitoring and drug-delivery devices. Technologies such as continuous glucose monitors (CGMs) and insulin pumps have particularly transformed diabetes care over the past two decades. However, most current efforts largely focus on glucose and insulin regulation, limiting a broader understanding of metabolic health and the interplay of various biomarkers. Comprehensive diabetes management requires a more holistic approach encompassing diverse biomarkers to address the full spectrum of metabolic health. Adequate response to glycemic variability thus requires continuous monitoring of additional chemical and physical parameters that affect insulin sensitivity. Leveraging recent advances in wearable microneedle (MN) platforms, such systems have received considerable attention for biomedical applications, ranging from continuous multiplexed monitoring to transdermal drug delivery. This review article provides a thorough analysis of the use of MNs for enhanced diabetes management, emphasizing their unique capabilities for simultaneous monitoring of multiple key diabetes biomarkers beyond glucose and for autonomous transdermal delivery of insulin and glucagon based on novel glucose-responsive MN materials and addressing literature gaps regarding the integration of such diagnostic and treatment technologies onto single MN arrays. Representative applications of key MN sensing and delivery devices are highlighted, underscoring their capabilities to revolutionize disease management. We conclude with a forward-looking vision of next-generation AI-guided MN-based closed-loop "Sense-Release" artificial pancreas systems for enhanced glycemic control and improved patient outcomes.
items.authors: Moonla C, Reynoso M, Chang AY, Saha T, Surace S, Wang J.
items.title_zh: 基于微针的糖尿病生物标志物多重监测技术进展
items.summary_zh: 本文评述了基于微针（Microneedle, MN）技术在糖尿病管理中的应用，强调其在超越血糖监测方面的独特能力。近年来，随着可穿戴生物医学监测和药物输送设备的发展，糖尿病管理取得了显著进展。尽管现有技术如连续血糖监测仪（CGMs）和胰岛素泵在糖尿病护理中发挥了重要作用，但大多数研究仍集中于血糖和胰岛素调节，限制了对代谢健康的全面理解。为了更好地应对血糖波动，需持续监测影响胰岛素敏感性的其他化学和物理参数。微针平台在连续多重监测和经皮药物输送方面的应用受到广泛关注，本文分析了微针在糖尿病管理中的潜力，特别是在同时监测多种关键生物标志物及自主输送胰岛素和胰高血糖素方面的前景。

items.title: Technology Roadmap of Micro/Nanorobots.
items.body: Inspired by Richard Feynman's 1959 lecture and the 1966 film Fantastic Voyage , the field of micro/nanorobots has evolved from science fiction to reality, with significant advancements in biomedical and environmental applications. Despite the rapid progress, the deployment of functional micro/nanorobots remains limited. This review of the technology roadmap identifies key challenges hindering their widespread use, focusing on propulsion mechanisms, fundamental theoretical aspects, collective behavior, material design, and embodied intelligence. We explore the current state of micro/nanorobot technology, with an emphasis on applications in biomedicine, environmental remediation, analytical sensing, and other industrial technological aspects. Additionally, we analyze issues related to scaling up production, commercialization, and regulatory frameworks that are crucial for transitioning from research to practical applications. We also emphasize the need for interdisciplinary collaboration to address both technical and nontechnical challenges, such as sustainability, ethics, and business considerations. Finally, we propose a roadmap for future research to accelerate the development of micro/nanorobots, positioning them as essential tools for addressing grand challenges and enhancing the quality of life.
items.authors: Ju X, Chen C, Oral CM, Sevim S, Golestanian R, Sun M, Bouzari N, Lin X, Urso M, Nam JS, Cho Y, Peng X, Landers FC, Yang S, Adibi A, Taz N, Wittkowski R, Ahmed D, Wang W, Magdanz V, Medina-Sánchez M, Guix M, Bari N, Behka
items.title_zh: 微纳机器人技术路线图
items.summary_zh: 受Richard Feynman 1959年讲座和1966年电影《奇幻之旅》的启发，微纳机器人领域从科幻走向现实，在生物医学和环境应用方面取得了显著进展。尽管发展迅速，功能性微纳机器人的应用仍然有限。本文评述了技术路线图，识别了阻碍其广泛应用的关键挑战，重点关注推进机制、基础理论、集体行为、材料设计和具身智能等方面。我们探讨了微纳机器人技术的现状，强调其在生物医学、环境修复、分析传感和其他工业技术中的应用。此外，分析了与生产规模化、商业化和监管框架相关的问题，这些对从研究转向实际应用至关重要。最后，提出了未来研究的路线图，以加速微纳机器人的发展，使其成为应对重大挑战和提升生活质量的重要工具。

items.title: DNA-PAINT Imaging with Hydrogel Imprinting and Clearing.
items.body: Hydrogel-embedding is a versatile technique in fluorescence microscopy, offering stabilization, optical clearing, and the physical expansion of biological specimens. DNA-PAINT is a super-resolution microscopy approach based on the diffusion and transient binding of fluorescently labeled oligos, but its feasibility in hydrogels has not yet been explored. In this study, we demonstrate that polyacrylamide hydrogels support sufficient diffusion for effective DNA-PAINT imaging. Using acrydite-anchored oligonucleotides imprinted from patterned DNA origami nanostructures and microtubule filaments in fixed cells, we find that hydrogel embedding preserves docking strand positioning at the nanoscale. Sample clearing via protease treatment had minor structural effects on the microtubule structure and enhanced diffusion and accessibility to hydrogel-imprinted docking strands. Our work demonstrates promising potential for diffusion and binding-based fluorescence imaging applications in hydrogel-embedded samples.
items.authors: Stein J, Magni L, Church GM.
items.title_zh: 水凝胶印刷与清晰化的DNA-PAINT成像技术
items.summary_zh: 水凝胶嵌入是一种在荧光显微镜中应用广泛的技术，能够提供样本的稳定性、光学清晰度和生物样本的物理扩展。DNA-PAINT（DNA-基于荧光的瞬时结合成像）是一种超分辨率显微镜方法，基于荧光标记寡核苷酸的扩散和瞬时结合，但其在水凝胶中的可行性尚未被探讨。本研究表明，聚丙烯酰胺水凝胶支持足够的扩散以实现有效的DNA-PAINT成像。通过从固定细胞中的图案化DNA折纸纳米结构和微管丝印刷的丙烯酰胺锚定寡核苷酸，我们发现水凝胶嵌入能够在纳米尺度上保持对接链的位置。通过蛋白酶处理进行样本清晰化对微管结构的影响较小，并增强了对水凝胶印刷对接链的扩散和可及性。我们的研究展示了基于扩散和结合的荧光成像在水凝胶嵌入样本中的应用潜力。

items.title: 33 Unresolved Questions in Nanoscience and Nanotechnology.
items.body: Significant advances in science and engineering often emerge at the intersections of disciplines. Nanoscience and nanotechnology are inherently interdisciplinary, uniting researchers from chemistry, physics, biology, medicine, materials science, and engineering. This convergence has fostered novel ways of thinking and enabled the development of materials, tools, and technologies that have transformed both basic and applied research, as well as how we address critical societal challenges. In this Nano Focus, we pose and explore 33 questions whose answers could profoundly impact fields such as energy, electronics, the environment, optics, and medicine. These questions highlight the need for deeper foundational understanding, improved tools and techniques, and innovative applications─each with significant societal relevance. Together, they represent a global call-to-action for the scientific community.
items.authors: Mirkin CA, Petrosko SH, Artzi N, Aydin K, Biaggne A, Brinker CJ, Bujold KE, Cao YC, Chan RR, Chen C, Chen PC, Chen X, Chevalier OJGL, Choi CHJ, Crooks RM, Dravid VP, Du JS, Ebrahimi SB, Fan H, Farha OK, Figg CA, Fink TD,
items.title_zh: 纳米科学与纳米技术中的33个未解问题
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了纳米科学与纳米技术领域中的33个未解问题，这些问题涉及化学、物理、生物、医学、材料科学和工程等多个学科的交叉。文章指出，这些问题的答案可能对能源、电子、环境、光学和医学等领域产生深远影响，强调了对基础理解的深入需求、工具和技术的改进以及创新应用的重要性。每个问题都具有显著的社会相关性，呼吁科学界共同关注并采取行动，以推动相关研究的发展。

items.title: Nanofabrication for Nanophotonics.
items.body: Nanofabrication, a pivotal technology at the intersection of nanoscale engineering and high-resolution patterning, has substantially advanced over recent decades. This technology enables the creation of nanopatterns on substrates crucial for developing nanophotonic devices and other applications in diverse fields including electronics and biosciences. Here, this mega-review comprehensively explores various facets of nanofabrication focusing on its application in nanophotonics. It delves into high-resolution techniques like focused ion beam and electron beam lithography, methods for 3D complex structure fabrication, scalable manufacturing approaches, and material compatibility considerations. Special attention is given to emerging trends such as the utilization of two-photon lithography for 3D structures and advanced materials like phase change substances and 2D materials with excitonic properties. By highlighting these advancements, the review aims to provide insights into the ongoing evolution of nanofabrication, encouraging further research and application in creating functional nanostructures. This work encapsulates critical developments and future perspectives, offering a detailed narrative on the state-of-the-art in nanofabrication tailored for both new researchers and seasoned experts in the field.

items.title_zh: 纳米光子学中的纳米制造技术进展
items.summary_zh: 纳米制造技术是纳米工程与高分辨率图案化交叉的重要技术，近年来取得了显著进展。该技术能够在基材上创建纳米图案，对于纳米光子学器件及电子、生物科学等多个领域的应用至关重要。本文综述了纳米制造的各个方面，重点关注其在纳米光子学中的应用，探讨了聚焦离子束（focused ion beam）和电子束光刻（electron beam lithography）等高分辨率技术、三维复杂结构制造方法、可扩展制造方案以及材料兼容性等问题。特别关注了新兴趋势，如利用双光子光刻（two-photon lithography）制造三维结构，以及相变材料和具有激子特性的二维材料等先进材料。通过强调这些进展，本文旨在提供对纳米制造持续演变的洞察，鼓励在功能纳米结构创建方面的进一步研究与应用。

items.title: Timing of Antiplatelet and Anticoagulant Therapy Resumption Following Gastrointestinal Bleeding: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.body: Background & aims Gastrointestinal bleeding is a major complication in patients receiving antithrombotic therapy. Following gastrointestinal bleeding, clinicians face a critical dilemma: resuming therapy risks rebleeding, whereas discontinuation increases thrombotic events and mortality. This meta-analysis aimed to quantify the risks and benefits of antithrombotic therapy resumption vs discontinuation following gastrointestinal bleeding, and to evaluate the impact of resumption timing on recurrent gastrointestinal bleeding, major vascular events, and all-cause mortality. Methods We searched Embase, Scopus, PubMed, Web of Science, and Cochrane Library from inception to September 2025 for studies comparing antithrombotic therapy resumption vs delayed resumption or discontinuation after gastrointestinal bleeding. This review was registered with PROSPERO (CRD420251141360). Results Twenty-one studies were included. Antiplatelet therapy resumption reduced major vascular events (hazard ratio, 0.70; 95% confidence interval, 0.60-0.83; absolute risk difference, -3.6%) and mortality (hazard ratio, 0.44; 95% confidence interval, 0.26-0.76; absolute risk difference, -10.0%), but increased recurrent gastrointestinal bleeding (hazard ratio, 1.42; 95% confidence interval, 1.09-1.84; absolute risk difference, +2.2%). Similarly, anticoagulant therapy resumption reduced major vascular events (hazard ratio, 0.45; 95% confidence interval, 0.34-0.58; absolute risk difference, -7.0%) and mortality (hazard ratio, 0.53; 95% confidence interval, 0.43-0.65; absolute risk difference, -11.1%), but increased recurrent gastrointestinal bleeding (hazard ratio, 1.59; 95% confidence interval, 1.38-1.83; absolute risk difference, +2.6%). Notably, early resumption of both antiplatelet therapy and anticoagulant therapy within 7 days significantly reduced major vascular events (hazard ratio, 0.39; 95% confidence interval, 0.19-0.78; absolute risk difference, -11.4%) but increased recurrent gastrointestinal bleeding (hazard ratio, 1.49; 95% confidence interval, 1.18-1.89; absolute risk difference, +2.7%), with no significant difference in mortality (hazard ratio, 0.78; 95% confidence interval, 0.29-2.10; absolute risk difference, -4.7%). Conclusions Both antiplatelet therapy and anticoagulant therapy resumption after gastrointestinal bleeding provide substantial clinical benefits despite increased recurrent gastrointestinal bleeding risk. Early resumption (≤7 days) offers favorable benefit-risk balance.
items.journal: Clinical gastroenterology and hepatology : the official clinical practice journal of the American Gastroenterological Association
items.authors: Liu Y, Hu Y, Song S, Goh WWB, Tsoi KKF, Sung JJY.
items.title_zh: 抗血小板与抗凝治疗在胃肠出血后的恢复时机研究
items.summary_zh: 胃肠出血是接受抗血栓治疗患者的一大并发症。临床医生在出血后面临恢复治疗与停药的两难选择：恢复治疗可能导致再出血，而停药则增加血栓事件和死亡风险。本系统评价与荟萃分析旨在量化抗血栓治疗恢复与停药的风险与收益，并评估恢复时机对再发胃肠出血、重大血管事件及全因死亡率的影响。研究纳入21项相关研究，结果显示，恢复抗血小板治疗可降低重大血管事件（风险比0.70，95%置信区间0.60-0.83，绝对风险差-3.6%）和死亡率（风险比0.44，95%置信区间0.26-0.76，绝对风险差-10.0%），但增加再发胃肠出血（风险比1.42，95%置信区间1.09-1.84，绝对风险差+2.2%）。抗凝治疗的恢复效果类似。

items.title: A six-tiered framework for evaluating AI models from repeatability to replaceability.
items.body: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming biotechnology and medicine. But evaluating its safety, effectiveness, and generalizability is increasingly challenging, especially for complex generative models. Traditional evaluation metrics often fall short in high-stakes applications where reliability and adaptability are critical. We propose a six-tiered framework to guide AI evaluation across the dimensions of repeatability, reproducibility, robustness, rigidity, reusability, and replaceability. These tiers reflect increasing expectations, from basic consistency to deployment. Each is defined clearly, with actionable testing methodologies informed by literature. Designed for flexibility, the framework applies to both traditional and generative AI. Through case studies in diagnostics and medical large language models (LLM), we demonstrate its utility in fostering trustworthy, accountable, and effective AI for biomedicine, biotechnology, and beyond.
items.authors: Tian S, Lam AWY, Sung JJ, Goh WWB.
items.title_zh: 评估人工智能模型的六层框架
items.summary_zh: 人工智能（AI）正在迅速改变生物技术和医学，但评估其安全性、有效性和普适性变得越来越困难，尤其是对于复杂的生成模型。传统的评估指标在高风险应用中往往不足以满足对可靠性和适应性的要求。本文提出了一个六层框架，以指导AI在可重复性、可再现性、鲁棒性、刚性、可重用性和可替代性等维度的评估。这些层次反映了从基本一致性到部署的逐步期望。每一层都有明确的定义，并提供了基于文献的可操作测试方法。该框架灵活适用于传统AI和生成AI。通过在诊断和医学大语言模型（LLM）中的案例研究，展示了该框架在促进生物医学和生物技术中可信、负责任和有效的AI方面的实用性。

items.title: Gene editing technique CRISPR identifies dangerous breast cancer mutations
items.body: Mutations in BRCA genes are linked to the early onset of breast and ovarian cancers. But the effect of most mutations is unclear. Now new research can distinguish harmless from dangerous mutations.
items.authors: Jay Shendure
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/jay-shendure-553297（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 基因编辑技术CRISPR识别危险乳腺癌突变
items.summary_zh: BRCA基因突变与乳腺癌和卵巢癌的早发有关，但大多数突变的影响尚不明确。最新研究利用基因编辑技术CRISPR，能够区分无害突变与危险突变。这项研究为理解BRCA基因突变的不同影响提供了新的视角，可能为乳腺癌的早期筛查和个性化治疗提供重要依据。

items.title: Navigating the next frontier in biomedicine: breakthroughs and insights in nucleic acid therapeutics.
items.body: Nucleic acid therapeutics are rapidly emerging as a transformative drug paradigm, offering precise and programmable regulation of gene expression across a broad spectrum of diseases. This review summarizes recent advances in key platforms-including antisense oligonucleotides, siRNA, miRNA, mRNA, and aptamers-emphasizing their unique mechanisms of action and therapeutic potential. We systematically outline critical contributions of chemical modification and delivery engineering, including backbone and sugar modifications, site-specific design, N -acetylgalactosamine (GalNAc) conjugation, and lipid nanoparticles, which collectively enhance stability, target specificity, and clinical applicability.
