Finally, we discuss persistent challenges such as immune activation, large-scale manufacturing, and long-term safety, and provide perspectives on future directions involving CRISPR-based gene editing, synthetic biology, nanotechnology, smart delivery systems, and combination therapies, aiming to offer strategic insights for the development and clinical translation of nucleic acid drugs.
items.authors: Wu S, Zhang Z, Zhao Z, Cui C, Tan W.
items.title_zh: 生物医学新前沿：核酸治疗的突破与见解
items.summary_zh: 核酸治疗作为一种变革性的药物范式，正在迅速崛起，能够在广泛疾病中实现基因表达的精确和可编程调控。本文综述了抗病毒寡核苷酸（antisense oligonucleotides）、小干扰RNA（siRNA）、微RNA（miRNA）、信使RNA（mRNA）和适配体（aptamers）等关键平台的最新进展，强调其独特的作用机制和治疗潜力。我们系统性地概述了化学修饰和递送工程的关键贡献，包括骨架和糖的修饰、特定位点设计、N-乙酰半乳糖胺（GalNAc）结合以及脂质纳米颗粒，这些因素共同增强了稳定性、靶向特异性和临床适用性。最后，我们讨论了免疫激活、大规模生产和长期安全性等持续挑战，并展望了未来的发展方向，包括基于CRISPR的基因编辑、合成生物学、纳米技术、智能递送系统和组合疗法，为核酸药物的开发和临床转化提供战略见解。

items.title: Single-Atom Enzymes: From Evolutionary Insights, Precision Engineering to Breakthroughs in Biomedical Applications.
items.body: Single-atom enzymes (SAEs), integrating the catalytic efficiency of single-atom catalysts with enzymatic functions, represent a paradigm shift in biomedicine. Comprising natural enzymes, mimic enzymes, and single-atom nanozymes, SAEs leverage isolated metal atoms as catalytic centers. Natural enzymes, evolved over billions of years, feature monoatomic active sites for precise biocatalysis under physiological conditions. Mimic enzymes (e.g., DNAzymes) represent a biomimetic adaptation, replicating natural active sites via programmable molecular scaffolds to enhance stability while inheriting an evolutionary bias that prioritizes structural robustness over catalytic diversity, limiting multifunctionality. In contrast, nanozymes embody an evolutionary leap: they sacrifice partial biocompatibility to achieve multienzyme-mimicking capabilities and scalable production through inorganic nanomaterial engineering, thereby expanding the catalytic landscape beyond biological boundaries, though this advancement introduces concomitant immunogenicity challenges. This review systematically examines cutting-edge advances in SAE applications across biomedical domains including biosensing, oncotherapy, antimicrobial strategies, and oxidative stress management. This review particularly presents a critical analysis of current challenges and emerging opportunities, proposing rational design principles for next-generation SAEs with enhanced multifunctionality. By elucidating fundamental design strategies and translational potential, this work aims to accelerate the development of precision catalytic platforms for modern biomedicine.
items.authors: Xu Y, Dong C, Liu X, Wei D, Chen Z, Zhou H, Li JB, Yang Y, Tan W.
items.title_zh: 单原子酶：从进化洞察到生物医学应用的突破
items.summary_zh: 单原子酶（Single-Atom Enzymes, SAEs）将单原子催化剂的催化效率与酶的功能相结合，标志着生物医学领域的范式转变。SAEs包括天然酶、仿生酶和单原子纳米酶，利用孤立的金属原子作为催化中心。天然酶经过数十亿年的进化，具有单原子活性位点，能够在生理条件下进行精确的生物催化。仿生酶（如DNA酶）通过可编程分子支架复制天然活性位点，增强稳定性，但在催化多样性上存在局限。相比之下，纳米酶则通过无机纳米材料工程实现多酶仿生能力和可扩展生产，尽管这带来了免疫原性挑战。本文系统评述了SAE在生物医学领域的前沿应用，包括生物传感、肿瘤治疗、抗微生物策略和氧化应激管理，分析了当前面临的挑战和新兴机遇，并提出了合理的设计原则。

items.title: Gut dysbiosis in oncology: a risk factor for immunoresistance.
items.body: The gut microbiome is recognized as a determinant of response to immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) therapies in cancer. However, the clinical translation of microbiome science has been hampered by inconsistent definitions of dysbiosis, inadequate biomarker frameworks, and limited mechanistic understanding. In this review, we synthesize the current state of knowledge on how gut microbial composition and function influence ICI efficacy, highlighting both correlative and causal evidence. We discuss computational approaches based on α-diversity or taxonomic abundance and argue for more functionally and clinically informative models, such as the topological score (TOPOSCORE) and other dysbiosis indices derived from machine learning. Using retrospective analyses of metagenomic datasets from thousands of patients and healthy controls, we examine microbial patterns that distinguish responders from non-responders. We also explore how dysbiosis perturbs immunoregulatory pathways, including bile acid metabolism, gut permeability, and mucosal immunomodulation. Finally, we assess emerging therapeutic strategies aimed at correcting microbiome dysfunction - including dietary modification, bacterial consortia, and fecal microbiota transplantation - and describe how they are being deployed in multiple clinical trials. We conclude with a brief discussion of the ONCOBIOME initiative, which works with international partners to incorporate microbiome science into oncology workflows. By refining our understanding of gut-immune interactions and translating it into action, microbiome-informed oncology may unlock new therapeutic potential for patients previously resistant to immunotherapy.
items.authors: Almonte AA, Thomas S, Iebba V, Kroemer G, Derosa L, Zitvogel L.
items.title_zh: 肠道微生物失调与肿瘤免疫耐受的风险关系
items.summary_zh: 肠道微生物组被认为是癌症免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）疗法反应的决定因素。然而，微生物组科学的临床转化受到失调（dysbiosis）定义不一致、缺乏生物标志物框架和机制理解有限的阻碍。本文综述了肠道微生物组成和功能如何影响ICI疗效的现状，强调了相关性和因果证据。我们讨论了基于α多样性或分类丰度的计算方法，并主张采用更具功能性和临床信息的模型，如拓扑评分（TOPOSCORE）和其他基于机器学习的失调指数。通过对数千名患者和健康对照的宏基因组数据集进行回顾性分析，我们考察了区分应答者与非应答者的微生物模式。同时，我们探讨了失调如何扰乱免疫调节通路，包括胆汁酸代谢、肠道通透性和粘膜免疫调节。最后，我们评估了旨在纠正微生物组功能障碍的新兴治疗策略，包括饮食调整、细菌群落和粪便微生物移植，并描述了它们在多个临床试验中的应用。

items.title: Quantum information meets high-energy physics: input to the update of the European strategy for particle physics.
items.body: Some of the most astonishing and prominent properties of Quantum Mechanics, such as entanglement and Bell nonlocality, have only been studied extensively in dedicated low-energy laboratory setups. The feasibility of these studies in the high-energy regime explored by particle colliders was only recently shown and has gathered the attention of the scientific community. For the range of particles and fundamental interactions involved, particle colliders provide a novel environment where quantum information theory can be probed, with energies exceeding by about 12 orders of magnitude those employed in dedicated laboratory setups. Furthermore, collider detectors have inherent advantages in performing certain quantum information measurements and allow for the reconstruction of the state of the system under consideration via quantum state tomography. Here, we elaborate on the potential, challenges, and goals of this innovative and rapidly evolving line of research and discuss its expected impact on both quantum information theory and high-energy physics.
items.authors: Afik Y, Fabbri F, Low M, Marzola L, Aguilar-Saavedra JA, Altakach MM, Asbah NA, Bai Y, Banks H, Barr AJ, Bernal A, Browder TE, Caban P, Casas JA, Cheng K, Déliot F, Demina R, Di Domenico A, Eckstein M, Fabbrichesi M, Fuk
items.attribution_note: 作者串被截断，ORCID 命中即采信
items.title_zh: 量子信息与高能物理的交汇：欧洲粒子物理战略更新的建议
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了量子力学的一些显著特性，如纠缠和贝尔非局域性，主要在低能实验室环境中得到广泛研究。最近，粒子对撞机高能领域的研究显示了这些特性的可行性，吸引了科学界的关注。粒子对撞机提供了一种新颖的环境，能够探测量子信息理论，其能量比专门实验室设置高出约12个数量级。此外，对撞机探测器在执行某些量子信息测量方面具有固有优势，并允许通过量子态层析（quantum state tomography）重构系统状态。本文详细阐述了这一快速发展的研究方向的潜力、挑战和目标，并讨论其对量子信息理论和高能物理的预期影响。

items.title: The multi-kingdom cancer microbiome.
items.body: Microbial influence on cancer development and therapeutic response is a growing area of cancer research. Although it is known that microorganisms can colonize certain tissues and contribute to tumour initiation, the use of deep sequencing technologies and computational pipelines has led to reports of multi-kingdom microbial communities in a growing list of cancer types. This has prompted discussions on the role and scope of microbial presence in cancer, while raising the possibility of microbiome-based diagnostic, prognostic and therapeutic tools. However, additional investigation and thorough validation of cancer microbiome findings are required before this translational potential can be realized. Here we provide historical context and a conceptual framework for the so-called cancer microbiome and summarize experimental studies into tumour-associated bacteria, fungi and other microorganisms. We also discuss the current evidence for microbial colonization of tumours and their varied influence on the disease, including recent debates. Finally, we consider outstanding questions and discuss our outlook for the field.
items.authors: Dohlman AB, Pan X, Zitvogel L, Iliev ID.
items.title_zh: 多王国癌症微生物组的研究进展
items.summary_zh: 微生物对癌症发展和治疗反应的影响正成为癌症研究的一个重要领域。尽管已知微生物能够定殖某些组织并促进肿瘤的形成，但深度测序技术和计算管道的应用使得多种微生物群落在越来越多的癌症类型中被发现。这引发了关于微生物在癌症中的角色和范围的讨论，并提出了基于微生物组的诊断、预后和治疗工具的可能性。然而，在实现这一转化潜力之前，需要对癌症微生物组的发现进行进一步研究和严格验证。本文提供了癌症微生物组的历史背景和概念框架，并总结了与肿瘤相关的细菌、真菌及其他微生物的实验研究。我们还讨论了微生物对肿瘤的定殖及其对疾病的多样影响，包括近期的争论。最后，我们考虑了尚待解决的问题，并展望该领域的未来。

items.title: Microbiota-centered interventions to boost immune checkpoint blockade therapies.
items.body: Immune checkpoint blockade therapies have markedly advanced cancer treatment by invigorating antitumor immunity and extending patient survival. However, therapeutic resistance and immune-related toxicities remain major concerns. Emerging evidence indicates that microbial dysbiosis diminishes therapeutic response rates, while a diverse gut ecology and key beneficial taxa correlate with improved treatment outcomes. Therefore, there is a growing understanding that manipulating the gut microbiota could boost therapy efficacy. This review examines burgeoning methods that target the gut microbiome to optimize therapy and innovative diagnostic tools to detect dysbiosis, and highlights challenges that remain to be addressed in the field.
items.authors: Almonte AA, Thomas S, Zitvogel L.
items.title_zh: 微生物组干预提升免疫检查点抑制疗法效果
items.summary_zh: 免疫检查点抑制疗法通过增强抗肿瘤免疫力显著改善了癌症治疗效果并延长了患者生存期。然而，治疗抵抗和免疫相关毒性仍然是主要问题。新兴证据表明，微生物失调（dysbiosis）会降低治疗反应率，而多样化的肠道生态和关键有益菌群与改善的治疗结果相关。因此，调节肠道微生物组可能提高疗效。本文回顾了针对肠道微生物组的最新干预方法，以优化治疗效果，并探讨了检测微生物失调的创新诊断工具，同时强调了该领域仍需解决的挑战。

items.title: Causal machine learning for single-cell genomics.
items.body: Advances in single-cell '-omics' allow unprecedented insights into the transcriptional profiles of individual cells and, when combined with large-scale perturbation screens, enable measuring of the effect of targeted perturbations on the whole transcriptome. These advances provide an opportunity to better understand the causative role of genes in complex biological processes. In this Perspective, we delineate the application of causal machine learning to single-cell genomics and its associated challenges. We first present the causal model that is most commonly applied to single-cell biology and then identify and discuss potential approaches to three open problems: the lack of generalization of models to novel experimental conditions, the complexity of interpreting learned models, and the difficulty of learning cell dynamics.
items.authors: Tejada-Lapuerta A, Bertin P, Bauer S, Aliee H, Bengio Y, Theis FJ.
items.title_zh: 因果机器学习在单细胞基因组学中的应用
items.summary_zh: 单细胞“组学”的进展为个体细胞的转录谱提供了前所未有的洞察，并结合大规模干扰筛选，使得能够测量针对性干扰对整个转录组的影响。这些进展为更好地理解基因在复杂生物过程中的因果作用提供了机会。本文探讨了因果机器学习在单细胞基因组学中的应用及其相关挑战。首先介绍了最常用于单细胞生物学的因果模型，然后识别并讨论了三个未解决问题的潜在解决方案：模型在新实验条件下缺乏泛化能力、学习模型的复杂性以及学习细胞动态的困难。

items.title: Reaction development: a student's checklist.
items.body: So you've discovered a reaction. But how do you turn this new discovery into a fully-fledged program that maximises the potential of your novel transformation? Herein, we provide a student's checklist to serve as a helpful guide for synthesis development, allowing you to thoroughly investigate the chemistry in question while ensuring that no key aspect of the project is overlooked. A wide variety of the most illuminating synthetic and spectroscopic techniques will be summarised, in conjunction with literature examples and our own insights, to provide sound justifications for their implementation towards the goal of developing new reactions.
items.authors: Tyler JL, Trauner D, Glorius F.
items.title_zh: 反应开发：学生检查清单
items.summary_zh: 本文提供了一份学生检查清单，旨在帮助学生将新发现的反应转化为全面的合成开发程序，以最大化其潜力。清单将指导学生深入研究相关化学，确保项目的关键方面不被忽视。文章总结了多种重要的合成和光谱技术，并结合文献实例和作者的见解，为这些技术的实施提供合理的依据，以实现新反应的开发目标。

items.title: L’IA pour le meilleur, sans le pire
items.body: L'IA se fonde sur des données produites par notre société, agie par les discriminations. Si on n’y prend garde, elle pourrait les perpétuer ou même les augmenter. Mais le pire n'est pas sûr.
items.authors: Yoshua Bengio
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/yoshua-bengio-601743（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 人工智能的机遇与挑战
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了人工智能（IA）在社会中应用时可能面临的歧视问题。作者指出，人工智能依赖于由社会产生的数据，这些数据可能受到歧视的影响。如果不加以注意，人工智能可能会延续甚至加剧这些歧视现象。然而，作者也认为，最坏的结果并非必然发生。通过对这一问题的分析，文章强调了在开发和应用人工智能时，需谨慎对待数据的来源和使用，以避免潜在的负面影响。

items.title: The Montréal Declaration: Why we must develop AI responsibly
items.body: The Montréal Declaration calls for the responsible development of artificial intelligence. A world expert explains why scientists must choose how their expertise will benefit society.
items.authors: Yoshua Bengio
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/yoshua-bengio-601743（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 蒙特利尔宣言：为何我们必须负责任地发展人工智能
items.summary_zh: 蒙特利尔宣言呼吁负责任地发展人工智能（AI）。世界专家指出，科学家必须选择如何利用他们的专业知识来造福社会。文章强调，科学家在AI发展中扮演着重要角色，需考虑其技术对社会的影响，确保其应用符合伦理标准和社会需求。通过负责任的开发，科学家能够促进技术的积极应用，避免潜在的负面后果，最终实现技术与社会的和谐发展。

items.title: L’IA pour le meilleur, sans le pire
items.body: À mesure que l’IA se déploie dans la société, il y a un impact, qui peut être positif ou négatif. À nous de choisir comment les choses se feront. Le futur est entre nos mains.
items.authors: Yoshua Bengio
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/yoshua-bengio-601743（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 人工智能的未来：机遇与挑战并存
items.summary_zh: 随着人工智能（AI）在社会中的广泛应用，其影响力日益显著，既可能带来积极效果，也可能引发负面后果。文章强调，未来的发展方向掌握在我们手中，呼吁社会各界共同选择如何利用和管理AI技术，以确保其为人类带来更多的益处而非危害。

items.title: Our experiments taught us why people troll
items.body: You might think that trolling on the internet is done by a small, vocal minority of sociopaths. But what if all trolls aren’t born trolls? What if they are ordinary people like you and me?
items.authors: Jure Leskovec
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/jure-leskovec-337634（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 我们的实验揭示了人们为何进行网络恶搞
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了网络恶搞（trolling）现象，提出并非所有恶搞者都是天生的反社会人格者，而是普通人。通过实验，研究者发现恶搞行为可能源于社会互动中的某些因素，而非个体的性格缺陷。这一观点挑战了传统对恶搞者的刻板印象，提示我们在理解网络行为时应考虑更复杂的社会心理因素。

items.title: People with disability are dying from cancers we can actually prevent, our study shows
items.body: People with disability are more likely to die from cancer than the overall population. Here’s how we can shift this striking inequity.
items.authors: Yi Yang
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/yi-yang-2270524（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 残疾人因可预防癌症而死亡的现象亟需关注
items.summary_zh: 研究表明，残疾人群体死于癌症的风险高于整体人口。这一现象揭示了健康不平等的问题，尤其是在癌症预防和治疗方面。通过改善医疗资源的可及性、加强早期筛查和提供针对性的健康教育，可以有效降低残疾人群体的癌症死亡率。研究强调，采取积极措施以消除这一不平等现象是当务之急。

items.title: NDIS reforms aim to make the scheme fairer. But we’ve found the groups struggling to gain access
items.body: Factors like age, gender and where you live can make it more likely an applicant will be rejected.
items.authors: Yi Yang
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/yi-yang-2270524（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: NDIS改革旨在提升公平性，但部分群体仍难以获得支持
items.summary_zh: 本文评述了澳大利亚国家残疾保险计划（NDIS）的改革措施，旨在提高该计划的公平性。然而，研究发现，申请者的年龄、性别及居住地等因素可能导致其被拒绝的可能性增加。这表明，尽管政策上有意改善公平性，但在实际操作中，某些群体仍面临较大挑战，难以顺利获得所需的支持和服务。

items.title: Australians with disability are 4 times more likely to die early – often not due to their disability
items.body: People with disability die of conditions such as cancer, heart disease and diabetes at a much higher rate than the rest of the population.
items.authors: Yi Yang
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/yi-yang-2270524（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 残疾澳大利人早逝风险是普通人四倍
items.summary_zh: 研究显示，残疾人士因癌症、心脏病和糖尿病等疾病的死亡率远高于普通人群。尽管残疾本身并不是导致早逝的主要原因，但这些健康问题显著影响了他们的生存期。这一现象强调了需要关注残疾人士的整体健康状况，而不仅仅是他们的残疾。通过改善医疗服务和健康管理，可以有效降低这一群体的早逝风险。

items.title: Scalable photonic quantum technologies.
items.body: Photonic quantum technologies are now progressing from demonstrations of fundamental phenomena to systems of sufficient scale and quality to enable practical applications with quantum advantage in communications, computation and metrology. Here we review recent advances in quantum optics that have led to the emergence of such scalable quantum technologies, and outline the road ahead to more general applications with greater potential impact. We first focus on the components that support various photonic quantum applications, including quantum light sources, linear-optical networks and detectors. We go on to discuss recent experimental demonstrations of quantum communication, quantum computation and simulation, and quantum metrology using photons. Finally, an overview is provided on the manner in which photons fit within both the opportunities and challenges of implementing space-to-ground quantum internet, universal quantum computing and quantum precision measurement.
items.authors: Wang H, Ralph TC, Renema JJ, Lu CY, Pan JW.
items.title_zh: 可扩展的光子量子技术进展
items.summary_zh: 光子量子技术正从基础现象的演示向足够规模和质量的系统发展，以实现量子通信、计算和计量中的实际应用优势。本文回顾了量子光学的最新进展，这些进展促成了可扩展量子技术的出现，并概述了未来更广泛应用的前景。我们首先关注支持各种光子量子应用的组件，包括量子光源、线性光学网络和探测器。接着讨论了利用光子进行量子通信、量子计算与模拟以及量子计量的最新实验演示。最后，概述了光子在实施地面与太空量子互联网、通用量子计算和量子精密测量中的机遇与挑战。

items.title: Nanotechnology for CAR T cells and tumour-infiltrating lymphocyte therapies.
items.body: Adoptive T-cell therapies, and particularly CAR T cells and tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes, have transformed cancer treatment by selectively targeting malignant cells. Despite their clinical success, these therapies face substantial challenges, including costly manufacturing processes and tumour-imposed barriers that limit efficacy. Advances in understanding the nanoscale mechanisms governing T-cell activation and the role of the tumour microenvironment in restricting T-cell responses have driven the development of nanotechnology-based strategies that integrate key chemical and physical cues. Here we provide a brief overview of the current state of CAR T and tumour-infiltrating lymphocyte therapies and discuss nanotechnology strategies to enhance their ex vivo production, in vivo performance and the direct in vivo generation of CAR T cells. We highlight nanotechnology's transformative potential to overcome existing challenges, broaden therapeutic applications and identify factors that will shape the future of nanotechnology for CAR T and tumour-infiltrating lymphocyte therapies.
items.authors: Lafuente-Gómez N, Kang S, Mooney DJ.
items.title_zh: 纳米技术在CAR T细胞和肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞疗法中的应用
items.summary_zh: 采用性T细胞疗法，特别是CAR T细胞和肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞，已通过选择性靶向恶性细胞改变了癌症治疗。尽管这些疗法在临床上取得了成功，但仍面临制造成本高和肿瘤相关障碍等重大挑战。对T细胞激活的纳米尺度机制及肿瘤微环境对T细胞反应限制作用的理解进展，推动了基于纳米技术的策略发展，这些策略整合了关键的化学和物理信号。本文简要概述了CAR T细胞和肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞疗法的现状，并讨论了纳米技术在提高其体外生产、体内表现及直接体内生成CAR T细胞方面的策略。我们强调了纳米技术在克服现有挑战、拓宽治疗应用及识别未来CAR T细胞和肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞疗法发展方向的潜力。

items.title: Systematic attribution of heatwaves to the emissions of carbon majors.
items.body: Extreme event attribution assesses how climate change affected climate extremes, but typically focuses on single events 1-4 . Furthermore, these attributions rarely quantify the extent to which anthropogenic actors have contributed to these events 5,6 . Here we show that climate change made 213 historical heatwaves reported over 2000-2023 more likely and more intense, to which each of the 180 carbon majors (fossil fuel and cement producers) substantially contributed. This work relies on the expansion of a well-established event-based framework 1 . Owing to global warming since 1850-1900, the median of the heatwaves during 2000-2009 became about 20 times more likely, and about 200 times more likely during 2010-2019. Overall, one-quarter of these events were virtually impossible without climate change. The emissions of the carbon majors contribute to half the increase in heatwave intensity since 1850-1900. Depending on the carbon major, their individual contribution is high enough to enable the occurrence of 16-53 heatwaves that would have been virtually impossible in a preindustrial climate. We, therefore, establish that the influence of climate change on heatwaves has increased, and that all carbon majors, even the smaller ones, contributed substantially to the occurrence of heatwaves. Our results contribute to filling the evidentiary gap to establish accountability of historical climate extremes 7,8 .
items.authors: Quilcaille Y, Gudmundsson L, Schumacher DL, Gasser T, Heede R, Heri C, Lejeune Q, Nath S, Naveau P, Thiery W, Schleussner CF, Seneviratne SI.
items.title_zh: 系统归因于碳排放大户的热浪事件
items.summary_zh: 极端事件归因评估气候变化对气候极端事件的影响，但通常只关注单一事件。本文展示了气候变化使2000-2023年间报告的213个历史热浪事件更为频繁和强烈，180个碳排放大户（化石燃料和水泥生产商）对此有显著贡献。研究表明，自1850-1900年以来，2000-2009年间热浪的发生概率增加了约20倍，而2010-2019年间则增加了约200倍。总体而言，四分之一的热浪事件在没有气候变化的情况下几乎不可能发生。碳排放大户的排放量导致自1850-1900年以来热浪强度增加的一半。根据不同的碳排放大户，其个体贡献足以使16-53个热浪事件在前工业气候中几乎不可能发生。因此，气候变化对热浪的影响已显著增加，所有碳排放大户，包括较小的企业，均对热浪的发生做出了重要贡献。

items.title: Advancing Metal-Organic Framework-Based Composites for Effective Chemical Warfare Agent Detoxification under Real-World Conditions.
items.body: Threats from toxic chemical warfare agents (CWAs) persist due to war and terrorist attacks, endangering both human beings and the environment. Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), which feature ordered pore structures and excellent tunability at both metal/metal cluster nodes and organic linkers, are regarded as the best candidates to directly remove CWAs and their simulants via both physical adsorption and chemically catalyzed hydrolysis or oxidization. MOFs have attracted significant attention in the last two decades that has resulted from the rapid development of MOF-based materials in both fundamental research and real-world applications. In this review, the authors focus on the recent advancements in designing and constructing functional MOF-based materials toward CWAs detoxification and discuss how to bridge the gap between fundamental science and real-world applications. With detailed summaries from different points of view, this review provides insights into design rules for developing next-generation MOF-based materials for protection from both organophosphorus and organosulfur CWAs to mitigate potential threats from CWAs used in wars and terrorism attacks.
items.authors: Cheng Z, Fahy KM, Peterson GW, Kirlikovali KO, Farha OK.
items.title_zh: 基于金属有机框架的复合材料在化学战剂解毒中的应用进展
items.summary_zh: 随着战争和恐怖袭击的持续，毒性化学战剂（CWAs）对人类和环境的威胁依然存在。金属有机框架（MOFs）因其有序的孔结构和在金属/金属簇节点及有机连接体上的优良可调性，被视为直接去除CWAs及其模拟物的最佳候选材料，能够通过物理吸附和化学催化水解或氧化实现解毒。过去二十年，MOFs在基础研究和实际应用中的快速发展引起了广泛关注。本文评述了在CWAs解毒方面设计和构建功能性MOF材料的最新进展，并探讨了基础科学与实际应用之间的桥梁。通过不同视角的详细总结，本文为开发下一代MOF材料提供了设计规则，以应对有机磷和有机硫类CWAs，减轻战争和恐怖袭击中CWAs带来的潜在威胁。

items.title: Rule-breaking in chemical synthesis.
items.body: Challenging century-old rules of structure, bonding, and reactivity enables the discovery of new synthetic chemistry involving amides and anti-Bredt olefins.
items.authors: Gonzalez JAM, Miseo GA, Houk KN, Garg NK.
items.title_zh: 打破化学合成中的规则
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了在化学合成中挑战百年传统的结构、键合和反应性规则的重要性，特别是在酰胺（amides）和反-Bredt烯烃（anti-Bredt olefins）的合成中。通过对这些新合成化学的研究，科学家们发现了新的反应途径和机制，这些发现不仅推动了化学合成的进步，也为相关领域的研究提供了新的视角和方法。文章强调，打破传统规则的勇气和创新思维是推动科学进步的关键。

items.title: Progress, challenges, and opportunities in the field of biosynthetic reactions involving ambimodal transition states.
items.body: Covering: up to June 2025High selectivity is generally observed in the biosynthesis of complex natural molecules. Evolution usually leads to enzymes that favor the formation of a particular isomer rather than one of the many other potential molecules. Recent discoveries of enzymes with multiple sequential post-transition state bifurcations (PTSB) after ambimodal transition states demonstrate the impact of dynamics on selectivity. PTSB cause a single ambimodal transition state (TS) to form multiple products. This is different from conventional energetically-controlled mechanisms, where two discrete transition states have different energy barriers. Selectivity arising from ambimodal TSs cannot be fully explained by transition state theory. The presence of PTSB on enzyme catalyzed reaction surfaces has been discovered recently at a significantly higher rate. For both uncatalyzed and catalyzed reactions, computational chemists are devising techniques to comprehend which elements of molecular structure and vibrations govern the product selectivity in systems that contain bifurcations. This review describes enzyme-catalyzed reactions involving ambimodal transition states, and recent advances in understanding how enzymes control selectivity in such reactions.
items.authors: Hussain H, Houk KN, Lam CC, Sarker SD, Nahar L.
items.title_zh: 生物合成反应中双模态过渡态的进展与挑战
items.summary_zh: 本文评述了涉及双模态过渡态（ambimodal transition states）的酶催化反应，强调了高选择性在复杂天然分子生物合成中的重要性。进化通常导致酶偏向于形成特定异构体，而非众多其他潜在分子。近期发现的多重顺序过渡态分叉（post-transition state bifurcations, PTSB）现象表明，动态因素对选择性的影响。PTSB使得单一的双模态过渡态能够生成多种产物，这与传统的能量控制机制不同。双模态过渡态的选择性无法完全用过渡态理论解释。计算化学家正在开发技术，以理解分子结构和振动中哪些元素主导包含分叉的系统中的产物选择性。本文总结了酶催化反应的最新进展，探讨了酶如何控制这些反应中的选择性。

items.title: Insights into the surface chemistry of N-heterocyclic carbenes.
items.body: N-heterocyclic carbenes (NHCs) have emerged as a versatile and powerful class of ligands in surface chemistry, offering remarkable stability and tunability when bound to surfaces, including metals, metal oxides, and semiconductors. Understanding their surface and interfacial mechanisms at the atomic-level is essential for precise control of molecule-surface interaction, as well as intermolecular interactions, which directly influence material performance and functionalities. Research in surface chemistry focusing on molecular binding modes, self-assembly, on-surface reactions, and electronic properties is crucial for the rational design of efficient catalysts, customized materials, and high-performance devices. This review highlights these critical aspects of NHCs on surfaces, beginning with their robust and multiple binding modes, which underpin their stability and versatility. The covalent NHC-surface bonds allow NHCs to form stable attachments, often surpassing the strength of traditional thiol-based modifiers, promoting robust anchoring across diverse materials. Another focus is the self-assembly of NHCs into highly ordered monolayers, which facilitates the design of functional nanostructures. Emerging topics also include on-surface reactions, surface electronic properties, and interfacial charge transfer of NHCs, emphasizing their dependence on the substrate and NHC molecular structure. By consolidating recent advancements in the study of NHCs on surfaces, we aim to provide a comprehensive overview of their transformative potential in surface chemistry at the atomic scale, while also identifying key challenges and future directions in the field.
items.authors: Pan Y, Das A, Glorius F, Ren J.
items.title_zh: N-杂环卡宾表面化学的深入见解
items.summary_zh: N-杂环卡宾（NHCs）作为一种多功能且强大的配体，在表面化学中展现出卓越的稳定性和可调性，能够与金属、金属氧化物和半导体等表面结合。理解其原子级的表面和界面机制对于精确控制分子-表面相互作用及分子间相互作用至关重要，这直接影响材料的性能和功能。本文回顾了NHCs在表面上的关键特性，首先探讨了其强大且多样的结合模式，这些模式支撑了其稳定性和多功能性。共价的NHC-表面键合使NHCs能够形成稳定的附着，通常超过传统硫醇基修饰剂的强度，从而在多种材料中促进稳固的锚定。此外，NHCs自组装成高度有序的单层结构，有助于功能纳米结构的设计。新兴主题还包括NHCs的表面反应、表面电子特性及界面电荷转移，强调其对基底和NHC分子的依赖性。

items.title: Exploring guest species in zeolites using transmission electron microscopy: a review and outlook.
items.body: Zeolites, with their well-defined microporous frameworks, accommodate diverse guest species, including metal ions, atoms, clusters, complexes, and organic molecules. Direct imaging of these species and their interactions with the framework is crucial for understanding their structural and functional roles. Transmission electron microscopy (TEM), particularly aberration-corrected scanning TEM (STEM), has become an indispensable tool, offering atomic-resolution real-space insights. This review summarizes key (S)TEM techniques for probing guest species in zeolites, with a focus on low-dose strategies to minimize beam damage. We discuss the principles, applications, and limitations of various imaging modalities and highlight recent advances in visualizing metallic and organic species. Finally, we explore future directions for (S)TEM in zeolite research, emphasizing the opportunities and challenges of in situ , three-dimensional, and cryogenic imaging for resolving host-guest interactions with greater precision.
items.authors: Yu Z, Lin H, Zhang H, Han Y.
items.title_zh: 透射电子显微镜研究沸石中的客体物种：综述与展望
items.summary_zh: 沸石因其明确的微孔框架，能够容纳多种客体物种，包括金属离子、原子、簇、配合物和有机分子。直接成像这些物种及其与框架的相互作用对于理解其结构和功能至关重要。透射电子显微镜（TEM），尤其是像差校正扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM），已成为不可或缺的工具，提供原子分辨率的实空间洞察。本文综述了探测沸石中客体物种的关键（S）TEM技术，重点介绍了低剂量策略以最小化束损伤。我们讨论了各种成像模式的原理、应用和局限性，并强调了在可视化金属和有机物种方面的最新进展。最后，我们探讨了（S）TEM在沸石研究中的未来方向，强调了原位、三维和低温成像在更精确解析宿主-客体相互作用中的机遇与挑战。

items.title: Ferroptosis for food safety: An innovative and sustainable strategy in pathogenic bacteria inactivation and antimicrobial resistance modulation.
items.body: Microbial contamination in food has long posed a significant global public health challenge. The growing antibiotic resistance of foodborne pathogens, particularly multidrug-resistant bacteria, has diminished the effectiveness of traditional antibiotic treatments and increased the public health burden. There is an urgent need for innovative strategies to control foodborne pathogenic bacteria and their resistance. Since the discovery of ferroptosis, a regulatory modality of cell death, researchers have advanced our understanding of its mechanisms. While ferroptosis is primarily observed in eukaryotic cells, some studies indicate that microbial cells also undergo a similar process. This ferroptosis-like death depends on the Fenton reaction and is triggered by iron overload, leading to excessive reactive oxygen species (ROS) and lipid peroxidation. However, current knowledge on ferroptosis-mediated control of foodborne pathogenic bacteria and antimicrobial resistance remains limited. Ferroptosis is primarily triggered by excess intracellular ferrous ions (Fe 2+ ) and disruptions in antioxidant systems. Several studies have utilized this feature to design antimicrobial experiments, which have been successfully applied to antimicrobial infection treatment. Additionally, ferroptosis affects antibiotic-resistant bacteria mainly by inducing direct lethal effects through iron-dependent lipid peroxidation, and disrupting iron homeostasis, which bypasses traditional resistance mechanisms and enhances antibiotic efficacy. This review aims to summarize the concepts, mechanisms, and regulatory measures of ferroptosis while discussing its application in controlling pathogenic bacteria. Further insights into the specific molecular mechanisms of ferroptosis in foodborne pathogenic bacteria are essential to enhance inactivation precision and modulate antimicrobial resistance, thereby facilitating its practical application in food safety.
items.authors: Zhou X, Cheng JH, Yang X, Sun DW.
items.title_zh: 铁死亡在食品安全中的应用：抗病菌灭活与抗药性调控的新策略
items.summary_zh: 食品中的微生物污染长期以来对全球公共健康构成重大挑战，尤其是多重耐药的食源性病原体的抗生素耐药性日益增强，降低了传统抗生素治疗的有效性。针对食源性病原菌及其耐药性，迫切需要创新的控制策略。铁死亡（ferroptosis）作为一种细胞死亡的调控方式，近年来的研究揭示了其机制，尽管主要在真核细胞中观察到，但部分研究表明微生物细胞也可能经历类似过程。铁死亡依赖于芬顿反应，因铁过载引发过量的活性氧（ROS）和脂质过氧化。当前关于铁死亡介导的食源性病原菌控制及抗药性调控的知识仍然有限。铁死亡主要由细胞内过量的亚铁离子（Fe 2+）及抗氧化系统的破坏触发，已有研究利用这一特性设计抗微生物实验，并成功应用于抗感染治疗。

items.title: Why Is Clozapine Uniquely Effective in Treatment-Resistant Schizophrenia? A Review and Proposal.
items.body: A great deal is known about the use, benefits, and side effects of clozapine in treatment-resistant schizophrenia (TRS). However, why clozapine is more effective than other antipsychotics in TRS remains unclear. In this article, we address this question. Patients with TRS show glutamate abnormalities, and clozapine has widespread effects on glutamate. However, these actions have not been proven to be different from those of other antipsychotics. Immune dysfunction is also reported in TRS, and clozapine has anti-inflammatory actions, but these have not been correlated with clinical improvement. Currently, there is a great deal of interest in muscarinic abnormalities in psychosis. Unlike most antipsychotics, clozapine has important effects on muscarinic receptors, particularly M 1 and M 4 , and its major metabolite, N-desmethylclozapine, is a full agonist at M 1 . These effects are likely crucial to clozapine's effectiveness. In addition, clozapine's lower dopamine D 2 receptor occupancy has been postulated to allow gradual resolution of dopamine receptor supersensitivity in the minority of patients with TRS who initially respond to antipsychotics but become resistant following long-term dopamine blockade. However, this hypothesis remains controversial. Clozapine's multireceptor profile enables it to have beneficial actions on the nonpsychotic symptoms common in TRS; its ability to bind to histamine H 1 , serotonin 5-HT 1A , and GABA B (gamma-aminobutyric acid B) receptors offers an explanation for its anxiolytic actions, while effects on 5-HT 1A , 5-HT 2A , and 5-HT 7 receptors likely underlie its antidepressant properties. Clozapine shares these properties with olanzapine and quetiapine, but its affinity for muscarinic receptors may be the mechanism by which it is more effective in TRS.
items.authors: Murray RM, Egerton A, Gao Y, Grace AA, Howes O, Jauhar S, Leucht S, Chen EYH, MacCabe JH, McCutcheon RA, Natesan S, Taylor D.
items.title_zh: 氯氮平为何在难治性精神分裂症中独特有效？
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了氯氮平在难治性精神分裂症（TRS）中的独特疗效，尽管已知其使用、益处及副作用，但为何氯氮平比其他抗精神病药更有效仍不明确。TRS患者表现出谷氨酸异常，而氯氮平对谷氨酸有广泛影响，但这些作用与其他抗精神病药并无明显区别。此外，TRS中也报告了免疫功能障碍，氯氮平具有抗炎作用，但未与临床改善相关联。氯氮平对毒蕈碱受体（muscarinic receptors）有重要影响，尤其是M1和M4，其主要代谢物N-去甲氯氮平是M1的完全激动剂，这可能是其有效性的关键。此外，氯氮平较低的多巴胺D2受体占用率被认为有助于缓解部分患者的多巴胺受体超敏感性，但这一假设仍存在争议。氯氮平的多受体特性使其对TRS中常见的非精神症状产生有益作用。

items.title: Food Nanozymology: Nanozyme Engineering Toward Future Food.
items.body: Enzymes have historically served as critical biocatalysts in the food supply chain, yet their industrial applicability remains constrained by intrinsic limitations such as poor stability, low availability, and high production costs. Nanozymes, synthetic nanomaterials with enzyme-mimicking activities, offer a compelling alternative owing to their superior physicochemical properties and tunable functionalities. This review conceptualizes food nanozymology as a new interdisciplinary field that combines enzymological principles with nanotechnology to reimagine catalytic strategies in food systems. It provides a critical overview of current progress across multiple application fronts, including detection, detoxification, preservation, processing, food fortification and nutritional intervention, and resource recovery, etc. By framing food nanozymology as both a conceptual and technological shift, this work highlights its potential to catalyze innovation and improve the sustainability, efficiency, and resilience of the global food supply chain.
items.authors: Chi Y, Cheng H, Sun DW, Huang L, He Q, Shi B.
items.title_zh: 食品纳米酶学：未来食品的纳米酶工程
items.summary_zh: 酶在食品供应链中历来是重要的生物催化剂，但其工业应用受到稳定性差、可得性低和生产成本高等内在限制的制约。纳米酶（nanozyme）作为合成纳米材料，具备模拟酶的活性，因其优越的物理化学性质和可调功能而成为有力替代方案。本文将食品纳米酶学概念化为一个新兴的跨学科领域，结合酶学原理与纳米技术，重新构想食品系统中的催化策略。文章对当前在检测、解毒、保鲜、加工、食品强化与营养干预、资源回收等多个应用领域的进展进行了重要综述。通过将食品纳米酶学视为概念和技术的转变，强调其在推动创新、提升全球食品供应链的可持续性、效率和韧性方面的潜力。

items.title: Polymeric Sorbents as Energy-Efficient Alternative to Cryogenic Distillation for Light Hydrocarbon Purification.
items.body: Light hydrocarbons are essential gaseous compounds for fuel, polymer manufacturing, fertilizer production, and so forth. The efficient recovery and purification of these gases are still challenging despite their significant industrial and domestic relevance. They exist in the gaseous state under ambient temperature and pressure and are typically recovered from natural gas streams containing multiple close-boiling-point hydrocarbons. So far, cryogenic distillation is the commonly used method for their separation and purification. It operates based on their boiling-point differences, which amounts to significant energy consumption. To address this limitation, adsorption-based technology is considered an energy-efficient alternative for the purification of light hydrocarbons. To this effect, polymeric sorbents such as porous polymer networks (PPNs) are a potential alternative due to their robustness, stability, and scalability. This review provides an extensive discussion on cryogenic distillation, applications of light hydrocarbons, and progress in light hydrocarbon purification using polymeric sorbents. Additionally, the pore structure, stability, and techno-economic feasibility of the polymeric sorbents were extensively examined, covering current progress, mechanism of guest molecule separation, characterization techniques, and hurdles still encountered. Overall, since their application in light hydrocarbon separation is still an evolving field, this review will facilitate robust designs by providing the necessary know-how and roadmaps needed for advancement.
items.authors: Festus K, Mondal A, Mandal S, Aiya D Marquez J, Ghosh A, Sikdar A, Podder U, Sarkar A, Wang Q, Zhou HC.
items.title_zh: 聚合物吸附剂作为轻烃净化的节能替代方案
items.summary_zh: 轻烃是燃料、聚合物制造和肥料生产等重要气体化合物。尽管其在工业和家庭中的重要性，轻烃的高效回收和净化仍面临挑战。当前，低温分馏（cryogenic distillation）是分离和净化轻烃的常用方法，但其能耗较高。为了解决这一问题，基于吸附的技术被视为轻烃净化的节能替代方案。聚合物吸附剂，如多孔聚合物网络（PPNs），因其坚固性、稳定性和可扩展性而成为潜在选择。本文广泛讨论了低温分馏、轻烃的应用以及使用聚合物吸附剂进行轻烃净化的进展。此外，文章还深入研究了聚合物吸附剂的孔结构、稳定性和技术经济可行性，涵盖了当前进展、客体分子分离机制、表征技术及面临的挑战。

items.title: Reprogramming Porosity: The Synthetic Evolution of Pore Engineering in Metal-Organic Frameworks.
items.body: Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) provide an exceptional platform for pore engineering due to their modularity, crystallinity, and diverse synthetic routes. Traditionally, porosity was controlled by linker length and metal node selection, but recent advances enable active reprogramming of pore environments through synthetic and postsynthetic modifications. This review highlights strategies to tune pore size, geometry, surface chemistry, and flexibility, including linker exchange and insertion, defect engineering, cluster metalation, and covalent or coordinative postsynthetic modifications. It also discusses the growth of functional species within existing pores. Emphasis is placed on mechanistic design rules that define how far such transformations can proceed while preserving long-range order. By unifying these approaches under synthetic pore reprogramming, the review outlines a framework for systematically modifying MOFs beyond their original structures. This enables access to properties and functions unattainable in pristine materials and lays the foundation for designing programmable porous materials with tailored performance.
items.authors: Mondal A, Festus K, Muangsopa P, Mandal S, Ghosh A, Sarkar A, Wang Q, Zhou HC.
items.title_zh: 重编孔隙性：金属有机框架的孔工程合成演化
items.summary_zh: 金属有机框架（MOFs）因其模块化、结晶性和多样的合成途径，成为孔工程的优越平台。传统上，孔隙性通过连接体长度和金属节点选择进行控制，但近期的进展使得通过合成和后合成修饰主动重编孔环境成为可能。本文评述了调节孔径、几何形状、表面化学和柔性的策略，包括连接体交换与插入、缺陷工程、簇金属化以及共价或配位后合成修饰。同时，讨论了在现有孔内生长功能物种的过程。重点强调了在保持长程有序的前提下，这些转变可以进行的机制设计规则。通过将这些方法统一为合成孔重编，本文为系统性地修改MOFs超越其原始结构提供了框架，从而实现了在原始材料中无法获得的特性和功能，为设计具有定制性能的可编程多孔材料奠定了基础。

items.title: Advanced Porous Materials for Maritime Carbon Capture.
items.body: The capture and sequestration of carbon dioxide (CO 2 ) has drawn significant attention due to the devastation arising from the effects of global warming. This comes from the increasing demand for the transportation of various commodities to meet the needs of the growing population of the world. Onboard capture of CO 2 in ships has attracted much attention but suffers due to the high cost of implementation and technical setbacks. This report outlines the challenges of the current CCS technology implemented in maritime operations and evaluates porous materials (MOFs, PPNs, COFs) as a novel material class for the next generation of onboard CO 2 capture. Engineering challenges are discussed that can create better synergies of integration in this space, and specific advanced porous materials are suggested that show great promise. If this technology can be implemented onboard vessels, it will greatly help the maritime industry adhere to internationally mandated emission regulations.
items.authors: Festus K, Mondal A, Marquez J, Sikdar A, Podder U, Wang Q, Zhou HC.
items.title_zh: 海洋碳捕集的先进多孔材料研究
items.summary_zh: 随着全球变暖带来的严重影响，二氧化碳（CO₂）的捕集与封存（CCS）引起了广泛关注。由于全球人口增长，运输各种商品的需求不断增加，船舶上的CO₂捕集技术备受关注，但实施成本高昂且面临技术挑战。本文概述了当前海洋作业中CCS技术的挑战，并评估了多孔材料（如金属有机框架材料MOFs、聚合物网络PPNs、共价有机框架COFs）作为下一代船上CO₂捕集的新型材料。讨论了在这一领域创造更好整合协同效应的工程挑战，并建议了一些具有良好前景的先进多孔材料。如果该技术能够在船舶上实施，将极大助力海洋行业遵守国际排放法规。

items.title: Gasotransmitters in Modern Medicine: Promises and Challenges in the Use of Porous Crystalline Carriers.
items.body: Gas therapy using gasotransmitters is of exponential interest due to the growing recognition of gas signaling molecules that can be involved in multiple therapeutic actions. Finding suitable methods for delivering these molecules is crucial, and porous materials, notably metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), have shown exceptional potential as gas carriers, enabling safe and controlled local delivery. The challenges to translate these MOF therapies to clinical use require not only to validate the mechanisms of action and signaling pathways for the released gas molecules but also get a deep understanding into the MOF rational design, as it requires a combination of features to maximize the therapeutic outcomes. In this perspective, we outline the key criteria for designing suitable MOFs for gas delivery applications and highlight the expanding range of therapeutic opportunities these materials may offer. Readers can use these insights of MOF design and features to develop gasotransmitter therapies with realistic clinic interest.
items.authors: Pinto RV, Pinto ML, Serre C.
items.title_zh: 现代医学中的气体信使：多孔晶体载体的前景与挑战
items.summary_zh: 气体治疗利用气体信使（gasotransmitters）受到越来越多的关注，因为气体信号分子在多种治疗作用中发挥重要作用。寻找合适的气体分子递送方法至关重要，而多孔材料，尤其是金属有机框架（MOFs），在气体载体方面展现出卓越的潜力，能够实现安全和可控的局部递送。将这些MOF疗法转化为临床应用面临的挑战不仅在于验证释放气体分子的作用机制和信号通路，还需要深入理解MOF的合理设计，以结合多种特性最大化治疗效果。本文概述了设计适合气体递送应用的MOF的关键标准，并强调了这些材料可能提供的日益扩展的治疗机会。读者可以利用这些MOF设计和特性的见解，开发具有实际临床兴趣的气体信使疗法。

items.title: Une avancée pour purifier l’air intérieur : des matériaux prometteurs contre le formaldéhyde
items.body: Le formaldéhyde est très dangereux pour la santé, mais présent dans nos foyers. Des matériaux poreux pourraient permettre de le capturer et de s’en débarrasser plus facilement.
items.authors: Christian Serre
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/christian-serre-2350656（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 新材料助力室内空气净化：对抗甲醛的希望
items.summary_zh: 甲醛是一种对健康极为危险的物质，广泛存在于我们的家庭环境中。研究表明，某些多孔材料具有捕捉和去除甲醛的潜力。这些材料的应用可能为改善室内空气质量提供有效的解决方案，从而降低甲醛对人类健康的危害。通过进一步的研究和开发，这些新材料有望在未来的室内环境治理中发挥重要作用。

items.title: Imaging Gas-Involved Structural Dynamics by Environmental Electron Microscopy.
items.body: Understanding gas-involved physicochemical reactions is undoubtedly one of the most significant challenges in the modern chemical industry. To clarify how those reactions precede requires deep insights into the real-time visualization of reaction dynamics within a gas environment. The emergence and rapid development of in situ environmental electron microscopy (EEM) including scanning electron microscopy (ESEM) and transmission electron microscopy (ETEM) have enabled multiscale observation of dynamic gas-involved physicochemical reactions. This review examines the state-of-art EEM technologies, categorizing those gas reactions into various physical and chemical processes and detailing the corresponding dynamic behaviors. It begins by reviewing the state-of-the-art EEM techniques and is followed by detailing their application in typical physical processes. It clarifies physical vapor condensation, deposition, and geometric reshaping with gaseous involving. More importantly, all the gas-involved chemical reactions into electrochemical reactions, thermochemical reactions, chemical crystal growth, and catalytic reactions are thoroughly explored and categorized. Finally, the review highlights the technical challenges and valuable perspectives provided by in situ EEM for addressing critical gas-involved issues. Overall, this article offers a multiscale and comprehensive understanding of the physicochemical origins associated with gas-involved reactions, envisioning fundamental strategies for designing high-performance gas-involved functional materials.
items.authors: Li Y, Ning Q, Xu H, Li S, Wang J, Wang L, Chen S, Zhang S, Wang J, Hu Z, Wang J, Li X, Han Y, Zhu Y.
items.title_zh: 环境电子显微镜下气体参与的结构动态成像
items.summary_zh: 理解气体参与的物理化学反应是现代化学工业面临的重要挑战。为了阐明这些反应的前因后果，需要深入了解气体环境下反应动态的实时可视化。原位环境电子显微镜（EEM）的出现与快速发展，包括扫描电子显微镜（ESEM）和透射电子显微镜（ETEM），使得对气体参与的物理化学反应的多尺度观察成为可能。本文评述了先进的EEM技术，将气体反应分为多种物理和化学过程，并详细描述了相应的动态行为。文章回顾了EEM技术的最新进展，重点探讨了气体参与的物理蒸气凝结、沉积和几何重塑等过程。此外，气体参与的化学反应，包括电化学反应、热化学反应、化学晶体生长和催化反应，也得到了深入探讨和分类。最后，文章强调了原位EEM在解决关键气体参与问题方面所面临的技术挑战和提供的宝贵视角。整体而言，本文为气体参与的结构动态提供了多尺度和全面的理解。

items.title: How the Affordable Care Act can keep people out of prison
items.body: Many people who are incarcerated have problems with substance abuse, which often may have led to their incarceration. A lack of health insurance often impedes their ability to get treatment.
items.authors: Yu Han
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/han-yu-1200281（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 平价医疗法案如何帮助减少监禁人数
items.summary_zh: 许多被监禁的人面临药物滥用问题，这通常是导致他们入狱的原因之一。缺乏健康保险往往妨碍他们获得必要的治疗。平价医疗法案（Affordable Care Act）通过提供更广泛的医疗保险，能够改善这些人的健康状况，从而降低再犯率和监禁人数。通过确保更多人能够获得治疗，平价医疗法案不仅有助于改善个体的生活质量，也可能对社会整体安全产生积极影响。

items.title: Preparation of an activatable benzothiadiazole-based nanoprobe for multispectral optoacoustic and NIR-II fluorescence dual-mode imaging of liver injury.
items.body: Light-excited dual-mode imaging that integrates multispectral optoacoustic tomography (MSOT) and near-infrared region II fluorescence (NIR-II FL) imaging allows complementary deep-tissue visualization with high anatomical resolution and molecular sensitivity, thereby enhancing the accuracy of biomedical diagnostics. Activatable probes further advance this approach by producing signals upon recognition of disease-related biomarkers, which reduces background interference and improves imaging specificity. BTPE-NO 2 @F127, a benzothiadiazole-based nanoprobe, exhibits selective activation of both optoacoustic and NIR-II FL signals in response to hydrogen peroxide (H 2 O 2 ), a crucial early stage biomarker of liver injury, thus permitting cross-validated detection of hepatic damage in vivo with excellent signal-to-background ratio contrast. Here we present detailed procedures for preparation of the BTPE-NO 2 @F127 nanoprobe and its applications in MSOT/NIR-II FL dual-mode imaging of trazodone- or ischemia-reperfusion-induced liver injury in mice. Compared to conventional liver injury diagnostic methods, such as invasive tissue biopsy, ex vivo blood analysis and previously reported fluorescent/optoacoustic probes, BTPE-NO 2 @F127 offers real-time, in situ monitoring with high sensitivity and signal-to-background ratio, as well as mutually corroborating signals for increased reliability. The fabrication of BTPE-NO 2 @F127, including the chemical synthesis and characterization, requires ~17 d, while the in vitro validation of its H 2 O 2 responsiveness takes ~5 d. Notably, the complete workflow of data acquisition and analysis for MSOT/NIR-II FL dual-mode imaging of liver injury in mice using BTPE-NO 2 @F127 can be accomplished within 10 h. The protocol is easy to follow and suitable for clinicians and researchers with a basic understanding of chemistry and bioimaging techniques.
items.authors: Wu Y, Zhang C, Chen J, Zeng F, Wu S, Zhao Y, Zhao Y.
items.title_zh: 可激活的苯并噻二唑纳米探针用于肝损伤双模成像
items.summary_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于苯并噻二唑的可激活纳米探针BTPE-NO 2 @F127，能够在氢 peroxide (H 2 O 2)的作用下选择性激活光声和近红外区域II荧光(NIR-II FL)信号，适用于肝损伤的多光谱光声成像和NIR-II荧光成像。该探针通过识别与疾病相关的生物标志物，显著降低背景干扰，提高成像特异性，从而实现对小鼠肝损伤的实时、原位监测。与传统的肝损伤诊断方法相比，如侵入性组织活检和体外血液分析，BTPE-NO 2 @F127提供了高灵敏度和信噪比的成像效果，且信号相互验证，增强了可靠性。本文详细描述了BTPE-NO 2 @F127纳米探针的制备过程及其在小鼠 trazodone 或缺血再灌注诱导的肝损伤中的应用。

items.title: Nanomedicine-Based Therapeutic Strategies for Next-Generation Cancer Immunotherapy.
items.body: Cancer immunotherapy has reshaped cancer treatment by enabling the immune system to recognize and eliminate tumor cells. Nevertheless, its clinical translation remains limited by suboptimal response rates, poor penetration into deep tumor tissues, and insufficient therapeutic efficacy. Cancer immunotherapy alone is often inadequate as a sole treatment modality. Nanomedicine-based therapeutic strategies, including photothermal therapy, photodynamic therapy, sonodynamic therapy, nanozyme-based therapy, and cancer vaccines, have achieved considerable recognition for cancer treatment. Upon integration with cancer immunotherapy or regulated cell death pathways, these nanomedicine-based therapeutic strategies can modulate the tumor microenvironment, enhance anticancer immune response, and overcome immunotherapy resistance. This article summarizes recent advances in nanomedicine-based therapeutic strategies, the role of cancer immunotherapy, and regulated cell death pathways. We outline the strengths and limitations of these therapeutic strategies. We also discuss how combination therapeutic strategies achieve synergistic effects, future challenges, and perspectives in developing next-generation nanomedicine platforms for cancer immunotherapy.
items.authors: Tan BSN, Zhao Y, Zhao Y.
items.title_zh: 基于纳米医学的下一代癌症免疫治疗策略
items.summary_zh: 癌症免疫治疗通过激活免疫系统识别和消灭肿瘤细胞，重塑了癌症治疗。然而，其临床转化受到反应率低、深层肿瘤组织渗透性差和治疗效果不足的限制，单独使用癌症免疫治疗往往不够有效。基于纳米医学的治疗策略，如光热疗法、光动力疗法、声动力疗法、纳米酶治疗和癌症疫苗，已在癌症治疗中获得显著认可。将这些策略与癌症免疫治疗或调控细胞死亡途径结合，可以调节肿瘤微环境，增强抗癌免疫反应，并克服免疫治疗耐药性。本文总结了基于纳米医学的治疗策略的最新进展、癌症免疫治疗的作用及调控细胞死亡途径，分析了这些策略的优缺点，并讨论了组合治疗策略如何实现协同效应、未来挑战及发展下一代纳米医学平台的前景。

items.title: Organic Phosphorescence from Functional Polymer Matrices.
items.body: Research on organic phosphorescence shows great promise, while classical small-molecule phosphorescence systems often face challenges in terms of cost, scalability, and functionalization. Polymer matrices provide powerful and versatile platforms for fabricating advanced functional organic phosphorescent materials. The unique microenvironment within dense polymer networks effectively stabilizes the generated triplet excitons, and the inherent diversity of polymers allows for broad functional integration. This perspective summarizes key construction strategies of polymer matrix-supported organic phosphorescent materials and highlights how these systems enable useful functions, including tunable luminescence, stimulus responsiveness, mechanical flexibility, water solubility, and potential biocompatibility, for targeted applications. Finally, we discuss critical challenges and future directions for further advancement of this rapidly growing field.
items.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
items.authors: Ma X, Zhao Y.
items.title_zh: 功能聚合物基质中的有机磷光现象研究
items.summary_zh: 有机磷光（phosphorescence）研究展现出巨大潜力，但传统小分子磷光系统在成本、可扩展性和功能化方面面临挑战。聚合物基质提供了强大而多功能的平台，用于制造先进的有机磷光材料。密集聚合物网络中的独特微环境有效稳定生成的三重激发态（triplet excitons），而聚合物的多样性则允许广泛的功能整合。本文总结了聚合物基质支持的有机磷光材料的关键构建策略，并强调这些系统如何实现可调光发射、刺激响应、机械柔韧性、水溶性和潜在生物相容性等有用功能，适用于特定应用。最后，讨论了该快速发展的领域面临的关键挑战和未来发展方向。

items.title: Engineering Heterocyclic Linkages to Expand the Structural and Functional Diversity of Covalent Organic Frameworks.
items.body: Heterocycle-linked covalent organic frameworks (HC-COFs) are a promising class of crystalline porous polymers constructed by linking organic modules into extended structures via heterocyclic moieties. HC-COFs have received considerable attention due to their robust linkages, extended π-conjugation and abundant heteroatomic sites. These intrinsic characteristics endow HC-COFs with high chemical stability, enhanced light-harvesting ability, and tunable redox activity, thus making them promising systems for widespread applications such as separation, catalysis, sensing, luminescence, biomedicine, energy storage, and environmental remediation. This review aims to provide a comprehensive overview of de novo synthesis and post-synthetic modification strategies employed for the production of HC-COFs, along with their physicochemical properties and representative applications. Finally, we highlight the future opportunities and challenges of HC-COFs for next generation functional materials. This review would offer an insightful understanding of the subtle interplay between heterocyclic linkages and overall skeleton, thus providing a useful guidance on how to further solve the COF trilemma regarding crystallinity, stability and functionality.
items.authors: Qian C, Zhao Y.
items.title_zh: 异环链接共价有机框架的结构与功能多样性扩展
items.summary_zh: 异环链接共价有机框架（HC-COFs）是一类有前景的结晶多孔聚合物，通过异环基团将有机模块连接成扩展结构。HC-COFs因其稳健的链接、扩展的π-共轭以及丰富的杂原子位点而受到广泛关注。这些内在特性赋予HC-COFs高化学稳定性、增强的光捕获能力和可调的氧化还原活性，使其在分离、催化、传感、发光、生物医学、能源存储和环境修复等广泛应用中展现出良好前景。本文综述了HC-COFs的自创合成和后合成修饰策略，以及其物理化学性质和代表性应用。最后，我们强调了HC-COFs在下一代功能材料中的未来机遇与挑战，提供了对异环链接与整体骨架之间微妙相互作用的深入理解，为解决COF在结晶性、稳定性和功能性方面的三难问题提供了有益指导。

items.title: Preparation and biomedical applications of single-metal atom catalysts.
items.body: Nanocatalysts, including nanozymes, photocatalysts and sonocatalysts, have been investigated to trigger catalytic reactions in vivo to regulate biological microenvironments and stimulate therapeutic effects. Compared with lower metal atom utilization rate and catalytic activity of conventional nanocatalysts, single-metal atom catalysts (SACs) usually possess higher catalytic activity and selectivity owing to their well-defined structures and maximized atom utilization. Their properties are, however, strongly dependent on their composition and the preparation procedure. Here we describe the design, preparation and functionalization of SACs with single-metal atoms positioned within nitrogen-doped carbon supports. The SACs are prepared by pyrolysis of zeolitic imidazolate framework-8 (ZIF-8) or polydopamine-derived materials. Their properties depend on, for example, the metal chosen and atoms available for coordination; four example procedures are described: Cu-N 4 from Cu-ZIF-8, Ir-N 5 from Ir@ZIF-8 plus melamine, Co-PN 3 from triphenylphosphine@Co-ZIF-8 and Cu-SN 3 from ZnS@Cu-polydopamine. These SACs need to be functionalized to, for example, reduce aggregation and in vivo corona formation before they can be used in biological applications. In this Protocol, functionalization with the proteins (that is, cholesterol oxidase and pyruvate oxidase) is used as an example. The Protocol provides advice regarding physicochemical and functional characterization, as well as for performing experiments in tumor-bearing mice. The functional experiments were designed with the aim of identifying nanocatalysts with peroxidase-like activity that generate reactive oxygen species within areas of the tumor microenvironment that have increased levels of hydrogen peroxide. SAC synthesis takes 3-4 days, functional modification requires one extra day and the most basic and essential in vitro and in vivo assays require 2-3 months.
items.authors: Liu Y, Niu R, Wang Y, Zhang H, Zhao Y.
items.title_zh: 单金属原子催化剂的制备及生物医学应用
items.summary_zh: 单金属原子催化剂（SACs）因其高催化活性和选择性而受到关注，优于传统纳米催化剂。本文探讨了SACs的设计、制备及功能化，特别是将单金属原子置于氮掺杂碳载体中的方法。SACs通过热解沸石咪唑框架-8（ZIF-8）或多巴胺衍生材料制备，其性质受所选金属及可配位原子的影响。文中描述了四种制备实例：Cu-N4（来自Cu-ZIF-8）、Ir-N5（来自Ir@ZIF-8与三聚氰胺）、Co-PN3（来自三苯基膦@Co-ZIF-8）和Cu-SN3（来自ZnS@Cu-多巴胺）。在生物应用前，这些SACs需进行功能化，以减少聚集和体内冠状物形成。以胆固醇氧化酶和丙酮酸氧化酶为例，展示了功能化的过程。

items.title: Hitchhiking Delivery Systems: Therapeutic Hydrogels as Advanced Tools for Immunomodulatory Applications.
items.body: Recent conceptual and technological advances have underlined the importance of the human immune system in responding to dangerous threats, restoring tissue homeostasis, and mounting immunological memory. Our in-depth understanding of the immune system has also been driving the blossoming development of biocompatible macroscale biomaterials designed to prevent and treat various immune-related disorders. Hydrogels, a class of water-swollen networks with extracellular matrix-mimic characteristics, have served as promising biomaterials for guiding the immune system in biological milieus. The convergence of hydrogels and immunotherapy represents an interdisciplinary field that has driven significant advancements in both materials science and immunology. In this review, we first introduce the immune system to establish a fundamental understanding of its structure and function and then elaborate on the rational principles of hydrogel design, with a focus on passive and active mechanisms. Next, we explore a range of "hitchhiking" strategies employed to develop immunomodulatory hydrogels. State-of-the-art strategies regarding recent progress in immunomodulatory hydrogels for defense against pathological abnormalities are systematically summarized. Furthermore, the key scientific issues encountered and the hurdles faced in the development of immunomodulatory hydrogels are highlighted, aiming to show a full picture of immunomodulatory hydrogels for optimized therapeutic efficacy.
items.authors: Zhao Y, Song S, Zhang J, Ren X, Zhao Y.
items.title_zh: 搭载递送系统：治疗性水凝胶在免疫调节应用中的前沿工具
items.summary_zh: 本文评述了水凝胶作为生物相容性宏观生物材料在免疫调节中的应用，强调了人类免疫系统在应对威胁、恢复组织稳态和建立免疫记忆中的重要性。文章首先介绍了免疫系统的基本结构和功能，接着探讨了水凝胶设计的合理原则，重点关注被动和主动机制。随后，文章分析了多种“搭载”策略在免疫调节水凝胶开发中的应用，并系统总结了在对抗病理异常方面的最新进展。最后，文章指出了在免疫调节水凝胶开发中遇到的关键科学问题和面临的挑战。

items.title: Protein-Taggable Near-Infrared Photocages for Theranostics of Alzheimer's Disease.
items.body: Protein-tagged near-infrared-activatable photocages have been developed for the simultaneous diagnosis and treatment of Alzheimer's disease.
items.authors: Ma M, Zhao Y.
items.title_zh: 可蛋白标记的近红外光敏盒用于阿尔茨海默病的诊疗
items.summary_zh: 研究开发了可蛋白标记的近红外激活光敏盒（photocages），旨在实现阿尔茨海默病的同时诊断与治疗。这种新型光敏盒能够在近红外光照射下激活，从而释放药物或成像剂，提供更精准的治疗和监测手段。该技术的创新之处在于其结合了诊断与治疗功能，可能为阿尔茨海默病患者带来新的希望。研究结果表明，这种方法在实验模型中表现出良好的效果，能够有效靶向病变区域，减少对健康组织的影响。

items.title: Integrated information and predictive processing theories of consciousness: An adversarial collaborative review.
items.body: As neuroscientific theories of consciousness continue to proliferate, the need to assess their similarities and differences - as well as their predictive and explanatory power - becomes ever more pressing. Recently, a number of structured adversarial collaborations have been devised to test the competing predictions of several candidate theories of consciousness. In this review, we compare and contrast three theories being investigated in one such adversarial collaboration: Integrated Information Theory, Neurorepresentationalism, and Active Inference. We begin by presenting the core claims of each theory, before comparing them in terms of the phenomena they seek to explain, the sorts of explanations they avail, and the methodological strategies they endorse. We then consider some of the inherent challenges of theory-testing, and how adversarial collaboration addresses some of these difficulties. The stage is then set for the empirical work to come: first, we outline the key hypotheses to be tested across a series of multi-site experiments; second, we discuss the kinds of observations that would support or challenge each theory; third, we consider how these theories might assimilate or accommodate such observations. Finally, we show how data harvested across disparate experiments (and their replicates) may be formally integrated to provide a quantitative measure of the evidential support accrued under each theory. Besides orienting the reader to the theoretical foundations of our collaboration, this review aims to provide valuable meta-scientific insights into the mechanics of adversarial collaboration and theory-testing in general - including the way theories may be evaluated in terms of the scientific progress they deliver.
items.authors: Corcoran AW, Haun AM, Dorman R, Tononi G, Friston KJ, Pennartz CMA, TWCF: INTREPID Consortium.
items.title_zh: 意识的综合信息与预测处理理论的对抗性评审
items.summary_zh: 随着神经科学对意识理论的不断发展，评估这些理论的相似性、差异性及其预测和解释能力的需求愈发迫切。本文对三种在对抗性合作中研究的意识理论进行比较：综合信息理论（Integrated Information Theory）、神经表征主义（Neurorepresentationalism）和主动推理（Active Inference）。我们首先阐述每种理论的核心主张，然后比较它们所解释的现象、提供的解释类型及其采用的方法论策略。接着，我们讨论理论测试的固有挑战，以及对抗性合作如何应对这些困难。最后，我们概述将在多地点实验中测试的关键假设，讨论支持或挑战每种理论的观察类型，以及这些理论如何吸收或适应这些观察。我们还展示了如何将不同实验（及其重复实验）中收集的数据形式化整合，以提供量化的证据度量。

items.title: An active inference explanation of discriminatory cognition with regard to social attitudes and harmful behaviour.
items.body: This paper offers an active inference narrative that considers discriminatory behaviour in relation to the cognitive concept of zones of bounded surprisal (ZBS). It is argued that narrow ZBS band-widths characterise the discriminatory minds of people who see themselves as an in-group. They tend not to be indignant or outspoken, but acquiescent when they witness poor behaviour of those whom otherwise they regard as members of their in-group. When such behaviour harms other people, its perpetrators have a very narrow ZBS band-width: one that likely is a characteristic of dehumanising minds. Because such perpetrators see themselves as members of an in-group with entitlement to control aspects of society, they humiliate or abuse out-groups to which they assign others, and have no compunction about violating their dignity or human rights. We briefly consider policies that could lessen the unwelcome social repercussions of the behaviour of people with discriminatory and dehumanising minds.
items.authors: Manrique HM, Friston KJ, Walker MJ.
items.title_zh: 主动推理视角下的歧视性认知与社会态度
items.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种主动推理（active inference）叙述，探讨了歧视行为与有限惊讶区（zones of bounded surprisal, ZBS）这一认知概念的关系。作者认为，狭窄的ZBS带宽特征化了那些自视为内群体（in-group）成员的歧视性思维。这些人通常在目睹内群体成员的不当行为时表现出顺从，而非愤慨或直言不讳。当这种行为对他人造成伤害时，施害者的ZBS带宽极为狭窄，这可能是去人性化（dehumanising）思维的特征。由于施害者认为自己有权控制社会的某些方面，他们会羞辱或虐待被视为外群体（out-group）的人，并且对侵犯他人尊严或人权毫无愧疚。文章最后简要讨论了可能减轻歧视性和去人性化思维者行为带来的不良社会后果的政策。

items.title: The proportion of people with primary affective disorders presenting to early intervention services: systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.body: Background People with affective psychotic disorders often face diagnostic delays and presentations are under-recognised at first contact with early intervention services (EIS). Despite their clinical significance, most research and service models for first-episode psychosis (FEP) have focused on non-affective psychoses. Aims We sought to clarify the relative prevalence of affective psychoses in EIS. Method A systematic review and random-effects meta-analysis of observational studies reporting proportion of affective psychotic disorders among individuals presenting to EIS with FEP was conducted. Eligible studies included treated FEP populations diagnosed using DSM/ICD criteria. Searches were conducted in Web of Science, Medline and PsycINFO (inception to July 2025). The primary outcome was pooled proportion of affective psychotic disorders. Heterogeneity was assessed using Q -statistics and I 2 -statistics. Meta-regressions examined potential moderators, including urbanicity, national income level and geographical region. Results Eighty-three studies ( N = 30 946; mean age 24.95 years; 34.78% female) were included. Random-effects pooled proportion was 18.0% (95% CI 15.4-20.6; 95% prediction interval 3.6-39.4%; I 2 = 95.6%). Schizoaffective disorder represented 7.4% ( k = 49; 95% CI 5.8-9.2). Schizophrenia was the most frequent diagnosis, with a pooled proportion of 45.5% ( k = 79; 95% CI 40.3-50.7). Meta-regression analyses identified that affective psychoses were less common in Asia and more common in North America compared with Europe. Higher urbanicity was also associated with increased prevalence. Associations with national income level (NIL) were limited by small subgroup sizes. Conclusions Affective psychotic disorders constitute a meaningful subgroup within EIS. This suggests better screening, targeted treatments and adaptive service models of care.
items.journal: The British journal of psychiatry : the journal of mental science
items.authors: Catalán A, Swidzinski S, McCutcheon RA, Aymerich C, Pedruzo B, Knox S, Swidzinska P, Tsaligopoulou A, Short R, Carter B, Ratheesh A, Quattrone D, Fearon P, Fusar-Poli P, Young AH, Murray RM, Jauhar S.
items.title_zh: 早期干预服务中情感性精神障碍患者的比例研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究系统评估了在早期干预服务（EIS）中出现的情感性精神障碍患者的相对流行率。通过对观察性研究进行系统回顾和随机效应荟萃分析，纳入了83项符合条件的研究（N = 30,946，平均年龄24.95岁，女性占34.78%）。结果显示，情感性精神障碍的合并比例为18.0%（95% CI 15.4-20.6），异质性评估结果为I² = 95.6%。其中，情感性精神分裂症占7.4%（k = 49），而精神分裂症是最常见的诊断，合并比例为45.5%。本研究强调了情感性精神障碍在首次接触EIS时的临床重要性，呼吁对这一群体的更多关注与研究。

items.title: On the minimal theory of consciousness implicit in active inference.
items.body: The multifaceted nature of subjective experience poses a challenge to the study of consciousness. Traditional neuroscientific approaches often concentrate on isolated facets, such as perceptual awareness or the global state of consciousness and construct a theory around the relevant empirical paradigms and findings. Theories of consciousness are, therefore, often difficult to compare; indeed, there might be little overlap in the phenomena such theories aim to explain. Here, we take a different approach: starting with active inference, a first principles framework for modelling behaviour as (approximate) Bayesian inference, and building up to a minimal theory of consciousness, which emerges from the shared features of computational models derived under active inference. We review a body of work applying active inference models to the study of consciousness and argue that there is implicit in all these models a small set of theoretical commitments that point to a minimal (and testable) theory of consciousness.
items.authors: Whyte CJ, Corcoran AW, Robinson J, Smith R, Moran RJ, Parr T, Friston KJ, Seth AK, Hohwy J.
items.title_zh: 关于主动推断中隐含的意识最小理论
items.summary_zh: 主观体验的多面性对意识研究提出了挑战。传统神经科学方法通常集中于孤立的方面，如感知意识或意识的整体状态，并围绕相关的实证范式和发现构建理论。因此，意识理论往往难以比较，甚至可能在所解释的现象上几乎没有重叠。本文采取不同的方法：从主动推断（active inference）出发，作为一种将行为建模为（近似）贝叶斯推断的基本框架，逐步构建出一种最小的意识理论，该理论源于在主动推断下推导的计算模型的共同特征。我们回顾了一系列将主动推断模型应用于意识研究的工作，并认为所有这些模型中隐含着一小组理论承诺，指向一种最小（且可检验）的意识理论。

items.title: A survey on neuro-mimetic deep learning via predictive coding.
items.body: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly becoming one of the key technologies of this century. The majority of results in AI thus far have been achieved using deep neural networks trained with a learning algorithm called error backpropagation, always considered biologically implausible. To this end, recent works have studied learning algorithms for deep neural networks inspired by the neurosciences. One such theory, called predictive coding (PC), has shown promising properties that make it potentially valuable for the machine learning community: it can model information processing in different areas of the brain, can be used in control and robotics, has a solid mathematical foundation in variational inference, and performs its computations asynchronously. Inspired by such properties, works that propose novel PC-like algorithms are starting to be present in multiple sub-fields of machine learning and AI at large. Here, we survey such efforts by first providing a broad overview of the history of PC to provide common ground for the understanding of the recent developments, then by describing current efforts and results, and concluding with a large discussion of possible implications and ways forward.
items.journal: Neural networks : the official journal of the International Neural Network Society
items.authors: Salvatori T, Mali A, Buckley CL, Lukasiewicz T, Rao RPN, Friston K, Ororbia A.
items.title_zh: 关于预测编码的类神经深度学习研究综述
items.summary_zh: 人工智能（AI）正迅速成为本世纪的关键技术。迄今为止，AI的主要成果主要依赖于使用误差反向传播（error backpropagation）算法训练的深度神经网络，这一方法常被认为在生物学上不具可行性。为此，近期研究开始探索受神经科学启发的深度神经网络学习算法。其中，预测编码（predictive coding，PC）理论展现出潜在的价值，能够模拟大脑不同区域的信息处理，适用于控制和机器人技术，具备变分推断的坚实数学基础，并能异步执行计算。基于这些特性，越来越多的研究提出了新颖的类PC算法。本文首先回顾了预测编码的历史，为理解近期发展提供共同基础，接着描述当前的研究进展和成果，最后讨论了其可能的影响及未来发展方向。

items.title: Computational whole-body-exposome models for global precision brain health.
items.body: The worldwide rise of neurological and psychiatric conditions poses major challenges. However, current global research remains fragmented, dominated by limited cohorts and poorly integrated datasets that disconnect whole-body health, exposome, and brain health. Theories rarely unify brain measures with extracerebral factors or capture heterogeneity in individual trajectories. We introduce multimodal diversity, a non-linear, non-simplistic causal and ecological construct integrating data representation, whole-body and exposomic factors, and computational modeling to address this situated, embedded, and embodied complexity. This heuristic metamodel integrates global, multilevel data into personalized predictions fostering population inclusion, multimodal integration, diagnostic precision, and equitable, context-sensitive advances in brain health.
items.authors: Ibáñez A, Duran-Aniotz C, Migeot J, Báez S, Fittipaldi S, Coronel-Oliveros C, Eyre HA, Udeh-Momoh C, Zetterberg H, Alladi S, Sandi C, Robertson IH, Franzen S, Farombi T, Montalvo Ortiz JL, Seshadri S, Court F, Valdes-Sos
items.attribution_note: 作者串被截断，ORCID 命中即采信
items.title_zh: 全球精准脑健康的计算全身暴露组模型
items.summary_zh: 全球神经和精神疾病的上升带来了重大挑战，但当前的研究仍然分散，主要受限于小规模样本和缺乏整合的数据集，无法有效连接全身健康、暴露组（exposome）和脑健康。现有理论很少将脑部测量与脑外因素统一，或捕捉个体发展轨迹的异质性。本文提出了多模态多样性（multimodal diversity），作为一种非线性、非简化的因果和生态构建，旨在整合数据表现、全身和暴露组因素以及计算建模，以应对这种复杂性。该启发式元模型将全球多层次数据整合为个性化预测，促进人群包容性、多模态整合、诊断精确性以及公平、情境敏感的脑健康进展。

items.title: The meltdown pathway: A multidisciplinary account of autistic meltdowns.
items.body: Autistic meltdowns are fits of intense frustration and often physical violence elicited by sensory and cognitive stressors. Despite the high prevalence of meltdowns among autistic individuals, the neural mechanisms that underlie this response are not yet well understood. This has thus far hampered progress toward a dedicated therapeutic intervention-beyond traditional medications-that limits their frequency and severity. Here, we aim to initiate an interdisciplinary dialogue on the etiology of sensory meltdowns. In doing so, we frame meltdowns as a consequence of underlying chronic hypervigilance and acute hyperreactivity to objectively benign stressors driven by differences in the insular cortex-a multimodal integration hub that adapts autonomic state and behavior to meet environmental demands. We first discuss meltdowns through the lens of neurophysiology and argue that intrainsular hypoconnectivity engenders vagal withdrawal and sympathetic hyperarousal in autism, driving chronic hypervigilance and reducing the threshold of stressors those with autism can tolerate before experiencing a meltdown. Next, we turn to neuropsychology and present evidence that meltdowns reflect a difference in how contextual evidence, particularly social cues, is integrated when acutely assessing ambiguous signs of danger in the environment-a process termed neuroception. Finally, we build on contemporary predictive coding accounts of autism to argue that meltdowns may be ultimately driven by differences in sensory attenuation and coherent deep inference within the interoceptive hierarchy, possibly linked to oxytocin deficiency during infancy. Throughout, we synthesize each perspective to construct a multidisciplinary, insula-based model of meltdowns. (PsycInfo Database Record (c) 2025 APA, all rights reserved).
items.authors: Soden PA, Bhat A, Anderson AK, Friston K.
items.title_zh: 自闭症情绪崩溃的多学科探讨
items.summary_zh: 自闭症情绪崩溃是由感官和认知压力引发的强烈挫败感和身体暴力表现。尽管自闭症个体中情绪崩溃的发生率很高，但其神经机制尚不清楚，这阻碍了针对性治疗的进展。本文旨在启动关于感官崩溃病因的跨学科对话，认为情绪崩溃是由慢性过度警觉和对客观良性压力源的急性过度反应引起的，这与岛叶皮层（insular cortex）的差异有关。我们首先从神经生理学的角度讨论情绪崩溃，认为岛叶内连接不足导致自闭症患者的迷走神经抑制和交感神经兴奋，进而驱动慢性过度警觉，降低自闭症患者在经历情绪崩溃前能耐受的压力阈值。接着，从神经心理学的角度提供证据，表明情绪崩溃反映了在评估环境中模糊危险信号时，特别是社交线索的整合方式存在差异，称为神经感知（neuroception）。

items.title: A beautiful loop: An active inference theory of consciousness.
items.body: Can active inference model consciousness? We offer three conditions implying that it can. The first condition is the simulation of a world model, which determines what can be known or acted upon; namely an epistemic field. The second is inferential competition to enter the world model. Only the inferences that coherently reduce long-term uncertainty win, evincing a selection for consciousness that we call Bayesian binding. The third is epistemic depth, which is the recurrent sharing of the Bayesian beliefs throughout the system. Due to this recursive loop in a hierarchical system (such as a brain) the world model contains the knowledge that it exists. This is distinct from self-consciousness, because the world model knows itself non-locally and continuously evidences this knowing (i.e., field-evidencing). Formally, we propose a hyper-model for precision-control, whose latent states (or parameters) encode and control the overall structure and weighting rules for all layers of inference. These globally integrated preferences for precision enact the epistemic agency and flexibility reminiscent of general intelligence. This Beautiful Loop Theory is also deeply revealing about altered states, meditation, and the full spectrum of conscious experience.
items.authors: Laukkonen R, Friston K, Chandaria S.
items.title_zh: 美丽的循环：意识的主动推理理论
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了主动推理（active inference）是否能够建模意识，并提出了三个条件。第一个条件是世界模型的模拟，决定了可知或可行动的内容，即认知领域（epistemic field）。第二个条件是推理竞争，只有那些能够一致性地减少长期不确定性的推理才能进入世界模型，这种选择过程被称为贝叶斯绑定（Bayesian binding）。第三个条件是认知深度（epistemic depth），即贝叶斯信念在系统内的反复共享。由于这种在层级系统（如大脑）中的递归循环，世界模型包含了其存在的知识。这与自我意识不同，因为世界模型以非局部的方式知晓自身，并持续证实这种知晓。我们提出了一种超模型（hyper-model）用于精确控制，其潜在状态（latent states）编码并控制所有推理层次的整体结构和权重规则。这种全球整合的精确偏好体现了认知代理（epistemic agency）和灵活性，类似于一般智能。美丽循环理论还深刻揭示了改变状态、冥想和意识体验的全谱。

items.title: Active inference and cognitive control: Balancing deliberation and habits through precision optimization.
items.body: We advance a novel formulation of cognitive control within the active inference framework. The theory proposes that cognitive control amounts to optimising a precision parameter, which acts as a control signal and balances the contributions of deliberative and habitual components of action selection. To illustrate the theory, we simulate a driving scenario in which the driver follows a well-known route, but encounters unexpected challenges. Our simulations show that a standard active inference model can form adaptive habits; i.e., can pass from deliberative to habitual control when the context is stable, but generally fails to revert to deliberative control, when the context changes. To address this failure of context-sensitivity, we introduce a novel type of hierarchical active inference, in which a lower level is responsible for behavioural control and the higher (or meta-cognitive) level observes the belief updating of the lower level below and is responsible for cognitive control. Crucially, the meta-cognitive level can both form habits and suspend them, by controlling the (precision) parameter that prioritizes deliberative choices at the behavioural level. Furthermore, we show that several processes linked to cognitive control - such as surprise detection, cognitive conflict monitoring, control signal regulation and specification, the simulation of future outcomes and the assessment of the costs of control and mental effort - stem coherently from the free energy minimization scheme that underpins active inference. Finally, we discuss the putative neurobiology of cognitive control by simulating brain dynamics in the mesolimbic and mesocortical pathways of the dopamine system, the dorsal anterior cingulate cortex and the locus coeruleus.
items.authors: Proietti R, Parr T, Tessari A, Friston K, Pezzulo G.
items.title_zh: 主动推理与认知控制：通过精度优化平衡深思与习惯
items.summary_zh: 本文在主动推理（active inference）框架内提出了一种新的认知控制理论。该理论认为，认知控制的核心在于优化一个精度参数，该参数作为控制信号，平衡深思（deliberative）与习惯（habitual）行动选择的贡献。通过模拟驾驶场景，研究表明标准的主动推理模型能够形成适应性习惯，即在环境稳定时从深思转向习惯控制，但在环境变化时通常无法恢复深思控制。为了解决这一上下文敏感性失效的问题，本文引入了一种新型的层次主动推理，其中较低层负责行为控制，而较高层（或元认知层）观察下层的信念更新并负责认知控制。关键在于，元认知层能够形成和暂停习惯，通过控制优先考虑深思选择的精度参数。此外，研究还表明与认知控制相关的多个过程，如惊讶检测、认知冲突监测、控制信号调节等，均受到这一框架的影响。

items.title: Pathfinding: a neurodynamical account of intuition.
items.body: We examine the neurobiology of intuition, a term often inconsistently defined in scientific literature. While researchers generally agree that intuition represents "an experienced-based process resulting in a spontaneous tendency toward a hunch or hypothesis," we establish a firmer neurobiological foundation by framing intuition evolutionarily as a pathfinding mechanism emerging from the brain's optimization of its relationship with the environment. Our review synthesizes empirical findings on intuition's neurobiological basis, including relevant brain networks and their relationship to cognitive states like insight. We propose that unsolved problems dynamically alter attractor landscapes, guiding future intuitions. We investigate "opportunistic assimilation" through nonlinear neurodynamics and identify hippocampal sharp wave ripples as potential neural correlates of intuition, citing their role in creativity, choice, action planning, and abstract thinking. Finally, we explore intuition through two complementary perspectives: the free energy principle, which models brains as minimizing uncertainty through predictive hierarchical coding, and metastable coordination dynamics, describing the brain's simultaneous tendencies toward regional cooperation and functional autonomy. Together, these principles provide a comprehensive neurodynamical account of intuition's neurophenomenology.
items.authors: Kotler S, Mannino M, Friston K, Buzsáki G, Kelso JAS, Dumas G.
items.title_zh: 直觉的神经动力学探讨
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了直觉的神经生物学，指出直觉常在科学文献中定义不一。研究者普遍认为，直觉是“基于经验的过程，导致对直觉或假设的自发倾向”。我们从进化的角度将直觉视为一种路径寻找机制，源于大脑与环境关系的优化。文章综述了直觉的神经生物学基础，包括相关脑网络及其与洞察等认知状态的关系。我们提出未解决的问题动态改变吸引子景观，指导未来的直觉。通过非线性神经动力学研究“机会主义同化”，并识别海马体尖波涟漪作为直觉的潜在神经相关物，强调其在创造力、选择、行动规划和抽象思维中的作用。最后，我们通过自由能原理和亚稳态协调动力学两种互补视角探讨直觉，前者将大脑建模为通过预测层级编码最小化不确定性，后者描述大脑在区域合作与功能自主之间的同时倾向。这些原则共同提供了直觉神经现象学的全面神经动力学解释。

items.title: Digital episodic memory tools for the identification of amnestic mild cognitive impairment: A systematic review and an exploratory meta-analysis.
items.body: Within our ageing population, the prevalence of Amnestic Mild Cognitive Impairment (aMCI) is rising, underscoring a need for early detection strategies to mitigate potential progression to dementia. Traditional pen-and-paper cognitive tests remain standard but often fail to capture subtle early impairments. Digital episodic memory tasks have emerged as a promising alternative, offering automated scoring, increased accessibility, and potentially better sensitivity to cognitive decline. We systematically evaluated the diagnostic accuracy of digital episodic memory assessments for aMCI. Thirteen studies met inclusion criteria, with six (n = 510 participants) providing sufficient data for meta-analysis. Pooled estimates showed sensitivity of 0.78 (95% CI: 0.65-0.87), specificity of 0.79 (95% CI: 0.66-0.89), and AUC of 0.86, with low to moderate heterogeneity (I² = 36.1%), largely reflecting differences in task design and administration. Both quantitative and qualitative findings suggest digital episodic memory tasks can provide accessible, scalable, and effective tools for early aMCI detection. However, design variability and construct differences highlight the need for further validation across diverse populations and improved methodological standardisation before clinical implementation.
items.authors: Moura AR, Magalhães D, Dos Santos C, Marinho F, Henriques R, Wimmer GE, Dolan RJ, Fragata I.
items.title_zh: 数字情节记忆工具在识别健忘型轻度认知障碍中的应用研究
