items.summary_zh: 随着老龄化人口的增加，健忘型轻度认知障碍（aMCI）的发病率上升，迫切需要早期检测策略以减缓向痴呆的潜在进展。传统的纸笔认知测试仍是标准方法，但往往无法捕捉到早期的微妙损伤。数字情节记忆任务作为一种有前景的替代方案，提供了自动评分、提高可及性以及可能更好地敏感于认知衰退的优势。我们系统评估了数字情节记忆评估在aMCI诊断中的准确性。共有13项研究符合纳入标准，其中6项（n = 510参与者）提供了足够的数据进行荟萃分析。汇总结果显示敏感性为0.78（95% CI: 0.65-0.87），特异性为0.79（95% CI: 0.66-0.89），AUC为0.86，异质性低至中等（I² = 36.1%），主要反映任务设计和实施的差异。定量和定性结果均表明，数字情节记忆任务可以作为早期aMCI检测的可及、可扩展和有效工具。然而，设计变异性和构念差异强调了在不同人群中进一步验证和改善方法标准化的必要性，以便临床应用。

items.title: The prenatal sex steroid theory of autism after 25 years.
items.body: We first proposed the prenatal sex steroid theory of autism 25 years ago to account for a number of then-unexplained observations around autism, including (1) the more frequent diagnosis of autism in male than in female individuals and (2) apparent 'male-type' shifts in cognitive traits associated with autism, such as empathizing and systemizing. Here we review 25 years of research testing this theory. Early studies found that higher prenatal testosterone levels were associated with slower social, language and empathy development, greater attention to detail, stronger systemizing and more autistic traits. Subsequent studies suggested that both prenatal androgens and oestrogens are associated with autism. New methods in genetics and using stem-cell-derived neural organoids have further indicated the importance of sex steroid hormones for neurodevelopment, as well as atypical patterns in autism. These new findings support and open new lines of research into the prenatal sex steroid theory of autism.
items.authors: Baron-Cohen S, Tsompanidis A, Srivastava DP, Mill J, Lancaster MA, Adhya D, APEX consortium, Warrier V.

items.title_zh: 产前性激素理论与自闭症研究25年回顾
items.summary_zh: 本文回顾了产前性激素理论（prenatal sex steroid theory）提出25年来的研究进展，该理论旨在解释自闭症（autism）的一些未解现象，包括男性自闭症患者的比例高于女性，以及自闭症相关的认知特征表现出明显的“男性化”倾向，如同理心（empathizing）和系统化（systemizing）。早期研究发现，较高的产前睾酮水平与社交、语言和同理心发展缓慢、对细节的关注度更高、系统化能力更强及更多自闭症特征相关。后续研究表明，产前雄激素（androgens）和雌激素（oestrogens）均与自闭症相关。最新的遗传学方法和干细胞衍生的神经类器官（neural organoids）研究进一步强调了性激素在神经发育中的重要性，以及自闭症中的非典型模式。这些新发现支持了产前性激素理论，并为未来的研究开辟了新的方向。

items.title: Appraisal of Gene Expression-Based Classifiers for Neuropsychiatric Disorders: A Meta-Regression.
items.body: A substantial body of research examines the potential of gene-expression-based biomarkers for diagnosing and selecting treatments for neuropsychiatric disorders, yet no clear consensus has been reached regarding the influence of controllable factors such as study design and model selection on the performance of gene-expression-based classifiers. To investigate study characteristics and methodologies that influence the accuracy of studies using transcriptomics to classify neuropsychiatric disorders, we conducted a literature review and meta-regression of relevant studies. We extracted several characteristics from each study, including the number of samples in a training dataset, approach for model validation, and classification model. Using univariate and multivariate mixed-effect meta-regression analyses, we estimated the association between these study characteristics and reported classification accuracies. Machine Learning (ML) models accounted for 55% of all models; Deep Learning (DL) models accounted for 20%, and variations of Logistic Regression models made up the remaining 25%. Support vector machine (SVM) was the most common model type (17%). The use of withheld test samples (56%) was the most frequent approach for validating the performance of classification models. We found significant associations between reported accuracies and study-rated bias risk, model type, class ratio, and validation approach. Overall, this review provides helpful insights into study characteristics that significantly influence classification accuracies and emphasizes the importance of prudent methodologies for training and evaluating classification models to mitigate biased accuracy estimates. In future research, these findings can direct study designs and support the development of clinically reliable, minimally invasive gene-expression biomarkers to improve diagnostic workflows and patient outcomes in neuropsychiatry.
items.journal: American journal of medical genetics. Part B, Neuropsychiatric genetics : the official publication of the International Society of Psychiatric Genetics
items.authors: Razavi A, Arensman B, Barnett EJ, Lee LA, Faraone SV, Glatt SJ, Hess JL.
items.title_zh: 基于基因表达的神经精神疾病分类器评估：元回归分析
items.summary_zh: 本文评估了基因表达生物标志物在神经精神疾病诊断和治疗选择中的潜力，探讨了研究设计和模型选择等可控因素对基因表达分类器性能的影响。通过文献回顾和相关研究的元回归分析，提取了每项研究的多个特征，包括训练数据集样本数量、模型验证方法和分类模型类型。结果显示，机器学习（ML）模型占所有模型的55%，深度学习（DL）模型占20%，逻辑回归模型的变体占25%。支持向量机（SVM）是最常见的模型类型（17%）。使用保留测试样本（56%）是验证分类模型性能的最常用方法。研究发现，报告的分类准确性与研究评估的偏倚风险、模型类型等因素之间存在显著关联。

items.title: Prevalence of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder/hyperkinetic disorder of pediatric and adult populations in clinical settings: a systematic review, meta-analysis and meta-regression.
items.body: Background Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD)/Hyperkinetic Disorder (HD) is linked to increased risks of morbidity, comorbidity and mortality, with higher prevalence in clinical populations. The differential prevalence of ADHD/HD across adult and pediatric clinical populations, influenced by factors such as time trends, sex, age, geographic regions, and comorbidities, has not been systematically assessed. Methods MEDLINE, CINAHL, Embase and PsycINFO databases were searched from inception to 1st August 2023 for eligible full-text papers published in English, and reviewing reference lists of identified studies and review papers. Studies reporting ADHD/HD prevalence in adult and pediatric clinical populations were included. Meta-regression evaluated the effects of geographic region, year of publication and sample size. Results From 30,740 citations, we reviewed 521 full-text articles, yielding 311 studies for inclusion (including 653,558 pediatric and 43,311 adult participants). Overall, worldwide pooled prevalence of ADHD/HD in clinical settings for pediatrics was 32.4% (95% CI 31-34%), and in adults 21.4% (95% CI 20-23%). Prevalence was higher in outpatient settings than inpatient settings. Prevalence based on rating scales was higher than studies using diagnostic interviews or clinical record review. Prevalence varied significantly across subspecialist settings for children and adults. No significant time trend was detected between 1981-2023. Pediatric prevalence appears influenced by geographic region but not year of publication or sample size. For adults, larger sample sizes were associated with lower prevalence estimates. Conclusions ADHD/HD prevalence in clinical populations is 8-9-fold higher than community estimates. With these patients at risk for many adverse outcomes, our findings underscore the critical importance of resource allocation for screening, diagnosing and treatment.
items.authors: Johnson S, Lim E, Jacoby P, Faraone SV, Su BM, Solmi M, Forrest B, Furfaro B, von Klier K, Downs J, Chen W.
items.title_zh: 临床人群中注意缺陷多动障碍的流行病学研究综述
items.summary_zh: 本系统评价和荟萃分析旨在探讨注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）/多动障碍（HD）在儿科和成人临床人群中的流行情况。研究分析了30,740条文献，最终纳入311项研究，涉及653,558名儿童和43,311名成人。结果显示，儿科临床环境中ADHD/HD的全球合并流行率为32.4%（95% CI 31-34%），成人为21.4%（95% CI 20-23%）。门诊环境的流行率高于住院环境，基于评定量表的流行率高于使用诊断访谈或临床记录审查的研究。流行率在不同专科设置中显著不同，表明ADHD/HD的流行情况受多种因素影响，包括时间趋势、性别、年龄和合并症等。

items.title: Role of serotonin in psychiatric and somatic comorbidities of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder: a systematic literature review.
items.body: Introduction Serotonin is a well-established modulator of various neuropsychological processes, as well as organ and endocrine functioning, and metabolism and homeostasis. Serotonin has been implicated in the neurobiology of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). Herein, the evidence for a serotonergic link between psychiatric and somatic comorbidities associated with ADHD was evaluated. Methods A systematic literature review was conducted of the published literature to identify comorbidities proven to co-occur with ADHD and determine whether there was any serotonergic pathophysiology associated with these comorbidities. The average grade of serotonergic evidence was calculated and plotted alongside the volume of publications for each identified comorbidity. The date of the last search was 7 March 2024. Results One hundred eighty-two individual comorbidities commonly occurring in ADHD populations were identified; 135 (74.2 %) had evidence for serotonergic pathophysiology, including 91 psychiatric and 44 somatic conditions. The grade of evidence for a serotonergic role in the pathophysiology of a given comorbidity was generally medium to high or high. Conclusions Findings indicate that serotonin plays a key role, alongside dopamine and norepinephrine, in ADHD neurobiology. Serotonin involvement in physiological functioning suggests that dysregulation is likely to generate a broad spectrum of clinical manifestations, which may account for the unique presentation of neuropsychiatric behaviors and comorbidities found in patients with ADHD.
items.authors: Faraone SV, Ward CL, Boucher M, Elbekai R, Brunner E.
items.title_zh: 血清素在注意缺陷多动障碍合并症中的作用综述
items.summary_zh: 本文系统评述了血清素在注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）相关的精神和躯体合并症中的作用。通过对已发表文献的系统回顾，识别出182种与ADHD人群常见的合并症，其中135种（74.2%）显示出与血清素（serotonin）相关的病理生理证据，包括91种精神疾病和44种躯体疾病。研究结果表明，血清素在ADHD的神经生物学中与多巴胺和去甲肾上腺素共同发挥关键作用，且血清素在生理功能中的参与暗示其失调可能导致多种合并症的发生。

items.title: A Global Prospective Harmonization Framework for Suicidality, Anhedonia, and Obsessive-Compulsive Symptoms in Psychiatric Genetic Studies: A Cross-Continental Study Within the Ancestral Population Network.
items.body: This study aims to prospectively collect harmonized, quantitative, and dimensional psychiatric phenotypes (suicidality, anhedonia, and obsessive-compulsive symptoms) and information on discrimination, stigma, and unfair treatment in up to 27,500 individuals across diverse ancestries and clinical populations for genetic analysis within the NIMH Ancestral Population Network (APN). Five APN projects are participating in the current study (PUMAS-Paisa, PUMAS-NeuroGAP, KOMOGEN-D, LATINO, and SAX-II), spanning recruitment over 15 countries across the Americas, Africa, and Asia. Participants are being enrolled via the recruitment protocols specific to each participating project. The harmonized clinical battery includes the Columbia-Suicide Severity Scale, Snaith-Hamilton Pleasure Scale, and Florida Obsessive-Compulsive Inventory-II to assess suicidality, anhedonia, and obsessive-compulsive symptoms, respectively. Additionally, we use the Discrimination and Stigma Scale-Ultra Short to evaluate discrimination and stigma across cultures. This project is a pioneering effort to prospectively assess transdiagnostic phenotypes in large-scale, diverse ancestral and clinical populations (across different diagnoses) using a harmonized clinical battery, advancing genetic research in mental health in underrepresented populations.

items.title_zh: 全球精神病遗传研究中的自杀倾向、快感缺失与强迫症状统一框架
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在前瞻性地收集统一的、定量的、维度化的精神病表型（自杀倾向、快感缺失和强迫症状），以及关于歧视、污名和不公平对待的信息，涉及多达27,500名来自不同祖先和临床人群的个体，进行NIMH祖先人群网络（APN）内的遗传分析。参与本研究的五个APN项目（PUMAS-Paisa、PUMAS-NeuroGAP、KOMOGEN-D、LATINO和SAX-II）覆盖美洲、非洲和亚洲的15个国家。参与者通过各项目特定的招募协议进行招募。统一的临床评估工具包括哥伦比亚自杀严重性量表、斯奈斯-汉密尔顿快感量表和佛罗里达强迫症量表-II，分别用于评估自杀倾向、快感缺失和强迫症状。此外，我们使用歧视与污名量表-超短版评估跨文化的歧视和污名。本项目是前所未有的努力，旨在使用统一的临床评估工具前瞻性地评估大规模、多样化的祖先和临床人群中的跨诊断表型，推动在弱势人群中的心理健康遗传研究。

items.title: Placebo and nocebo effects of pharmacotherapy for obsessive-compulsive related disorders: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.body: Objective This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to quantify the magnitude of placebo and nocebo effects in pharmacological trials for OCRDs and identify clinical and methodological moderators influencing these effects. Methods A comprehensive literature search was conducted across multiple databases and clinical trial registries up to May 2025. Randomised, placebo-controlled trials involving pharmacological interventions for OCRDs were included. The primary outcomes were placebo effect size and placebo response rate; secondary outcomes included nocebo response rate and side effect profile. Data were extracted independently and meta-analysed using random effects models. Meta-regression was performed to assess moderators of placebo response. Results Fifteen eligible trials ( N = 640; placebo N = 341) were included. The pooled placebo effect size was moderate (SMC = -0.63; 95% CI -0.77 to -0.48), with low heterogeneity ( I 2 = 4.73%). The placebo response rate was 21%, and the nocebo response rate was 18%. Despite testing a broad range of potential moderators, including clinical characteristics, methodological design, and medication class, no significant predictors of placebo effect size were identified. Side effects were reported in nearly one-third of placebo recipients, underscoring the relevance of nocebo effects. Conclusions Placebo and nocebo responses are noteworthy in trials for OCRDs and may influence perceived treatment efficacy. Variability in placebo responses is not well explained by currently measurable moderators. Further research is needed to explore neurobiological, psychological, and methodological contributors to expectancy effects in OCRD pharmacotherapy trials.
items.authors: Hoffman J, Williams T, Stein DJ.
items.title_zh: 强迫症相关障碍药物治疗的安慰剂与反安慰剂效应系统评估
items.summary_zh: 本系统评价和荟萃分析旨在量化强迫症相关障碍（OCRDs）药物试验中的安慰剂（placebo）和反安慰剂（nocebo）效应，并识别影响这些效应的临床和方法学调节因素。研究纳入了截至2025年5月的多数据库和临床试验登记处的随机对照试验。结果显示，纳入15项符合条件的试验（N = 640；安慰剂组N = 341），合并安慰剂效应量为中等（SMC = -0.63；95% CI -0.77至-0.48），异质性低（I² = 4.73%）。安慰剂反应率为21%，反安慰剂反应率为18%。尽管测试了多种潜在调节因素，但未发现显著的安慰剂效应量预测因子。近三分之一的安慰剂接受者报告了副作用，强调了反安慰剂效应的重要性。

items.title: Neurorestorative properties of ibogaine: linking multi-receptor affinities to remyelination and metabolic restoration.
items.body: Ibogaine is a psychedelic alkaloid without an approved indication. Observational clinical research shows linkages between single administration of ibogaine and relief of symptoms of neuropsychiatric conditions including substance use disorder, multiple sclerosis (MS), and traumatic brain injury. Ibogaine has multi-receptor actions, but the neurobiological mechanisms underlying such putative effects are unknown. Here we review and discuss the relevant literature, focusing on remyelination and metabolic restoration. We provide evidence that ibogaine upregulates markers of myelination following opioid administration; that conditions such as opioid use disorder, MS and traumatic brain injury are characterised by white matter pathology; that decreased myelination is related to dysregulated metabolic homeostasis, ischaemia and hypoxia which may also play a role in these disorders. We conclude that multi-receptor actions of ibogaine, especially its affinities for the NMDA, kappa opioid and sigma receptors, in turn account for reduction in excitotoxicity, metabolic regulation, lasting neuroplasticity and immunomodulation that facilitates neuronal repair and remyelination providing a rationale for future investigation of its use as a therapeutic agent for these common central nervous system disorders.
items.authors: Calvey T, Govender D, Owen GR, Tumba N, Lang D, Lerer B, Stein DJ, Shoptaw S.
items.title_zh: 伊博卡因的神经修复特性：多受体亲和力与再髓鞘化及代谢恢复的关联
items.summary_zh: 伊博卡因是一种尚未获得批准的迷幻生物碱。观察性临床研究显示，单次使用伊博卡因与缓解神经精神疾病症状（如物质使用障碍、多发性硬化症和创伤性脑损伤）存在关联。本文回顾并讨论相关文献，重点关注再髓鞘化和代谢恢复。我们提供证据表明，伊博卡因在阿片类药物使用后上调髓鞘化标志物；物质使用障碍、多发性硬化症和创伤性脑损伤等疾病特征表现为白质病理；髓鞘化减少与代谢稳态失调、缺血和缺氧相关，这些因素可能在这些疾病中发挥作用。我们得出结论，伊博卡因的多受体作用，尤其是其对NMDA、κ阿片和σ受体的亲和力，降低了兴奋性毒性，调节了代谢，促进了持久的神经可塑性和免疫调节，从而有助于神经修复和再髓鞘化，为其作为治疗这些常见中枢神经系统疾病的药物的未来研究提供了依据。

items.title: Are you on the internet or using screen-based devices?
items.body: The concept of 'internet addiction' was introduced in the 1990s and has increasingly been recognized as a clinical and public health issue. Although umbrella terms can be useful for screening, theoretical considerations, and intervention planning, the term itself has received criticism because of its conceptual heterogeneity, implying an addiction to a medium and not including a wide range of problematic behavioral patterns that are below the diagnostic threshold of a clinical disorder. To address this criticism, we propose adopting the term 'problematic use' instead of 'addiction'. Furthermore, we argue that while 'problematic usage of the internet' is currently a useful umbrella term, recent technological advancements and increasing online presence may in the future require a conceptual and methodological shift in terminology from 'internet' to the more specific 'screen-based devices' or 'screens' that would enable more accurate assessment and intervention strategies. Terms focusing on specific devices, such as 'smartphone addiction,' should also be used with caution, as problematic use relates to applications rather than the hardware itself and may extend to various devices.
items.authors: Demetrovics Z, Czakó A, Potenza MN, Griffiths MD, Fineberg NA, Stein DJ, Ekhtiari H, Brand M, Montag C, Lin CY, Li L, Elhai JD, Király O.
items.title_zh: 互联网使用与屏幕设备的“问题性使用”探讨
items.summary_zh: 自1990年代以来，“互联网成瘾”概念逐渐被认定为临床和公共健康问题。尽管这一统称在筛查、理论探讨和干预规划中有其价值，但因其概念异质性而受到批评，暗示对媒介的成瘾而未涵盖低于临床障碍诊断阈值的多种行为模式。为应对这一批评，本文建议使用“问题性使用”一词替代“成瘾”。同时，作者认为，尽管“互联网的有问题使用”目前是一个有用的统称，但随着技术进步和在线存在感的增强，未来可能需要将术语从“互联网”转向更具体的“屏幕设备”或“屏幕”，以便更准确地评估和制定干预策略。针对特定设备的术语，如“智能手机成瘾”，也应谨慎使用，因为问题性使用与应用程序相关，而非硬件本身，并可能扩展至多种设备。

items.title: Executive functioning in adolescents with internalizing disorders: a systematic review.
items.body: Internalizing disorders (INTs), including anxiety (AD) and depressive disorders (DD), frequently emerge during adolescence. Studies suggest that certain core domains of executive functioning (EF), i.e. inhibition, shifting and working memory (WM) may show selectively lower performance in certain INTs. This systematic review aimed to evaluate the evidence of associations between INTs and EF in adolescents. A systematic search was conducted in Medline, Psych-INFO, Scopus, and Web of Science in May 2023. Inclusion focused on adolescents (12-17) with AD (including obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD)) or DD. After screening 2,551 titles/abstracts, 818 records underwent full-text review, on which independent reviewers reached 93% agreement on eligibility. EF parameters, measured through task-performance or ratings, were extracted from 32 eligible articles published since 2014. Performance-based EF differences were reported in 22 studies, most frequently in adolescents with DD. Task-based inhibition showed lower scores most consistently in DD (n = 5). Findings were mixed across other INTs. Three studies found evidence for improved inhibition performance in OCD (n = 2) and AD (n = 1). Finally, 6 studies reporting on self- or parent-rated EF found significant difficulties across EF domains, of which 3 contrasted with intact performances on task-based measurements of EF. Findings suggest both objective and subjective EF difficulties across INTs with no conclusive evidence for selective domain-specific differences. We highlight a discrepancy between subjectively experienced or observed deficits in daily EF and performance on structured tasks. This suggests that rating-based EF may be more sensitive for capturing subtle EF difficulties and therefore adds value in research and clinical settings. Finally, the quality of studies is discussed and directions for future studies are identified, namely, the use of both task and rating-based measures of EF as well as inclusion of larger sample sizes.
items.authors: Fontaine GP, Blake KV, Koen N, Stein DJ, Hammar Å, Groenewold NA.
items.title_zh: 青少年内化障碍与执行功能的系统评估
items.summary_zh: 内化障碍（INTs），如焦虑障碍（AD）和抑郁障碍（DD），常在青少年时期出现。研究表明，执行功能（EF）的某些核心领域，如抑制、转换和工作记忆（WM），在特定的内化障碍中表现较低。本系统评价旨在评估青少年内化障碍与执行功能之间的关联证据。2023年5月，在Medline、Psych-INFO、Scopus和Web of Science进行系统检索，纳入对象为12至17岁患有焦虑障碍（包括强迫症（OCD）和创伤后应激障碍（PTSD））或抑郁障碍的青少年。经过对2,551个标题/摘要的筛选，818条记录进行了全文审查，独立评审者对合格性达成93%的一致。提取了自2014年以来32篇合格文章中的执行功能参数，22项研究报告了基于表现的执行功能差异，抑郁障碍青少年表现最为明显。任务基础的抑制在抑郁障碍中得分最低（n = 5），而其他内化障碍的结果则较为混杂。三项研究发现强迫症（n = 2）和焦虑障碍（n = 1）中抑制表现有所改善。最后，6项关于自评或父母评估的研究发现执行功能各领域存在显著困难，其中3项与任务表现良好相对立。

items.title: Consortium profile: the methylation, imaging and NeuroDevelopment (MIND) consortium.
items.body: Epigenetic processes, such as DNA methylation, show potential as biological markers and mechanisms underlying gene-environment interplay in the prediction of mental health and other brain-based phenotypes. However, little is known about how peripheral epigenetic patterns relate to individual differences in the brain itself. An increasingly popular approach to address this is by combining epigenetic and neuroimaging data; yet, research in this area is almost entirely comprised of cross-sectional studies in adults. To bridge this gap, we established the Methylation, Imaging and NeuroDevelopment (MIND) Consortium, which aims to bring a developmental focus to the emerging field of Neuroimaging Epigenetics by (i) promoting collaborative, adequately powered developmental research via multi-cohort analyses; (ii) increasing scientific rigor through the establishment of shared pipelines and open science practices; and (iii) advancing our understanding of DNA methylation-brain dynamics at different developmental periods (from birth to emerging adulthood), by leveraging data from prospective, longitudinal pediatric studies. MIND currently integrates 16 cohorts worldwide, comprising (repeated) measures of DNA methylation in peripheral tissues (blood, buccal cells, and saliva) and neuroimaging by magnetic resonance imaging across up to five time points over a period of up to 21 years (N pooled DNAm = 12,877; N pooled neuroimaging = 10,899; N pooled combined = 6074). By triangulating associations across multiple developmental time points and study types, we hope to generate new insights into the dynamic relationships between peripheral DNA methylation and the brain, and how these ultimately relate to neurodevelopmental and psychiatric phenotypes.

items.title_zh: 甲基化、成像与神经发育（MIND）联盟简介
items.summary_zh: 甲基化、成像与神经发育（MIND）联盟旨在通过结合表观遗传学和神经影像学数据，填补外周表观遗传模式与大脑个体差异之间的研究空白。该联盟强调发展性研究，采用多队列分析，推动科学严谨性，建立共享流程和开放科学实践。MIND联盟整合了全球16个队列的数据，涵盖了外周组织（血液、口腔细胞和唾液）中的DNA甲基化（methylation）和磁共振成像（MRI）在长达21年的时间内的多次测量。这一研究将有助于深入理解不同发育阶段（从出生到新兴成年期）DNA甲基化与大脑动态之间的关系。

items.title: Exploring the relationships between Early Childhood Adversity, Social Cognition, and Aggression in a South African Study of People Living with Schizophrenia.
items.body: People living with schizophrenia (PLS) are at increased risk of being both victims and perpetrators of violence. Recent research suggests that social cognitive impairments may contribute to heightened aggression in schizophrenia. Childhood trauma, a well-established risk factor for both schizophrenia and aggression, is also linked to more severe cognitive deficits in PLS. Few studies have explored the relationships between childhood trauma, social cognition, and aggression in large sample sizes, particularly in low- and middle-income settings, where varying socioeconomic factors and exposure to violence may influence these associations. In this study, a subsample of participants (PLS = 585; controls = 882) from the Genomics of Schizophrenia in the South African Xhosa People study completed The Childhood Trauma Questionnaire (CTQ), Penn Emotion Identification Test (ER), Life History of Aggression Questionnaire (LHA), and Structured Diagnostic Interview for DSM-IV Axis I Disorders. Group differences in CTQ, ER, LHA, and selected demographic and clinical factors were assessed using t -tests and chi-square tests. Multivariable linear regressions were employed to test for associations among CTQ, ER, and LHA. We found that PLS had significantly higher childhood trauma and lifetime aggression scores and poorer emotion recognition performance than controls. Higher childhood trauma was associated with higher lifetime aggression and worse emotion recognition performance. However, emotion recognition performance was not associated with lifetime aggression. In this setting, childhood trauma predicts lifetime aggression and poorer emotion recognition, but there is no evidence that emotion recognition ability is related to aggression.
items.authors: van der Walt K, Wootton O, Rokicki J, Vaskinn A, Jonker D, Campbell M, Susser E, Haukvik UK, Gur RC, Stein DJ, Friestad C.
items.title_zh: 南非精神分裂症患者早期逆境、社会认知与攻击性关系研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了生活在南非的精神分裂症患者（PLS）中，早期儿童创伤、社会认知和攻击性之间的关系。研究发现，PLS在儿童创伤和终生攻击性评分上显著高于对照组，并且情绪识别能力较差。儿童创伤被认为是精神分裂症和攻击性的已知风险因素，且与PLS的认知缺陷更为严重相关。研究使用了585名PLS和882名对照的样本，完成了儿童创伤问卷（CTQ）、宾州情绪识别测试（ER）、攻击性历史问卷（LHA）及DSM-IV轴I障碍结构化诊断访谈。通过t检验和卡方检验评估了CTQ、ER、LHA及相关人口和临床因素的组间差异，并采用多变量线性回归分析CTQ、ER和LHA之间的关联。结果表明，儿童创伤程度越高，攻击性越强，提示社会认知缺陷可能加剧精神分裂症患者的攻击性行为。

items.title: Problematic usage of the internet: Converging and diverging terminologies and constructs.
items.body: Problematic usage of the internet (PUI) is an increasing global concern, leading to significant negative impacts in various levels. PUI is an umbrella term comprised of subcategories, including online gaming disorder, online gambling disorder, online buying-shopping disorder, online compulsive sexual behavior disorder, problematic usage of social media, cyberchondria, cyberbullying, and digital hoarding. With respect to the diversity of these categories, a factor that further impedes the field of PUI is not recognizing these subcategories under the PUI. To estimate the state of the field, we conducted a systematic review on a sample time frame, 2022-2023, and we found that among 2,497 relevant papers, only 13% of the studies on PUI subcategories used PUI as an umbrella term. Establishing PUI as an overarching terminology, as we do with substance use disorder (SUD) as a term while respecting the diversities within its subcategories, would synergize research efforts, facilitate comparisons, and inform treatment strategies. As technology continues to evolve, terminological refinement is critical to maintaining relevance and accessibility for researchers and the broader community.
items.authors: Zare-Bidoky M, Baldacchino AM, Baldacchino AM, Demetrovics Z, Fineberg NA, Kamali M, Khazaal Y, Potenza MN, Stein DJ, Ekhtiari H.
items.title_zh: 互联网问题使用的术语与构念的汇聚与分歧
items.summary_zh: 互联网问题使用（Problematic usage of the internet, PUI）日益成为全球关注的议题，带来了显著的负面影响。PUI是一个涵盖多个子类别的总称，包括网络游戏障碍、网络赌博障碍、在线购物障碍、强迫性网络性行为障碍、社交媒体问题使用、网络健康焦虑、网络欺凌和数字囤积等。研究发现，在2022至2023年间的2497篇相关论文中，仅有13%的研究将PUI作为总称使用。将PUI确立为一个总体术语，类似于物质使用障碍（Substance Use Disorder, SUD），能够促进研究协作、便于比较并指导治疗策略。随着技术的不断发展，术语的细化对于保持研究的相关性和可及性至关重要。

items.title: New Genomics Discoveries Across the Bipolar Disorder Spectrum Implicate Neurobiological and Developmental Pathways.
items.body: Bipolar disorder (BD) is a highly heritable mental disorder that affects millions of people worldwide. Our understanding of the genetic etiology and biological processes that underlie BD have greatly increased in recent years. Extensive progress has been made in identifying common variant signals for BD, and the polygenic score from the latest genome-wide association study (GWAS) may provide some clinical utility if combined with other risk factors for BD. The role of rare variation in BD remains to be determined, although genes annotated to common variant loci are shown to be enriched for rare variation. BD subtypes have been shown to differ in their genetic architecture, and as such, genetic studies across the subtypes of the BD spectrum will identify subtype-specific signals and reveal subtype-specific biological mechanisms. Despite this, subtype-specific GWAS sample sizes have not increased at the same rate as BD cases, and more concerted efforts are required to obtain this information for participants included in future BD GWASs. Moreover, assessment of culture, geography, and other systematic differences that may impact patient assessment will be necessary to ensure accurate inclusion of diverse ancestral groups and global representation in genetic studies of BD moving forward.

items.title_zh: 新发现揭示双相障碍的神经生物学与发展路径
items.summary_zh: 双相障碍（BD）是一种高度遗传的心理疾病，影响全球数百万人。近年来，我们对BD的遗传病因和生物过程的理解显著提高。研究已在识别BD的常见变异信号方面取得了重大进展，最新的全基因组关联研究（GWAS）中的多基因评分若与其他风险因素结合，可能具有一定的临床应用价值。尽管尚未确定稀有变异在BD中的作用，但与常见变异位点相关的基因显示出稀有变异的富集。不同BD亚型的遗传结构存在差异，因此对BD谱系各亚型的遗传研究将识别特定信号并揭示特定生物机制。然而，亚型特异性GWAS的样本量未能与BD病例的增长同步，未来需要更有针对性的努力以获取相关信息。此外，评估文化、地理及其他系统性差异对于确保在BD的遗传研究中准确纳入多样的祖先群体和全球代表性至关重要。

items.title: A whole-brain voxel-based analysis of structural abnormalities in PTSD: An ENIGMA-PGC study.
items.body: Background Patients with posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) exhibit smaller regional brain volumes in commonly reported regions including the amygdala and hippocampus, regions associated with fear and memory processing. In the current study, we have conducted a voxel-based morphometry (VBM) meta-analysis using whole-brain statistical maps with neuroimaging data from the ENIGMA-PGC PTSD working group. Methods T1-weighted structural neuroimaging scans from 36 cohorts (PTSD n = 1309; controls n = 2198) were processed using a standardized VBM pipeline (ENIGMA-VBM tool). We meta-analyzed the resulting statistical maps for voxel-wise differences in gray matter (GM) and white matter (WM) volumes between PTSD patients and controls, performed subgroup analyses considering the trauma exposure of the controls, and examined associations between regional brain volumes and clinical variables including PTSD (CAPS-4/5, PCL-5) and depression severity (BDI-II, PHQ-9). Results PTSD patients exhibited smaller GM volumes across the frontal and temporal lobes, and cerebellum, with the most significant effect in the left cerebellum (Hedges' g = 0.22, p corrected = .001), and smaller cerebellar WM volume (peak Hedges' g = 0.14, p corrected = .008). We observed similar regional differences when comparing patients to trauma-exposed controls, suggesting these structural abnormalities may be specific to PTSD. Regression analyses revealed PTSD severity was negatively associated with GM volumes within the cerebellum ( p corrected = .003), while depression severity was negatively associated with GM volumes within the cerebellum and superior frontal gyrus in patients ( p corrected = .001). Conclusions PTSD patients exhibited widespread, regional differences in brain volumes where greater regional deficits appeared to reflect more severe symptoms. Our findings add to the growing literature implicating the cerebellum in PTSD psychopathology.

items.title_zh: PTSD患者脑结构异常的全脑体素分析：ENIGMA-PGC研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）患者的脑结构异常进行了全脑体素基础的形态学元分析。研究发现，PTSD患者在前额叶、颞叶和小脑等区域的灰质（GM）体积较小，尤其在左小脑的影响最为显著（Hedges' g = 0.22, p 校正 = .001）。此外，小脑的白质（WM）体积也较小（峰值Hedges' g = 0.14, p 校正 = .008）。通过与经历过创伤的对照组进行比较，结果显示这些结构异常可能特异于PTSD患者。研究使用了来自36个队列的T1加权结构神经影像数据，分析了PTSD患者与对照组之间的体素差异，并考虑了对照组的创伤暴露情况及其与临床变量（如PTSD和抑郁严重程度）的关联。

items.title: Ethical Considerations in Psychiatric Genomics.
items.body: The ethics of psychiatric genetics and genomics is an emerging field, distinct from general genetics. Key ethical concerns include the implications for personhood and identity, the dual perception of psychiatric conditions as both afflictions and integral aspects of identity, and the unique vulnerabilities of affected populations regarding informed consent. The multifactorial nature of psychiatric disorders, characterized by complex genetic and environmental interactions, further complicates ethical considerations. This paper explores ethical issues in psychiatric genomic research, clinical applications, and prevention efforts, emphasizing the need for a multidisciplinary approach and the importance of context sensitivity, particularly in low-and-middle-income countries.
items.journal: The Psychiatric clinics of North America
items.authors: Stein DJ, Hartford A.
items.title_zh: 精神病学基因组学中的伦理考量
items.summary_zh: 精神病学遗传学和基因组学的伦理问题是一个新兴领域，与一般遗传学有所不同。主要伦理关注点包括对个人身份和自我的影响、精神疾病作为痛苦和身份重要组成部分的双重认知，以及受影响人群在知情同意方面的独特脆弱性。精神障碍的多因素特性，表现为复杂的遗传与环境交互，进一步复杂化了伦理考量。本文探讨了精神病学基因组研究、临床应用和预防工作中的伦理问题，强调了多学科方法的必要性以及在低收入和中等收入国家中对情境敏感性的重视。

items.title: Comparison between accelerated and standard or sham rTMS in the treatment of depression: A systematic review.
items.body: Major depressive disorder (MDD) represents a major global health challenge, with a significant proportion of patients being resistant to drug treatment (TRD). Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) has shown promise in the treatment of MDD/TRD, with a single stimulation session per day for five days per week over several weeks (the "standard" protocol). The two main paradigms used are high-frequency rTMS and intermittent theta burst stimulation (iTBS) delivered to the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC). Accelerated TMS (aTMS) protocols aim to make the treatment more effective, or at least more rapidly effective, by delivering more stimulations in a shorter time, which could also facilitate the implementation of the protocols for a larger number of patients. In this systematic literature review, articles comparing in the same study an aTMS protocol to a standard or sham rTMS protocol were retained for analysis. Thus, 23 articles were retained and the analysis focused on the efficacy of aTMS protocols used for the treatment of depression (MDD/TRD) as well as on the impact of various stimulation parameters, such as stimulation pattern, intersession interval, dosage, and methods of cortical targeting. Although some studies did not report significant differences between aTMS and standard or sham protocols, others suggested potential advantages of aTMS, such as twice-daily HF-rTMS of the left DLPFC or more intensive iTBS protocols with a long interval between two sessions and personalized cortical targeting. Our results highlight the influence of the number of sessions or pulses per session (dosage), the duration of the interval between sessions, and the precision of target localization (using image-guided neuronavigation) on therapeutic efficacy. However, limitations in sample size, few independent studies replicating the same methodology, and variability in the clinical profile of treated patients, given different definitions of treatment resistance or the presence of comorbidities, hamper definitive conclusions.

items.title_zh: 加速与标准或假刺激rTMS治疗抑郁症的比较研究
items.summary_zh: 重度抑郁障碍（MDD）是全球健康的重要挑战，部分患者对药物治疗（TRD）产生耐药性。重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）在MDD/TRD治疗中显示出良好前景，标准方案为每周五天每天一次刺激。主要使用高频rTMS和间歇性θ波刺激（iTBS）作用于左侧背外侧前额叶皮层（DLPFC）。加速TMS（aTMS）方案旨在通过在更短时间内提供更多刺激，提高治疗效果或加快见效速度，从而使更多患者受益。本系统文献综述分析了比较aTMS与标准或假刺激rTMS方案的23篇文章，重点评估aTMS在抑郁症治疗中的有效性及各种刺激参数的影响。尽管部分研究未发现aTMS与标准或假刺激方案间显著差异，但其他研究则指出aTMS可能具有潜在优势。

items.title: Global study aims to unpack mental health issues facing university students
items.body: Many students suffer from mental illness but universities have limited support services.
items.authors: Dan J. Stein
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/dan-j-stein-376345（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 全球研究揭示大学生面临的心理健康问题
items.summary_zh: 许多大学生遭受心理疾病的困扰，但高校提供的支持服务有限。研究指出，心理健康问题在大学生中普遍存在，影响他们的学习和生活质量。尽管有需求，许多大学的心理健康服务资源不足，无法满足学生的需求。研究呼吁高校加强心理健康支持，提供更多的资源和服务，以帮助学生应对心理健康挑战，提升整体福祉。

items.title: The rising tide of drug-induced psychosis.
items.body: Recreational use of psychotogenic drugs has become more common in the last 30 years with consequent increase in drug-induced psychosis; 25-50% of such psychoses progress to schizophrenia within 5 years. Most cases result from abuse of methamphetamine or cannabis. The spread of methamphetamine psychosis has occurred without any liberalisation of laws; it is highly addictive and easy to make in small "kitchen" labs. The increase in cannabis use has been facilitated by a softening of attitudes towards the drug, and in some countries, especially in North America, by legalisation for so-called "medicinal use" and then recreational use. The potency of cannabis has greatly increased, especially in countries that have legalised its use, and the worldwide legal sales of cannabis for 2025 are estimated at $ 65 billion. The consequences are being seen with many reports of increases in the incidence of cannabis-psychosis and schizophrenia. In the 1980s some physicians predicted an epidemic of obesity and diabetes due to changes in diet and life style. Sadly, their predictions were correct. We are now at the beginning of a similar epidemic of drug-induced psychosis. Public education campaigns of the type that decreased tobacco smoking are necessary to avoid psychiatric services being overwhelmed.
items.journal: Neuropsychiatrie : Klinik, Diagnostik, Therapie und Rehabilitation : Organ der Gesellschaft Osterreichischer Nervenarzte und Psychiater
items.authors: Murray RM, Paparelli A, Di Forti M, Morrison P.
items.title_zh: 药物诱发精神病的上升潮流
items.summary_zh: 在过去30年中，精神药物的娱乐性使用日益普遍，导致药物诱发精神病的病例增加；25-50%的此类精神病在5年内进展为精神分裂症。大多数病例源于对甲基苯丙胺（methamphetamine）或大麻（cannabis）的滥用。甲基苯丙胺精神病的传播发生在法律未放宽的情况下，其高度成瘾且易于在小型“厨房”实验室中制造。大麻使用的增加得益于对该药物态度的软化，以及在一些国家（尤其是北美）对所谓“医疗用途”及后来的娱乐用途的合法化。大麻的效力显著提高，预计2025年全球合法大麻销售额将达到650亿美元。随着大麻精神病和精神分裂症病例的增加，这一趋势的后果已显现。我们正处于药物诱发精神病类似流行病的开端，需要开展公共教育活动，以避免精神卫生服务被淹没。

items.title: Domain-specific cognitive function in euthymic bipolar disorder: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.body: Background Euthymic bipolar disorder (BD) is associated with general and domain-specific cognitive impairment, which predicts poor occupational and social functioning. Methods We searched Embase, Medline, and PsycInfo for articles published between database inception and June 2024, examining cognitive domains in euthymic BD. We conducted meta-analysis, meta-regressions, including premorbid IQ, demographic, and clinical variables. Newcastle Ottawa Scale, I 2 statistic, and funnel plots/Egger's and Begg's Test were used to assess quality, heterogeneity, and publication bias, respectively. The Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) procedure was utilised for multiple comparisons. Results We identified 95 groups from 75 studies ( N = 4,404 BD & 4,037 HC). BD showed significant impairment in general cognitive functioning (Hedge's g = -0.58, 95%CI: -0.79, -0.37, p g = -0.70, 95%CI: -0.79, -0.60, p g = -0.69, 95%CI: -0.78, -0.60, p g = -0.68, 95%CI: -0.83, -0.53, p g = -0.64, 95%CI: -0.75, -0.54, p g = -0.61, 95%CI: -0.74, -0.49, p g = -0.24, 95%CI: -0.36, -0.12, p β = .066, adjusted p Conclusions Our findings highlight cognitive domains impaired in euthymic BD, indicating targets for interventions. Substantial variance is unexplained, warranting focus on larger samples of individual-level data.
items.authors: Swidzinski S, Tsapekos D, Swidzinska P, Zhang W, Zheng M, Millgate E, Strawbridge R, Short R, Carter B, Gallagher P, Zanelli J, Kravariti E, Reichenberg A, Young AH, Murray RM, Jauhar S.
items.title_zh: 躁郁症稳定期的领域特异性认知功能：系统评估与荟萃分析
items.summary_zh: 本研究系统评估了躁郁症（BD）稳定期患者的认知功能，发现其在一般和特定认知领域均存在显著损害，预测其职业和社交功能较差。通过对75项研究的95组数据进行荟萃分析，结果显示BD患者在一般认知功能（Hedge's g = -0.58）、注意力（Hedge's g = -0.70）、执行功能（Hedge's g = -0.69）、记忆（Hedge's g = -0.68）、语言（Hedge's g = -0.64）、视觉空间能力（Hedge's g = -0.61）等领域均显著受损。研究还指出，尽管发现了认知领域的损害，但仍有大量变异未被解释，建议未来研究应关注更大样本的个体数据，以便更深入了解躁郁症患者的认知功能障碍。

items.title: Genetic and structural aspects of amyloid diseases.
items.body: The conversion of proteins into insoluble fibrillar aggregates known as amyloid occurs in a wide variety of diseases, e.g., Alzheimer's disease, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, systemic transthyretin amyloidosis, and multisystem atrophy. There are more than 60 disease-associated amyloid-forming proteins, and amyloid formation can occur sporadically or can be induced or accelerated by genetic mutations. This Review discusses structural mechanisms by which genetic changes promote amyloid formation and thereby influence disease outcomes. By dividing amyloid-forming proteins into six types according to the genetic mutations they carry and analyzing mutation-induced structural changes in amyloid fibrils, a better understanding of inheritance patterns of amyloid diseases (amyloidoses) can be obtained.
items.authors: Rosenberg GM, Murray KA, Sawaya MR, Jiang YX, Geschwind DH, Eisenberg DS.
items.title_zh: 淀粉样蛋白疾病的遗传与结构特征
items.summary_zh: 淀粉样蛋白（amyloid）是指蛋白质转变为不溶性纤维状聚集体的过程，这一现象出现在多种疾病中，如阿尔茨海默病、肌萎缩侧索硬化症、全身性转甲状腺素淀粉样变性及多系统萎缩等。目前已知有超过60种与疾病相关的淀粉样形成蛋白，淀粉样形成可以是偶发的，也可以因遗传突变而诱发或加速。本文评述了遗传变化如何通过结构机制促进淀粉样形成，并影响疾病结果。通过将淀粉样形成蛋白根据其携带的遗传突变分为六类，并分析突变引起的淀粉样纤维结构变化，可以更好地理解淀粉样疾病（淀粉样变性）的遗传模式。

items.title: Monitoring of amyloid related imaging abnormalities: SWI vs T2*-GRE.
items.body: Amyloid-β-directed monoclonal antibody therapies may lead to amyloid-related imaging abnormalities (ARIA). Clinical trials that formed the basis for the ARIA radiographic severity grading scale adopted by the approved drugs' labels utilized T2* gradient recalled echo (T2*-GRE) images for ARIA-hemorrhagic (ARIA-H) assessment. Little is known about the application of susceptibility-weighted imaging (SWI) to ARIA-H assessment. We exploited comparative studies on the usage of SWI instead of 2D T2*-GRE and simulated the impact of SWI's higher sensitivity on the derived ARIA-H severity distribution for three approved drugs. The simulations indicated that the two sequences are not equivalent when grading ARIA-H severity and that the rate of therapy discontinuation would increase by more than 50% compared to the rates reported in the drugs' prescribing information. This should be taken into consideration whenever SWI is applied for ARIA safety monitoring. Appropriate imaging guidelines are needed to enhance management of amyloid-β-directed antibody therapies.
items.journal: The journal of prevention of Alzheimer's disease
items.authors: Sima DM, Phan TV, Franceschi AM, Gibbs WN, Barkhof F, Scheltens P, Salloway S, Cummings J, Van Hecke W, Smeets D.
items.title_zh: 监测淀粉样蛋白相关影像异常：SWI与T2*-GRE的比较
items.summary_zh: 淀粉样β（Amyloid-β）单克隆抗体疗法可能导致淀粉样蛋白相关影像异常（ARIA）。临床试验中，ARIA放射学严重性分级采用了T2*梯度回波（T2*-GRE）影像进行ARIA-出血（ARIA-H）评估，而关于敏感性加权影像（SWI）在ARIA-H评估中的应用知之甚少。研究表明，SWI相较于2D T2*-GRE在评估ARIA-H严重性时具有更高的敏感性，模拟结果显示两种序列在分级时并不等效，且治疗中断率可能比药物说明书中报告的高出50%以上。因此，在使用SWI进行ARIA安全监测时，需考虑这一点，并亟需制定适当的影像学指南以改善淀粉样β抗体疗法的管理。

items.title: Global emergence of unprecedented lifetime exposure to climate extremes.
items.body: Climate extremes are escalating under anthropogenic climate change 1 . Yet, how this translates into unprecedented cumulative extreme event exposure in a person's lifetime remains unclear. Here we use climate models, impact models and demographic data to project the number of people experiencing cumulative lifetime exposure to climate extremes above the 99.99th percentile of exposure expected in a pre-industrial climate. We project that the birth cohort fraction facing this unprecedented lifetime exposure to heatwaves, crop failures, river floods, droughts, wildfires and tropical cyclones will at least double from 1960 to 2020 under current mitigation policies aligned with a global warming pathway reaching 2.7 °C above pre-industrial temperatures by 2100. Under a 1.5 °C pathway, 52% of people born in 2020 will experience unprecedented lifetime exposure to heatwaves. If global warming reaches 3.5 °C by 2100, this fraction rises to 92% for heatwaves, 29% for crop failures and 14% for river floods. The chance of facing unprecedented lifetime exposure to heatwaves is substantially larger among population groups characterized by high socioeconomic vulnerabilities. Our results call for deep and sustained greenhouse gas emissions reductions to lower the burden of climate change on current young generations.
items.authors: Grant L, Vanderkelen I, Gudmundsson L, Fischer E, Seneviratne SI, Thiery W.
items.title_zh: 气候极端事件对人类终生影响的全球性上升
items.summary_zh: 在气候变化的背景下，气候极端事件的发生频率正在上升。本文利用气候模型、影响模型和人口数据，预测在2100年之前，经历超过工业化前气候99.99百分位数的气候极端事件的人的数量。研究表明，1960年至2020年间，面临热浪、农作物失败、河流洪水、干旱、野火和热带气旋等极端事件的出生队列比例将在现行减缓政策下至少翻倍。如果全球变暖达到1.5°C，2020年出生的52%的人将经历前所未有的热浪终生暴露；而若全球变暖达到3.5°C，这一比例将上升至92%（热浪）、29%（农作物失败）和14%（河流洪水）。高社会经济脆弱性群体面临的热浪终生暴露风险显著更高。研究结果呼吁采取深度和持续的温室气体减排，以减轻气候变化对当前年轻一代的影响。

items.title: Green finance? Why global banks are pledging billions to fight climate change
items.body: Announcing green finance packages is one way of deflecting criticism for fossil fuel investments.
items.authors: Simon A. Wilde
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/simon-wilde-422290（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 全球银行为何承诺数十亿抗击气候变化
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了全球银行在应对气候变化方面承诺巨额资金的现象，指出这是一种转移对化石燃料投资批评的策略。通过推出绿色金融（green finance）计划，银行试图改善其公众形象，尽管其在传统能源领域的投资仍然庞大。文章强调，尽管这些承诺看似积极，但实际效果和对气候变化的真正影响仍需进一步观察和评估。

items.title: How will this year’s record breaking El Niño affect NZ and the world? 5 things to know
items.body: From global temperature records to drought risk in New Zealand, the developing climate pattern could have far-reaching consequences.
items.authors: Kevin E. Trenberth
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/kevin-trenberth-15259（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 今年创纪录的厄尔尼诺现象将如何影响新西兰及全球？
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了当前发展中的厄尔尼诺现象（El Niño）对新西兰及全球的潜在影响。厄尔尼诺现象可能导致全球气温创纪录上升，并增加新西兰的干旱风险。文章指出，这一气候模式的变化可能会对农业、生态系统和水资源管理产生深远影响。通过分析气候数据和预测模型，作者强调了全球变暖与厄尔尼诺现象之间的关系，指出其可能引发的极端天气事件。结论表明，了解和应对厄尔尼诺现象的影响对于制定有效的气候适应策略至关重要。

items.title: Le système mondial d’observation des océans est en danger : sans les États Unis, l’Europe et l’Asie doivent jouer un rôle global
items.body: Arrêter de financer le système global de mesure de l’océan met en danger nos capacités de prévisions météorologiques et d’anticipation – ce qui coûterait au final bien plus cher que ce système lui-même.
items.authors: Kevin E. Trenberth
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/kevin-trenberth-15259（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 全球海洋观测系统面临危机：欧美亚需共同应对
items.summary_zh: 本文指出，停止资助全球海洋观测系统将危及气象预报和预警能力，最终造成的经济损失将远超该系统的维护成本。科学家强调，尤其在美国减少投入的情况下，欧洲和亚洲国家必须承担起全球责任，以确保海洋观测系统的持续运行和有效性。

items.title: Ocean monitoring is in trouble: without the US, it’s up to Europe and Asia to avoid losing sight of the world’s deep sea ecosystems
items.body: Defunding marine monitoring networks could jeopardise efforts to avoid losing track of the world’s oceans and their precious ecosystems, which drive the blue economy.
items.authors: Kevin E. Trenberth
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/kevin-trenberth-15259（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 海洋监测面临困境：缺乏美国支持，欧洲和亚洲需接力
items.summary_zh: 文章指出，海洋监测网络的资金削减可能会危及全球海洋及其珍贵生态系统的监测工作，这些生态系统是蓝色经济（blue economy）的重要驱动力。作者强调，若美国不再主导海洋监测，欧洲和亚洲国家必须承担起责任，以避免对深海生态系统的失去关注。文章呼吁国际社会重视海洋监测的重要性，以确保可持续发展和生态保护。

items.title: The network watching the world’s oceans is under pressure – just when it’s needed most
items.body: The Global Ocean Observing System informs weather forecasts and climate projections. But funding pressures could create data gaps leaving the world blind.
items.authors: Kevin E. Trenberth
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/kevin-trenberth-15259（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 全球海洋观测系统面临压力，亟需支持
items.summary_zh: 全球海洋观测系统（Global Ocean Observing System）为天气预报和气候预测提供重要数据。然而，资金压力可能导致数据缺口，使全球在应对气候变化和极端天气时失去重要信息来源。文章指出，当前的资金不足可能影响海洋监测网络的有效性，进而影响科学研究和政策制定。随着气候变化的加剧，确保海洋观测系统的持续运作显得尤为重要，以便为全球提供准确的气候信息和预警。

items.title: What northern NZ’s wet and sticky summer reveals about our warming atmosphere
items.body: Behind this summer’s floods and slips is a simple signal we rarely talk about: humidity. As the climate warms, NZ will need to pay closer attention.
items.authors: Kevin E. Trenberth
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/kevin-trenberth-15259（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 北岛潮湿夏季揭示气候变暖的信号
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了新西兰北岛今年夏季的洪水和滑坡现象，指出其背后反映出一个重要但常被忽视的因素——湿度（humidity）。随着气候变暖，新西兰需要更加关注湿度对天气模式的影响。文章强调，湿度的增加可能导致更频繁和更严重的极端天气事件，这对生态系统和人类生活都构成威胁。通过分析气候变化与湿度之间的关系，作者呼吁公众和政策制定者重视这一现象，以便更好地应对未来的气候挑战。

items.title: NZ is again being soaked this summer – record ocean heat helps explain it
items.body: Understanding what is happening deep beneath the ocean surface is key to understanding the weather patterns we are experiencing on land.
items.authors: Kevin E. Trenberth
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/kevin-trenberth-15259（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 新西兰今夏再遭暴雨，海洋热量创纪录助解释现象
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了新西兰今夏频繁降雨的原因，强调了海洋表层下的热量变化对天气模式的影响。研究指出，海洋热量的上升与气候变化密切相关，这种变化不仅影响了海洋生态系统，也直接影响了陆地的气候条件。通过分析海洋温度数据，科学家们发现，海洋热量的增加导致了更强的气候系统，从而引发了新西兰的极端天气现象。文章强调，深入理解海洋深处的动态对于预测和应对未来的天气变化至关重要。

items.title: How rising water vapour in the atmosphere is amplifying warming and making extreme weather worse
items.body: As the atmosphere warms, it can hold more moisture. This brings more intense downpours but also accelerates warming – because water vapour is a powerful greenhouse gas.
items.authors: Kevin E. Trenberth
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/kevin-trenberth-15259（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 大气水蒸气上升如何加剧极端天气
items.summary_zh: 随着大气变暖，它能够容纳更多的水分。这导致降水更加猛烈，同时也加速了全球变暖，因为水蒸气是一种强效温室气体。研究表明，水蒸气的增加不仅使得降雨事件更加频繁和强烈，还进一步推动了气候变化的进程，从而形成恶性循环。这一现象对极端天气事件的频率和强度产生了显著影响，预示着未来气候变化可能带来的更大挑战。

items.title: Meeting the long term climate threat takes more than private investment – 10 ways NZ can be smart and strategic
items.body: The BlackRock climate fund is a start, but New Zealand needs a comprehensive approach to tackling its various environmental and economic vulnerabilities to the climate crisis.
items.authors: Kevin E. Trenberth
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/kevin-trenberth-15259（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 应对气候威胁 新西兰需综合战略而非单靠投资
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了新西兰在应对气候危机时的策略，指出虽然黑石集团（BlackRock）的气候基金是一个良好的开端，但新西兰需要采取更全面的方法来应对其在环境和经济方面的脆弱性。文章强调，仅依赖私人投资不足以解决气候变化带来的长期威胁，呼吁制定更智能和战略性的政策，以有效应对气候挑战。

items.title: Cells lining your skin and organs can generate electricity when injured − potentially opening new doors to treating wounds
items.body: Textbooks usually depict the epithelial cells encasing the interior and exterior of your body as passive barriers. But researchers discovered they can produce electrical signals like neurons.
items.authors: Min Sun
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/sun-min-yu-2345749（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 皮肤和器官细胞受伤时可产生电信号，或助于伤口治疗
items.summary_zh: 传统教科书将包裹身体内外的上皮细胞视为被动屏障，但研究发现这些细胞在受伤时能够像神经元一样产生电信号。这一发现可能为伤口治疗开辟新的方向，提示上皮细胞在生理和病理过程中可能扮演更为主动的角色。

items.title_zh: 破解澳大利亚史前巨蛋之谜
items.summary_zh: 关于一种已灭绝鸟类的身份之谜得以解决，该鸟类在澳大利亚各地产卵。科学家们通过对化石的研究，结合现代鸟类的遗传数据，确定了这种鸟类的特征及其生态环境。这一发现不仅揭示了该鸟类的生物学特性，还为理解澳大利亚古代生态系统提供了重要线索。研究表明，这种鸟类与现存的某些鸟类有着密切的亲缘关系，进一步丰富了我们对鸟类进化历史的认识。

items.title: Why Antarctica’s sea ice cover is so low (and no, it’s not just about climate change)
items.body: Antarctic sea ice cover fell to an all-time low recently and hasn’t yet recovered. Why? The initial answers could lie in an unlikely place – the tropics.

items.title_zh: 南极海冰覆盖率为何如此低？不仅仅是气候变化
items.summary_zh: 南极海冰覆盖率近期降至历史最低水平，尚未恢复。文章探讨了这一现象的原因，指出初步答案可能与热带地区有关。研究表明，热带气候变化对南极海冰的影响可能被低估，热带地区的气温升高和风模式变化可能导致南极海冰的减少。这一发现挑战了传统观点，认为南极海冰变化主要由气候变化驱动。文章强调，理解南极海冰的变化需要考虑更广泛的气候系统相互作用，而不仅仅局限于南极自身的气候因素。

items.title: Russia’s invasion of Ukraine is proof the EU needs to get better at stopping mass atrocities
items.body: The war’s one-year anniversary is eerily close to that of an EU report on the prevention of mass atrocities. Ten years later, its authors reflect on what the bloc could have done differently.

items.title_zh: 俄罗斯入侵乌克兰证明欧盟需改善防止大规模暴行能力
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了俄罗斯入侵乌克兰一周年与欧盟（EU）关于防止大规模暴行的报告之间的关系。十年后，报告的作者反思欧盟在应对大规模暴行方面可以采取的不同措施。文章指出，当前的冲突凸显了欧盟在预防和应对人道危机方面的不足，强调了加强机制和政策的重要性，以更有效地应对未来的危机。

items.body: En plongeant ses héros dans une compétition de natation synchronisée, « Le grand bain » vient questionner la masculinité hégémonique et notre vision de la virilité.

items.title_zh: 电影《大浴场》中的男性危机探讨
items.summary_zh: 《大浴场》以一位在花样游泳比赛中奋斗的男性为主角，探讨了霸权男性气质（hegemonic masculinity）及其对男性身份的影响。影片通过展示男性在传统性别角色中的挣扎，质疑了社会对男性气质的刻板印象。通过对角色之间关系的深入分析，影片揭示了男性在面对脆弱和情感时的困境，挑战了传统的男性形象。最终，影片呼吁对男性气质的重新审视，强调情感表达和脆弱性的重要性。

items.body: A travers la figure du sportif, le film « Indian Horse » de Stephen Campanelli dénonce le racisme et les abus sexuels dont ont été victimes de nombreux amérindiens.

items.title_zh: 电影《印第安马》揭示美洲原住民身份困境
items.summary_zh: 斯蒂芬·坎帕内利（Stephen Campanelli）执导的电影《印第安马》（Indian Horse）通过运动员的形象，揭示了许多美洲原住民所遭受的种族主义和性虐待问题。影片不仅反映了历史上的不公正待遇，还强调了这些经历对个体身份的深远影响。通过生动的叙述和角色塑造，电影呼吁观众关注和反思美洲原住民的困境，挑战社会对其身份的刻板印象。

items.title: Royal Society president: GM crops feed much of the world today – why not tomorrow’s generations?

items.title_zh: 皇家学会会长：转基因作物能养活未来世代
items.summary_zh: 皇家学会会长指出，科学与技术一直以来帮助我们解决全球粮食问题，转基因作物（GM crops）在这一方面具有更大的潜力。如果我们愿意接受转基因技术，它将能够为未来的世代提供更多的粮食保障。文章强调了转基因作物在提高产量、抵抗病虫害及适应气候变化等方面的优势，认为这些技术的应用可以有效应对全球粮食安全的挑战。通过科学的进步，我们有机会为未来的世代创造更可持续的农业解决方案。

items.title: Integrated information and predictive processing theories of consciousness: An adversarial collaborative review.
items.body: As neuroscientific theories of consciousness continue to proliferate, the need to assess their similarities and differences - as well as their predictive and explanatory power - becomes ever more pressing. Recently, a number of structured adversarial collaborations have been devised to test the competing predictions of several candidate theories of consciousness. In this review, we compare and contrast three theories being investigated in one such adversarial collaboration: Integrated Information Theory, Neurorepresentationalism, and Active Inference. We begin by presenting the core claims of each theory, before comparing them in terms of the phenomena they seek to explain, the sorts of explanations they avail, and the methodological strategies they endorse. We then consider some of the inherent challenges of theory-testing, and how adversarial collaboration addresses some of these difficulties. The stage is then set for the empirical work to come: first, we outline the key hypotheses to be tested across a series of multi-site experiments; second, we discuss the kinds of observations that would support or challenge each theory; third, we consider how these theories might assimilate or accommodate such observations. Finally, we show how data harvested across disparate experiments (and their replicates) may be formally integrated to provide a quantitative measure of the evidential support accrued under each theory. Besides orienting the reader to the theoretical foundations of our collaboration, this review aims to provide valuable meta-scientific insights into the mechanics of adversarial collaboration and theory-testing in general - including the way theories may be evaluated in terms of the scientific progress they deliver.
items.authors: Corcoran AW, Haun AM, Dorman R, Tononi G, Friston KJ, Pennartz CMA, TWCF: INTREPID Consortium.
items.title_zh: 意识的综合信息与预测处理理论的对抗性评审
items.summary_zh: 随着神经科学对意识理论的不断发展，评估这些理论的相似性、差异性及其预测和解释能力的需求愈发迫切。本文对三种在对抗性合作中研究的意识理论进行比较：综合信息理论（Integrated Information Theory）、神经表征主义（Neurorepresentationalism）和主动推理（Active Inference）。我们首先阐述每种理论的核心主张，然后比较它们所解释的现象、提供的解释类型及其采用的方法论策略。接着，我们讨论理论测试的固有挑战，以及对抗性合作如何应对这些困难。最后，我们概述将在多地点实验中测试的关键假设，讨论支持或挑战每种理论的观察类型，以及这些理论如何吸收或适应这些观察。我们还展示了如何将不同实验（及其重复实验）中收集的数据形式化整合，以提供量化的证据度量。

items.title: A Global Prospective Harmonization Framework for Suicidality, Anhedonia, and Obsessive-Compulsive Symptoms in Psychiatric Genetic Studies: A Cross-Continental Study Within the Ancestral Population Network.
items.body: This study aims to prospectively collect harmonized, quantitative, and dimensional psychiatric phenotypes (suicidality, anhedonia, and obsessive-compulsive symptoms) and information on discrimination, stigma, and unfair treatment in up to 27,500 individuals across diverse ancestries and clinical populations for genetic analysis within the NIMH Ancestral Population Network (APN). Five APN projects are participating in the current study (PUMAS-Paisa, PUMAS-NeuroGAP, KOMOGEN-D, LATINO, and SAX-II), spanning recruitment over 15 countries across the Americas, Africa, and Asia. Participants are being enrolled via the recruitment protocols specific to each participating project. The harmonized clinical battery includes the Columbia-Suicide Severity Scale, Snaith-Hamilton Pleasure Scale, and Florida Obsessive-Compulsive Inventory-II to assess suicidality, anhedonia, and obsessive-compulsive symptoms, respectively. Additionally, we use the Discrimination and Stigma Scale-Ultra Short to evaluate discrimination and stigma across cultures. This project is a pioneering effort to prospectively assess transdiagnostic phenotypes in large-scale, diverse ancestral and clinical populations (across different diagnoses) using a harmonized clinical battery, advancing genetic research in mental health in underrepresented populations.

items.title_zh: 全球精神病遗传研究中的自杀倾向、快感缺失与强迫症状统一框架
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在前瞻性地收集统一的、定量的、维度化的精神病表型（自杀倾向、快感缺失和强迫症状），以及关于歧视、污名和不公平对待的信息，涉及多达27,500名来自不同祖先和临床人群的个体，进行NIMH祖先人群网络（APN）内的遗传分析。参与本研究的五个APN项目（PUMAS-Paisa、PUMAS-NeuroGAP、KOMOGEN-D、LATINO和SAX-II）覆盖美洲、非洲和亚洲的15个国家。参与者通过各项目特定的招募协议进行招募。统一的临床评估工具包括哥伦比亚自杀严重性量表、斯奈斯-汉密尔顿快感量表和佛罗里达强迫症量表-II，分别用于评估自杀倾向、快感缺失和强迫症状。此外，我们使用歧视与污名量表-超短版评估跨文化的歧视和污名。本项目是前所未有的努力，旨在使用统一的临床评估工具前瞻性地评估大规模、多样化的祖先和临床人群中的跨诊断表型，推动在弱势人群中的心理健康遗传研究。

items.title: Pro-aging effects of chronic glucocorticoid signaling.
items.body: Glucocorticoids (GCs) are essential endocrine regulators coordinating stress responsiveness, metabolic flexibility, inflammatory resolution, and circadian physiology. While acute GC fluctuations are adaptive, sustained exposure (arising from psychosocial stress, circadian disruption, obesity, chronic inflammation, neoplasms, or steroid therapy) elicits pleiotropic effects that overlap with biological aging. Prolonged GC signaling intersects with multiple hallmarks of aging by altering nutrient sensing, suppressing autophagy, impairing mitochondrial quality control, and promoting cellular senescence. In this context, the GC-responsive polypeptide ACBP/DBI (acyl-coenzyme A [CoA]-binding protein/diazepam-binding inhibitor) has emerged as a stress-induced inhibitor of macroautophagy that amplifies several metabolic and immune consequences of GC excess linked to aging phenotypes. Clinically, chronic GC elevation is associated with earlier and more severe manifestations of age-related diseases, including metabolic syndrome, osteoporosis, sarcopenia, neurodegeneration, cardiovascular disease, immunosenescence, and cancer. Here, we review mechanistic links between GC signaling and systemic aging and discuss strategies to mitigate the age-accelerating consequences of persistent GC exposure.
items.authors: Lambertucci F, Castinetti F, Martins I, López-Otín C, Kroemer G.
items.title_zh: 慢性糖皮质激素信号的促衰老效应
items.summary_zh: 糖皮质激素（GCs）是调节应激反应、代谢灵活性、炎症解决和昼夜生理的重要内分泌因子。虽然急性GC波动具有适应性，但持续暴露（源于心理社会压力、昼夜节律紊乱、肥胖、慢性炎症、肿瘤或类固醇治疗）会引发与生物衰老重叠的多重效应。长期GC信号通过改变营养感知、抑制自噬、损害线粒体质量控制和促进细胞衰老与衰老的多个标志相交。GC响应多肽ACBP/DBI（酰基辅酶A结合蛋白/地西泮结合抑制剂）作为一种应激诱导的宏自噬抑制因子，放大了与衰老表型相关的GC过量的多种代谢和免疫后果。临床上，慢性GC升高与代谢综合症、骨质疏松、肌肉减少症、神经退行性疾病、心血管疾病、免疫衰老和癌症等年龄相关疾病的早期和严重表现相关。本文回顾了GC信号与全身衰老之间的机制联系，并讨论了减轻持续GC暴露加速衰老后果的策略。

items.title: Trial watch: antibody-drug conjugates in cancer therapy.
items.body: Antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) combine the target specificity of monoclonal antibodies with the cytotoxic potency of small-molecule payloads. In recent years ADCs have emerged as a clinically validated component of modern precision oncology. To date, more than a dozen ADCs have received FDA approval for oncologic indications, with additional agents approved regionally and hundreds of ADC-based regimens in clinical development. Collectively, these therapies have demonstrated clinical benefit across hematologic malignancies and solid tumors, including significant overall survival improvements in advanced phase clinical trials. In this Trial Watch, we provide an overview on available ADCs from early preclinical development to current clinical applications. We also summarize design principles underpinning clinically successful ADCs, including epitope targeting, linker chemistry, payload toxicity and drug-to-antibody ratio, and discuss how these features can influence pharmacokinetics, intracellular trafficking, bystander effect and toxicity. Finally, we discuss results from advanced-stage clinical trials and approved agents to define future directions.
items.authors: Doffe F, Deng X, Shen Z, Xue E, Schauer K, Kroemer G, Kepp O.
items.title_zh: 抗体药物偶联物在癌症治疗中的应用进展
items.summary_zh: 抗体药物偶联物（ADCs）结合了单克隆抗体的靶向特异性与小分子药物的细胞毒性。近年来，ADCs已成为现代精准肿瘤学中经过临床验证的重要组成部分。目前已有十多种ADCs获得FDA批准用于肿瘤治疗，此外还有多个地区性批准的药物和数百种基于ADCs的治疗方案正在临床开发中。这些疗法在血液恶性肿瘤和实体瘤中均显示出临床益处，包括在晚期临床试验中显著改善总体生存率。本文概述了从早期临床前开发到当前临床应用的ADCs，并总结了成功ADCs的设计原则，如表位靶向、连接子化学、药物毒性及药物与抗体比率，讨论了这些特征如何影响药代动力学、细胞内运输、旁观者效应和毒性。最后，文章探讨了晚期临床试验的结果及已批准药物，以明确未来的发展方向。

items.title: The prenatal sex steroid theory of autism after 25 years.
items.body: We first proposed the prenatal sex steroid theory of autism 25 years ago to account for a number of then-unexplained observations around autism, including (1) the more frequent diagnosis of autism in male than in female individuals and (2) apparent 'male-type' shifts in cognitive traits associated with autism, such as empathizing and systemizing. Here we review 25 years of research testing this theory. Early studies found that higher prenatal testosterone levels were associated with slower social, language and empathy development, greater attention to detail, stronger systemizing and more autistic traits. Subsequent studies suggested that both prenatal androgens and oestrogens are associated with autism. New methods in genetics and using stem-cell-derived neural organoids have further indicated the importance of sex steroid hormones for neurodevelopment, as well as atypical patterns in autism. These new findings support and open new lines of research into the prenatal sex steroid theory of autism.
items.authors: Baron-Cohen S, Tsompanidis A, Srivastava DP, Mill J, Lancaster MA, Adhya D, APEX consortium, Warrier V.
items.attribution_note: 协作组署名，ORCID 命中即采信
items.title_zh: 产前性激素理论与自闭症研究25年回顾
items.summary_zh: 本文回顾了产前性激素理论（prenatal sex steroid theory）提出25年来的研究进展，该理论旨在解释自闭症（autism）的一些未解现象，包括男性自闭症患者的比例高于女性，以及自闭症相关的认知特征表现出明显的“男性化”倾向，如同理心（empathizing）和系统化（systemizing）。早期研究发现，较高的产前睾酮水平与社交、语言和同理心发展缓慢、对细节的关注度更高、系统化能力更强及更多自闭症特征相关。后续研究表明，产前雄激素（androgens）和雌激素（oestrogens）均与自闭症相关。最新的遗传学方法和干细胞衍生的神经类器官（neural organoids）研究进一步强调了性激素在神经发育中的重要性，以及自闭症中的非典型模式。这些新发现支持了产前性激素理论，并为未来的研究开辟了新的方向。

items.title: Digital episodic memory tools for the identification of amnestic mild cognitive impairment: A systematic review and an exploratory meta-analysis.
items.body: Within our ageing population, the prevalence of Amnestic Mild Cognitive Impairment (aMCI) is rising, underscoring a need for early detection strategies to mitigate potential progression to dementia. Traditional pen-and-paper cognitive tests remain standard but often fail to capture subtle early impairments. Digital episodic memory tasks have emerged as a promising alternative, offering automated scoring, increased accessibility, and potentially better sensitivity to cognitive decline. We systematically evaluated the diagnostic accuracy of digital episodic memory assessments for aMCI. Thirteen studies met inclusion criteria, with six (n = 510 participants) providing sufficient data for meta-analysis. Pooled estimates showed sensitivity of 0.78 (95% CI: 0.65-0.87), specificity of 0.79 (95% CI: 0.66-0.89), and AUC of 0.86, with low to moderate heterogeneity (I² = 36.1%), largely reflecting differences in task design and administration. Both quantitative and qualitative findings suggest digital episodic memory tasks can provide accessible, scalable, and effective tools for early aMCI detection. However, design variability and construct differences highlight the need for further validation across diverse populations and improved methodological standardisation before clinical implementation.
items.authors: Moura AR, Magalhães D, Dos Santos C, Marinho F, Henriques R, Wimmer GE, Dolan RJ, Fragata I.
items.title_zh: 数字情节记忆工具在识别健忘型轻度认知障碍中的应用研究
items.summary_zh: 随着老龄化人口的增加，健忘型轻度认知障碍（aMCI）的发病率上升，迫切需要早期检测策略以减缓向痴呆的潜在进展。传统的纸笔认知测试仍是标准方法，但往往无法捕捉到早期的微妙损伤。数字情节记忆任务作为一种有前景的替代方案，提供了自动评分、提高可及性以及可能更好地敏感于认知衰退的优势。我们系统评估了数字情节记忆评估在aMCI诊断中的准确性。共有13项研究符合纳入标准，其中6项（n = 510参与者）提供了足够的数据进行荟萃分析。汇总结果显示敏感性为0.78（95% CI: 0.65-0.87），特异性为0.79（95% CI: 0.66-0.89），AUC为0.86，异质性低至中等（I² = 36.1%），主要反映任务设计和实施的差异。定量和定性结果均表明，数字情节记忆任务可以作为早期aMCI检测的可及、可扩展和有效工具。然而，设计变异性和构念差异强调了在不同人群中进一步验证和改善方法标准化的必要性，以便临床应用。

items.title: The network watching the world’s oceans is under pressure – just when it’s needed most
items.body: The Global Ocean Observing System informs weather forecasts and climate projections. But funding pressures could create data gaps leaving the world blind.
items.authors: Kevin E. Trenberth
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/kevin-trenberth-15259（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 全球海洋观测系统面临压力，亟需支持
items.summary_zh: 全球海洋观测系统（Global Ocean Observing System）为天气预报和气候预测提供重要数据。然而，资金压力可能导致数据缺口，使全球在应对气候变化和极端天气时失去重要信息来源。文章指出，当前的资金不足可能影响海洋监测网络的有效性，进而影响科学研究和政策制定。随着气候变化的加剧，确保海洋观测系统的持续运作显得尤为重要，以便为全球提供准确的气候信息和预警。

items.title: Updated trends in the global prevalence and burden of mental disorders, 1990-2023: a systematic analysis for the Global Burden of Disease Study 2023.
items.body: Background The 2023 iteration of the Global Burden of Diseases, Injuries, and Risk Factors Study (GBD) estimated prevalence, incidence, and health burden for 375 diseases and injuries, including 12 mental disorders. We assess past, current, and emerging trends in the prevalence and burden of mental disorders across sexes and age groups, for 21 regions, 204 countries and territories, and by Socio-demographic Index (SDI) quintile, from 1990 to 2023. Methods Mental disorders included in GBD 2023 were anxiety disorders, major depressive disorder, dysthymia, bipolar disorder, schizophrenia, autism spectrum disorders, conduct disorder, attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder, anorexia nervosa, bulimia nervosa, idiopathic developmental intellectual disability, and a residual category of other mental disorders. A literature review identified epidemiological data for each disorder. These were analysed via a Bayesian meta-regression to estimate prevalence by disorder, sex, age, location, and year. Disorder-specific prevalence was multiplied by disability weights representing the severity of health loss associated with each disorder to estimate years lived with disability (YLDs). Deaths due to anorexia nervosa were assessed with a Cause of Death Ensemble modelling strategy to estimate deaths by sex, age, location, and year, and then multiplied by the standard life expectancy at age of death to estimate years of life lost (YLLs). YLDs equalled disability-adjusted life-years (DALYs) for all mental disorders except anorexia nervosa (the only mental disorder considered as an underlying cause of death in GBD), for which DALYs represented the sum of YLDs and YLLs. We presented prevalence, deaths, YLDs, YLLs, and DALYs as counts, age-specific rates per 100 000 population, and age-standardised rates per 100 000 population. Findings We estimated 1·17 billion (95% uncertainty interval 1·06-1·31) prevalent cases of mental disorders globally in 2023, equivalent to an age-standardised prevalence rate of 14 210·7 cases (12 849·5-15 940·1) per 100 000 population. These estimates represented a 95·5% (75·0-121·2) increase in prevalent cases and 24·2% (11·4-41·4) increase in age-standardised prevalence rate between 1990 and 2023. All mental disorders showed increases in prevalent cases between 1990 and 2023, while notable increases were seen in age-standardised prevalence rates for anxiety disorders, major depressive disorder, dysthymia, anorexia nervosa, bulimia nervosa, schizophrenia, and conduct disorder. There were an estimated 171 million (127-228) DALYs due to mental disorders globally across sex and age in 2023, equivalent to an age-standardised DALY rate of 2070·5 DALYs (1519·1-2750·5) per 100 000 population. Mental disorders contributed to 6·1% (4·8-7·6) of all-cause DALYs in 2023, making them the fifth leading cause of global DALYs (up from 12th in 1990). DALYs were almost entirely composed of YLDs. Mental disorders were the leading cause of YLDs in 2023 (up from second in 1990), explaining 17·3% (14·8-20·6) of all-cause global YLDs. Leading causes of mental disorder DALYs were anxiety disorders (ranked 11th among the 304 diseases and injuries at Level 4 of the GBD cause hierarchy), major depressive disorder (15th), and schizophrenia (41st). Globally in 2023, mental disorder age-standardised DALY rates were higher among females (2239·6 [1643·7-3014·1] per 100 000) than among males (1900·2 [1399·8-2510·8] per 100 000), and peaked in the 15-19 years age group (2617·3 [1850·6-3696·8] per 100 000). All locations showed increased mental disorder DALY rates in 2023 compared with 1990, ranging across countries and territories from 1302·4 (952·7-1683·7) per 100 000 in Viet Nam to 3555·8 (2661·9-4715·0) per 100 000 in the Netherlands. Across SDI quintiles, DALY rates ranged from 1853·0 (1352·1-2469·3) per 100 000 for middle SDI to 2184·1 (1606·1-2890·3) per 100 000 for high SDI. Interpretation A significant health burden was imposed by mental disorders in all countries and territories in 2023, irrespective of the health resources available. In some instances, this burden has increased over time and is unevenly distributed across populations. Stronger surveillance systems, particularly in low-income and middle-income countries, are required. Additionally, we need more coordinated and inclusive policies to reduce the burden through early treatment and prevention, tailored to sex and age differences across locations. Responding to the mental health needs of our global population, especially those most vulnerable, is an obligation, not a choice. Funding Gates Foundation, Queensland Health, and University of Queensland.
